23.17.176.s: paurṇamāsīm eva yajeta bhrātṛvyavān nāmāvāsyām iti || ubhayatra paurṇamāsahavirbhir yajeteti baudhāyanas |
23.17.176.d: पौर्णमासीम् एव यजेत भ्रातृव्यवान् नामावास्याम् इति ॥ उभयत्र पौर्णमासहविर्भिर् यजेतेति बौधायनस् ।
23.17.176.m: Regarding [the text]: "One who has a rival should sacrifice only at the full moon, not at the new moon": / Baudhāyana says he should sacrifice on both occasions with full-moon oblations.

23.17.176.s: nāmāvāsyāyāṃ kiṃcana yajñarūpaṃ kuryād iti śālīkiḥ
23.17.176.d: नामावास्यायां किंचन यज्ञरूपं कुर्याद् इति शालीकिः
23.17.176.m: Śālīki says he should not perform any form of sacrifice at the new moon.
Aupamanyava says he should perform the ancestral ball-offering.

23.17.176.s: sākaṃprasthāyīyena yajeta paśukāmas | iti || sūtram̐ śālīkes |
23.17.176.d: साकंप्रस्थायीयेन यजेत पशुकामस् । इति ॥ सूत्रँ शालीकेस् ।
23.17.176.m: Regarding [the text]: "One desiring cattle should sacrifice with the Sākaṃprasthāyīya": / The sūtra is Śālīki's.

23.17.176.s: atro ha smāha baudhāyanaḥ srugbhyām eva puroḍāśaṃ juhuyāc camasena sāṃnāyyam iti ||
23.17.176.d: अत्रो ह स्माह बौधायनः स्रुग्भ्याम् एव पुरोडाशं जुहुयाच् चमसेन सांनाय्यम् इति ॥
23.17.176.m: Here Baudhāyana indeed used to say: He should offer the cake with the two offering-ladles, and the curd-and-milk oblation with the cup.

23.17.176.s: nāgataśrīr mahendraṃ yajeta trayo vai gataśriyaḥ śuśuruvān grāmaṇī rājanyas
23.17.176.d: नागतश्रीर् महेन्द्रं यजेत त्रयो वै गतश्रियः शुशुरुवान् ग्रामणी राजन्यस्
23.17.176.m: "One who has not attained prosperity should not sacrifice to Mahendra;" / "Three indeed are those who have attained prosperity: the learned, the village headman, and the rājanya;"

23.17.176.s: teṣāṃ māhendro devatā | iti || sa yo 'nya etebhyo mahendram iyakṣeta sa saṃvatsaram indram iṣṭvā mahendrejyāṃ labheteti baudhāyanas |
23.17.176.d: तेषां माहेन्द्रो देवता । इति ॥ स यो ऽन्य एतेभ्यो महेन्द्रम् इयक्षेत स संवत्सरम् इन्द्रम् इष्ट्वा महेन्द्रेज्यां लभेतेति बौधायनस् ।
23.17.176.m: "Their deity is Mahendra." / Baudhāyana says that anyone other than these who desires to sacrifice to Mahendra, having sacrificed to Indra for a year, should obtain the sacrifice to Mahendra.

23.17.176.s: ata evāpi saṃvatsaram indram iṣṭvā mahendrejyāṃ labheteti śālīkiḥ ||
23.17.176.d: अत एवापि संवत्सरम् इन्द्रम् इष्ट्वा महेन्द्रेज्यां लभेतेति शालीकिः ॥
23.17.176.m: Śālīki says that from this very [principle], having sacrificed to Indra for a year, he should obtain the sacrifice to Mahendra.

23.17.176.s: saṃvatsaram indraṃ yajeta saṃvatsaram̐ hi vrataṃ nāti | iti ||
23.17.176.d: संवत्सरम् इन्द्रं यजेत संवत्सरँ हि व्रतं नाति । इति ॥
23.17.176.m: "He should sacrifice to Indra for a year;" / "For a vow does not exceed a year."

23.17.176.s: sūtram̐ śālīkes | atro ha smāha baudhāyano yasyām amāvāsyāyām ādita indraṃ yaṣṭuṃ prakrāmet saṃvatsare paryavete tasyāṃ mahendraṃ yajeta
23.17.176.d: सूत्रँ शालीकेस् । अत्रो ह स्माह बौधायनो यस्याम् अमावास्यायाम् आदित इन्द्रं यष्टुं प्रक्रामेत् संवत्सरे पर्यवेते तस्यां महेन्द्रं यजेत
23.17.176.m: The sūtra is Śālīki's. / Here Baudhāyana indeed used to say: On whichever new-moon day he begins to sacrifice to Indra, when a year has elapsed, on that [new moon] he should sacrifice to Mahendra.

23.17.177.s: so 'ta ūrdhvaṃ mahendrayājy eva syād iti | atro ha smāhaupamanyavo 'bhyārūḍhaḥ khalv asyaiva saṃvatsaro bhavati yasyām amāvāsyāyām ādita indraṃ yaṣṭuṃ prakrāmet saṃvatsare paryavete yā tataḥ pūrvāmāvāsyā syāt tasyāṃ mahendraṃ yajeta
23.17.177.d: सो ऽत ऊर्ध्वं महेन्द्रयाज्य् एव स्याद् इति । अत्रो ह स्माहौपमन्यवो ऽभ्यारूढः खल्व् अस्यैव संवत्सरो भवति यस्याम् अमावास्यायाम् आदित इन्द्रं यष्टुं प्रक्रामेत् संवत्सरे पर्यवेते या ततः पूर्वामावास्या स्यात् तस्यां महेन्द्रं यजेत
23.17.177.m: From then on, he should be a sacrificer to Mahendra. / Here Aupamanyava indeed used to say: His year becomes exceeded; on whichever new-moon day he begins to sacrifice to Indra, when a year has elapsed, on the new-moon day prior to that, he should sacrifice to Mahendra.

23.17.177.s: so 'ta ūrdhvaṃ mahendrayājy eva syād iti ||
23.17.177.d: सो ऽत ऊर्ध्वं महेन्द्रयाज्य् एव स्याद् इति ॥
23.17.177.m: From then on, he should be a sacrificer to Mahendra.

23.17.177.s: dākṣāyaṇayajñena suvargakāmo yajeta pūrṇamāse saṃnayen maitrāvaruṇyāmikṣayāmāvāsyāyāṃ yajeta | iti ||
23.17.177.d: दाक्षायणयज्ञेन सुवर्गकामो यजेत पूर्णमासे संनयेन् मैत्रावरुण्यामिक्षयामावास्यायां यजेत । इति ॥
23.17.177.m: "One desiring heaven should sacrifice with the Dākṣāyaṇa sacrifice;" / "He should prepare the curd-and-milk oblation at the full moon; he should sacrifice with the curd-mess for Mitra and Varuṇa at the new moon."
Śālīki says he should also perform the supplementary offering of the Vaimṛdha here.

23.17.177.s: sāṃnāyyasya bhakṣaṇa iti || sūtram̐ śālīkes | atro ha smāha baudhāyano yajamāna evaitam ardhamāsam anunidhāya sāṃnāyyaṃ bhakṣayed iti ||
23.17.177.d: सांनाय्यस्य भक्षण इति ॥ सूत्रँ शालीकेस् । अत्रो ह स्माह बौधायनो यजमान एवैतम् अर्धमासम् अनुनिधाय सांनाय्यं भक्षयेद् इति ॥
23.17.177.m: Regarding the consuming of the curd-and-milk oblation: / The sūtra is Śālīki's. / Here Baudhāyana indeed used to say: The sacrificer alone, following the half-month, having laid it aside, should consume the curd-and-milk oblation.

23.17.177.s: āmikṣāyai mantrāmantra iti || mantravatī syād iti baudhāyanas
23.17.177.d: आमिक्षायै मन्त्रामन्त्र इति ॥ मन्त्रवती स्याद् इति बौधायनस्
23.17.177.m: Regarding [whether] formula or no formula [is used] for the curd-mess: / Baudhāyana says it should be accompanied by a formula.

23.17.177.s: iḍādadhe catuñcakra upām̐śuyājasya karaṇa iti || kuryād iti baudhāyanas |
23.17.177.d: इडादधे चतुञ्चक्र उपाँशुयाजस्य करण इति ॥ कुर्याद् इति बौधायनस् ।
23.17.177.m: Regarding performing the low-voice offering in the Iḍādadha with four wheels: / Baudhāyana says he should perform it.

23.18.177.s: bṛhaspatisave dākṣiṇānāṃ homa iti || anusavanaṃ dākṣiṇāni juhuyād iti baudhāyano mādhyaṃdina eva savane dākṣiṇāni juhuyāt | dadāmi | ity evetarāyoḥ savanayor brūyād iti śālīkiḥ ||
23.18.177.d: बृहस्पतिसवे दाक्षिणानां होम इति ॥ अनुसवनं दाक्षिणानि जुहुयाद् इति बौधायनो माध्यंदिन एव सवने दाक्षिणानि जुहुयात् । ददामि । इत्य् एवेतरायोः सवनयोर् ब्रूयाद् इति शालीकिः ॥
23.18.177.m: Regarding the offering of the priestly gifts in the Bṛhaspatisava: / Baudhāyana says he should offer the priestly gifts at each pressing; Śālīki says he should offer the priestly gifts only at the midday pressing, and at the other two pressings he should merely say: "I give."

23.18.178.s: hiraṇyena ghṛtam utpunātīti || mantraniruptam etad ghṛtam̐ syād iti baudhāyanas
23.18.178.d: हिरण्येन घृतम् उत्पुनातीति ॥ मन्त्रनिरुप्तम् एतद् घृतँ स्याद् इति बौधायनस्
23.18.178.m: Regarding [the rule]: "He purifies the ghee with gold": / Baudhāyana says this ghee should be poured out with a formula.

23.18.178.s: anuddhate vedyai dakṣiṇata āhavanīyasya bṛhata stotraṃ pratyabhiṣiñcatīti ||
23.18.178.d: अनुद्धते वेद्यै दक्षिणत आहवनीयस्य बृहत स्तोत्रं प्रत्यभिषिञ्चतीति ॥
23.18.178.m: Regarding [the rule]: "On the unraised [portion] of the altar, south of the āhavanīya fire, he anoints towards the Bṛhat chant":

23.18.178.s: sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya kṛṣṇājinam apy atrāstṛtyābhiṣiñced iti śālīkiḥ ||
23.18.178.d: सूत्रं बौधायनस्य कृष्णाजिनम् अप्य् अत्रास्तृत्याभिषिञ्चेद् इति शालीकिः ॥
23.18.178.m: The sūtra is Baudhāyana's. / Śālīki says having spread a black antelope skin here too, he should anoint.

23.18.178.s: māṣaiḥ pūrṇaṃ kamaṇḍalum iti || sauvarṇaḥ sauvarṇair māṣaiḥ pūrṇaḥ syād iti baudhāyanas |
23.18.178.d: माषैः पूर्णं कमण्डलुम् इति ॥ सौवर्णः सौवर्णैर् माषैः पूर्णः स्याद् इति बौधायनस् ।
23.18.178.m: Regarding the water-pot filled with beans: / Baudhāyana says it should be of gold, filled with gold beans.
Śālīki says it should be made of clay, with grain beans.

23.18.178.s: saptadaśa mārutīḥ pṛśnīr vatsatarīr ālabhata iti || pṛthag evāsāṃ manotāḥ syuḥ pṛthak paśupuroḍāśa iti baudhāyanaḥ
23.18.178.d: सप्तदश मारुतीः पृश्नीर् वत्सतरीर् आलभत इति ॥ पृथग् एवासां मनोताः स्युः पृथक् पशुपुरोडाश इति बौधायनः
23.18.178.m: Regarding [the rule]: "He seizes seventeen speckled heifers for the Maruts": / Baudhāyana says their Manotā [hymns] should be separate, and the animal cakes separate.

23.18.178.s: pṛthag evasāṃ manotāḥ syur ekaḥ paśupuroḍāśa iti śālīkis |
23.18.178.d: पृथग् एवसां मनोताः स्युर् एकः पशुपुरोडाश इति शालीकिस् ।
23.18.178.m: Śālīki says their Manotā [hymns] should be separate, but the animal cake single.

23.18.178.s: ekaivāsāṃ manotā syādekaḥ paśupuroḍāśa ity aupamanyavaḥ ||
23.18.178.d: एकैवासां मनोता स्यादेकः पशुपुरोडाश इत्य् औपमन्यवः ॥
23.18.178.m: Aupamanyava says their Manotā [hymn] should be single, and the animal cake single.

23.18.178.s: agniṣṭutīndrastutīti || sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya yathāprakṛtim evādhvaryuḥ kuryāc chandogabahvṛcā eva prativikurvīrann iti śālīkiḥ ||
23.18.178.d: अग्निष्टुतीन्द्रस्तुतीति ॥ सूत्रं बौधायनस्य यथाप्रकृतिम् एवाध्वर्युः कुर्याच् छन्दोगबह्वृचा एव प्रतिविकुर्वीरन्न् इति शालीकिः ॥
23.18.178.m:
As to the Agniṣṭut and Indrastut rituals:
The sūtra is Baudhāyana's.
The adhvaryu priest should perform just according to the archetype; the Chāndogas and the Bahvṛcas alone should modify [their duties], says Śālīki.

23.18.178.s: atiriktastotreṣv iti || pūrvaḥ kalpo baudhāyanasyottaraḥ śālīkeḥ ||
23.18.178.d: अतिरिक्तस्तोत्रेष्व् इति ॥ पूर्वः कल्पो बौधायनस्योत्तरः शालीकेः ॥
23.18.178.m:
As to the redundant chants:
The former option is Baudhāyana's, the latter Śālīki's.

23.18.179.s: dhanuṣaḥ pradāna iti || pūrvaḥ kalpaḥ śālīker uttaro baudhāyanasya ||
23.18.179.d: धनुषः प्रदान इति ॥ पूर्वः कल्पः शालीकेर् उत्तरो बौधायनस्य ॥
23.18.179.m:
As to the presentation of the bow:
The former option is Śālīki's, the latter Baudhāyana's.

23.18.179.s: ekāhānām anta iti || sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya mṛtyusavānta iti śālīkiḥ ||
23.18.179.d: एकाहानाम् अन्त इति ॥ सूत्रं बौधायनस्य मृत्युसवान्त इति शालीकिः ॥
23.18.179.m:
As to the conclusion of the one-day rites:
The sūtra is Baudhāyana's.
Ending with the Mṛtyusava, says Śālīki.

23.18.179.s: nidadhaty asmā etad dhavir ucchiṣṭaṃ vratabhājanam iti || sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya
23.18.179.d: निदधत्य् अस्मा एतद् धविर् उच्छिष्टं व्रतभाजनम् इति ॥ सूत्रं बौधायनस्य
23.18.179.m:
As to the statement: 'They set down for him this leftover oblation as his food of observance':
The sūtra is Baudhāyana's.

23.18.179.s: nātra havir ucchiṣṭaṃ vratabhājanaṃ nidadhyād iti śālīkiḥ ||
23.18.179.d: नात्र हविर् उच्छिष्टं व्रतभाजनं निदध्याद् इति शालीकिः ॥
23.18.179.m: Here one should not set down the leftover oblation as food of observance, says Śālīki.

23.18.179.s: athāsyām̐ sadyaskriyām anukriyāṃ parikriyām atikriyāṃ pravargyasya karaṇa iti ||
23.18.179.d: अथास्याँ सद्यस्क्रियाम् अनुक्रियां परिक्रियाम् अतिक्रियां प्रवर्ग्यस्य करण इति ॥
23.18.179.m: Now, as to the performing of the pravargya in this single-day performance, imitated performance, surrounding performance, or beyond-performance:

23.18.179.s: kuryād iti baudhāyanas | na kuryād iti śālīkiḥ ||
23.18.179.d: कुर्याद् इति बौधायनस् । न कुर्याद् इति शालीकिः ॥
23.18.179.m:
One should perform it, says Baudhāyana.
One should not perform it, says Śālīki.

23.18.179.d: शवानसो ऽधिषवणे फलके पुरुषास्थस्य वृषणाव् इति ॥
23.18.179.m: As to: 'The two pressing boards from a corpse-cart, the two testicles from a human bone':

23.18.179.s: sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya śavānaso 'py atrāraṇī kuryād iti śālīkiḥ ||
23.18.179.d: सूत्रं बौधायनस्य शवानसो ऽप्य् अत्रारणी कुर्याद् इति शालीकिः ॥
23.18.179.m:
The sūtra is Baudhāyana's.
One should also make the two fire-drills from a corpse-cart here, says Śālīki.

23.18.179.s: sa yaṃ kaṃ ca grahaṃ gṛhṇāty evam evainaṃ gṛhṇāti yad u kiṃ ca pātram̐ sādayaty evainat sādayatīti ||
23.18.179.d: स यं कं च ग्रहं गृह्णात्य् एवम् एवैनं गृह्णाति यद् उ किं च पात्रँ सादयत्य् एवैनत् सादयतीति ॥
23.18.179.m: As to: 'Whatever soma-cup he draws, thus indeed he draws it; and whatever vessel he sets down, thus he sets it down':

23.18.179.s: sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya yaṃyaṃ grahaṃ gṛhṇīyāt taṃtaṃ parimṛjya sādayed iti śālīkiḥ ||
23.18.179.d: सूत्रं बौधायनस्य यंयं ग्रहं गृह्णीयात् तंतं परिमृज्य सादयेद् इति शालीकिः ॥
23.18.179.m:
The sūtra is Baudhāyana's.
Whichever soma-cup one may draw, after wiping each one, one should set it down, says Śālīki.

23.18.179.s: śvetam aśvaṃ dadāti śvetāṃ vaḍabāṃ dadāti | aśvam asitaṃ dadāti
23.18.179.d: श्वेतम् अश्वं ददाति श्वेतां वडबां ददाति । अश्वम् असितं ददाति

23.18.179.s: garbhiṇīṃ vaḍabāṃ lalāmīṃ dadāti | anaḍucchataṃ dadāti trayastrim̐śataṃ niṣkān dadāti
23.18.179.d: गर्भिणीं वडबां ललामीं ददाति । अनडुच्छतं ददाति त्रयस्त्रिँशतं निष्कान् ददाति

23.18.180.m:
he gives a soma-cup;
he gives a golden cup;

23.18.180.s: rāśikṛtaṃ dhānyaṃ dadāti marāyakṛtaṃ dhānyaṃ dadātīti ||
23.18.180.d: राशिकृतं धान्यं ददाति मरायकृतं धान्यं ददातीति ॥
23.18.180.m:
he gives grain heaped up;
he gives grain stored in a granary: —

23.18.180.s: etāni ca nityāni ca dadyād iti baudhāyanas |
23.18.180.d: एतानि च नित्यानि च दद्याद् इति बौधायनस् ।
23.18.180.m: One should give these and the regular [sacrificial fees], says Baudhāyana.

23.19.180.m: Now then we shall explain the Sarvatomukha [sacrifice].

23.19.180.s: cinvīta sarvatomukhe 'gnim iti baudhāyanas | na cinvīteti śālīkis |
23.19.180.d: चिन्वीत सर्वतोमुखे ऽग्निम् इति बौधायनस् । न चिन्वीतेति शालीकिस् ।
23.19.180.m:
One should pile the fire altar in the Sarvatomukha, says Baudhāyana.
One should not pile it, says Śālīki.

23.19.180.s: atro ha smāha maudgalyaḥ pūrvasminn evāgnicaya itareṣu sāvitrāḥ syus |
23.19.180.d: अत्रो ह स्माह मौद्गल्यः पूर्वस्मिन्न् एवाग्निचय इतरेषु सावित्राः स्युस् ।
23.19.180.m: On this matter Maudgalya used to say: there should be a piling of the fire altar only at the first; at the others there should be the Sāvitra [fire-pilings].

23.19.180.s: ity etad api na kuryād ity āñjīgaviḥ ||
23.19.180.d: इत्य् एतद् अपि न कुर्याद् इत्य् आञ्जीगविः ॥
23.19.180.m: One should not perform even this, says Āñjīgavi.

23.19.180.s: araṇyoḥ samāropaṇa iti || sūtram ācāryayos | atro ha smāha gautamo gṛhapatir eva prathamam araṇyoḥ samāropayeta itare sattra iti ||
23.19.180.d: अरण्योः समारोपण इति ॥ सूत्रम् आचार्ययोस् । अत्रो ह स्माह गौतमो गृहपतिर् एव प्रथमम् अरण्योः समारोपयेत इतरे सत्त्र इति ॥
23.19.180.m:
As to mounting [the fires] into the two churning sticks:
The sūtra is of the two teachers.
On this matter Gautama used to say: only the master of the house should first mount [the fires] into the two churning sticks, the others at the sacrificial session.

23.19.181.s: śālāyā iti || prākṛtena prakrameṇa mīyāt | madhye gārhapatya iti ||
23.19.181.d: शालाया इति ॥ प्राकृतेन प्रक्रमेण मीयात् । मध्ये गार्हपत्य इति ॥

23.19.181.s: sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya | atro ha smāha śālīkiḥ tripadena prakrameṇa sarvata iti ||
23.19.181.d: सूत्रं बौधायनस्य । अत्रो ह स्माह शालीकिः त्रिपदेन प्रक्रमेण सर्वत इति ॥
23.19.181.m:
The sūtra is Baudhāyana's.
On this matter Śālīki used to say: with a three-foot pace on every side.

23.19.181.s: trivṛt prācyāṃ diśi bhavati pañcadaśo dakṣiṇataḥ saptadaśaḥ paścād ekavim̐śa uttarataḥ
23.19.181.d: त्रिवृत् प्राच्यां दिशि भवति पञ्चदशो दक्षिणतः सप्तदशः पश्चाद् एकविँश उत्तरतः
23.19.181.m: The trivṛt [stoma] is in the eastern quarter, the fifteenfold to the south, the seventeenfold to the west, the twenty-onefold to the north;

23.19.181.s: sarvato vā jyotiṣṭomaḥ sarve jyotiṣṭomadakṣiṇā iti ||
23.19.181.d: सर्वतो वा ज्योतिष्टोमः सर्वे ज्योतिष्टोमदक्षिणा इति ॥
23.19.181.m: or it is a Jyotiṣṭoma facing all directions, with all the sacrificial fees of a Jyotiṣṭoma.

23.19.181.s: pravargyasya karaṇa iti || sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya nokthye pravṛñjyād iti śālīkiḥ ||
23.19.181.d: प्रवर्ग्यस्य करण इति ॥ सूत्रं बौधायनस्य नोक्थ्ये प्रवृञ्ज्याद् इति शालीकिः ॥
23.19.181.m:
As to performing the pravargya:
The sūtra is Baudhāyana's.
One should not perform the pravargya in an Ukthya, says Śālīki.

23.19.181.s: yājamāna iti || abhīnāma yājamānaṃ kuryād iti baudhāyanaḥ
23.19.181.d: याजमान इति ॥ अभीनाम याजमानं कुर्याद् इति बौधायनः
23.19.181.m:
As to the duties of the sacrificer:
One should perform the duties of the sacrificer in sequence, says Baudhāyana.

23.19.181.s: kuryād yathāvakāśaṃ yājamānam iti śālīkis | ye 'gnisam̐skārāḥ syus tān kāmam itarat tantreṇety aupamanyavaḥ ||
23.19.181.d: कुर्याद् यथावकाशं याजमानम् इति शालीकिस् । ये ऽग्निसँस्काराः स्युस् तान् कामम् इतरत् तन्त्रेणेत्य् औपमन्यवः ॥
23.19.181.m:
One should perform the duties of the sacrificer according to the occasion, says Śālīki.
Whatever are consecrations of the fire, one may perform them at will; the rest [is done] in common, says Aupamanyava.

23.19.181.s: agnyanvādhāna iti || sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya | atro ha smāha śālīkir gārhapatyaḥ sakṛd anvāhitaḥ syād grāmayonir anvāhāryapacana āhavanīyam̐ sakṛd anvādhāya tato yathārthaṃ gacched iti ||
23.19.181.d: अग्न्यन्वाधान इति ॥ सूत्रं बौधायनस्य । अत्रो ह स्माह शालीकिर् गार्हपत्यः सकृद् अन्वाहितः स्याद् ग्रामयोनिर् अन्वाहार्यपचन आहवनीयँ सकृद् अन्वाधाय ततो यथार्थं गच्छेद् इति ॥
23.19.181.m: Regarding the adding of fuel to the sacred fires: the sūtra is Baudhāyana's. In this regard, Śālīki used to say: The gārhapatya should be fueled once; the anvāhāryapacana is [procured] from the village; having fueled the āhavanīya fire once, he should then proceed according to the need.

23.19.182.s: bhakṣaṇa iti || sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya sarvam̐ samavadhāya sakṛd eva bhakṣayed iti śālīkiḥ ||
23.19.182.d: भक्षण इति ॥ सूत्रं बौधायनस्य सर्वँ समवधाय सकृद् एव भक्षयेद् इति शालीकिः ॥
23.19.182.m: Regarding consuming: the sūtra is Baudhāyana's. Śālīki says: Having gathered everything together, he should consume it only once.

23.19.182.s: mārjana iti || sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya sakṛd ekasminn iti śālīkiḥ ||
23.19.182.d: मार्जन इति ॥ सूत्रं बौधायनस्य सकृद् एकस्मिन्न् इति शालीकिः ॥
23.19.182.m: Regarding sprinkling [with water for purification]: the sūtra is Baudhāyana's. Śālīki says: Once on a single [object].

23.19.182.s: lokāgnīnām̐ haraṇa iti || sūtram ācāryayos | atro ha smāha dīrghavātsyaḥ pūrvasminn eva yājamānam̐ syād iti ||
23.19.182.d: लोकाग्नीनाँ हरण इति ॥ सूत्रम् आचार्ययोस् । अत्रो ह स्माह दीर्घवात्स्यः पूर्वस्मिन्न् एव याजमानँ स्याद् इति ॥
23.19.182.m: Regarding carrying the fires for the worlds: the sūtra belongs to both teachers. In this regard, Dīrghavātsya used to say: The sacrificer's duty should take place only at the former.

23.19.182.s: kratupaśūnāṃ karaṇa iti || sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya kratupaśava aikādaśināś ca vikalpanta iti śālīkiḥ ||
23.19.182.d: क्रतुपशूनां करण इति ॥ सूत्रं बौधायनस्य क्रतुपशव ऐकादशिनाश् च विकल्पन्त इति शालीकिः ॥
23.19.182.m: Regarding performing the sacrifice of sacrificial animals for the ritual: the sūtra is Baudhāyana's. Śālīki says: The sacrificial animals for the ritual and the eleven animal victims are optional alternatives.

23.19.182.s: samañjana iti || sūtram aupamanyavīputrasya yāvanta stomās tāvatkṛtvaḥ pracaraṇyā samanaktīti baudhāyanaḥ ||
23.19.182.d: समञ्जन इति ॥ सूत्रम् औपमन्यवीपुत्रस्य यावन्त स्तोमास् तावत्कृत्वः प्रचरण्या समनक्तीति बौधायनः ॥
23.19.182.m: Regarding anointing together: the sūtra is that of Aupamanyavīputra. Baudhāyana says: As many stomas as there are, so many times does he anoint together with the pracaraṇī ladle.

23.19.182.s: dadhigraha iti || sūtraṃ maudgalyasya payasā vājyena veti ||
23.19.182.d: दधिग्रह इति ॥ सूत्रं मौद्गल्यस्य पयसा वाज्येन वेति ॥
23.19.182.m: Regarding the soma-cup with curd: the sūtra is Maudgalya's: 'Either with milk or with clarified butter.'
The former option is Baudhāyana's; the latter is Śālīki's.

23.19.182.s: am̐śvadābhyayor grahaṇa iti || sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya | atro ha smāha śālīkir vājapeye dvādaśāhe sattre tāṇḍināmayana udbhidi valabhidīti tasya syād iti |
23.19.182.d: अँश्वदाभ्ययोर् ग्रहण इति ॥ सूत्रं बौधायनस्य । अत्रो ह स्माह शालीकिर् वाजपेये द्वादशाहे सत्त्रे ताण्डिनामयन उद्भिदि वलभिदीति तस्य स्याद् इति ।
23.19.182.m: Regarding drawing the aṃśu and adābhya cups: the sūtra is Baudhāyana's. In this regard, Śālīki used to say: In the vājapeya, the twelve-day rite, a sattra, the tāṇḍināmayana, the udbhid, and the valabhid—in these it should belong to him.

23.19.183.m: Likewise regarding the pṛśni cups and the prāṇa cups.

23.19.183.s: ṣoḍaśigrahāṇāṃ grahaṇa iti || sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya | anusavanaṃ gṛhṇīyur iti śālīkiḥ ||
23.19.183.d: षोडशिग्रहाणां ग्रहण इति ॥ सूत्रं बौधायनस्य । अनुसवनं गृह्णीयुर् इति शालीकिः ॥
23.19.183.m: Regarding drawing the ṣoḍaśin cups: the sūtra is Baudhāyana's. Śālīki says: They should draw them at each soma pressing.

23.19.183.s: atigrāhyāṇām̐ homa iti || sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya māhendrasyānuvaṣaṭkāram upajuhuyur iti śālīkiḥ ||
23.19.183.d: अतिग्राह्याणाँ होम इति ॥ सूत्रं बौधायनस्य माहेन्द्रस्यानुवषट्कारम् उपजुहुयुर् इति शालीकिः ॥
23.19.183.m: Regarding the offering of the additional cups: the sūtra is Baudhāyana's. Śālīki says: They should offer them following the secondary vaṣaṭ call for the Māhendra cup.

23.19.183.s: ṣoḍaśina stotram upākarotīti || sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya yena kena cid iti śālīkiḥ ||
23.19.183.d: षोडशिन स्तोत्रम् उपाकरोतीति ॥ सूत्रं बौधायनस्य येन केन चिद् इति शालीकिः ॥
23.19.183.m: Regarding 'he initiates the stotra of the ṣoḍaśin': the sūtra is Baudhāyana's. Śālīki says: With whatever [stotra].

23.19.183.s: hṛdayaśūlānām udvāsana iti || ekaikaśa udvāsayed iti baudhāyanaḥ
23.19.183.d: हृदयशूलानाम् उद्वासन इति ॥ एकैकश उद्वासयेद् इति बौधायनः
23.19.183.m: Regarding the disposal of the heart-spits: Baudhāyana says that one should dispose of them one by one.

23.19.183.s: avabhṛtha iti || sūtraṃ baudhāyanasya prāñca evāvabhṛtham aveyur iti śālīkiḥ ||
23.19.183.d: अवभृथ इति ॥ सूत्रं बौधायनस्य प्राञ्च एवावभृथम् अवेयुर् इति शालीकिः ॥
23.19.183.m: Regarding the final purifying bath: the sūtra is Baudhāyana's. Śālīki says: They should go down to the final purifying bath facing east only.

23.19.184.s: araṇyoḥ samāropaṇa iti || sūtram ācāryayos | atro ha smāha gautamo gṛhapatir evāraṇyoḥ samāropayet tata itara iti ||
23.19.184.d: अरण्योः समारोपण इति ॥ सूत्रम् आचार्ययोस् । अत्रो ह स्माह गौतमो गृहपतिर् एवारण्योः समारोपयेत् तत इतर इति ॥
23.19.184.m: Regarding the placing [of the fires] into the fire-churning sticks: the sūtra belongs to both teachers. In this regard, Gautama used to say: The master of the house alone should place them into the fire-churning sticks; thereafter the other.

24.1.185.s: pañcatayena kalpam avekṣeta chandasā brāhmaṇena pratyayena nyāyena sam̐sthāvaśeneti
24.1.185.d: पञ्चतयेन कल्पम् अवेक्षेत छन्दसा ब्राह्मणेन प्रत्ययेन न्यायेन सँस्थावशेनेति
24.1.185.m: One should examine the ritual procedure by means of five factors: by the Vedic text, by the brāhmaṇa passage, by authority, by general rule, and by the requirement of the ritual form.

24.1.185.s: chandaseti yad avocāma yathāmnāyapraṇidhīdaṃ pūrvam idam uttaram iti |
24.1.185.d: छन्दसेति यद् अवोचाम यथाम्नायप्रणिधीदं पूर्वम् इदम् उत्तरम् इति ।
24.1.185.m: As to what we said, 'by the Vedic text': according to the arrangement of the transmitted text, this comes first, this comes later.

24.1.185.s: athāpi mantra eva svayaṃ karma prabrūte karmānuvādo bhavati
24.1.185.d: अथापि मन्त्र एव स्वयं कर्म प्रब्रूते कर्मानुवादो भवति
24.1.185.m: Moreover, the mantra itself declares the ritual action; it is a restatement of the action.

24.1.185.s: yathaitad bhavati preyam agād dhiṣaṇā barhir accha | urv antarikṣam anvihi devasya tvā savituḥ prasave 'śvinor bāhubhyāṃ pūṣṇo hastābhyām agnaye juṣṭaṃ nirvapāmi | iti
24.1.185.d: यथैतद् भवति प्रेयम् अगाद् धिषणा बर्हिर् अच्छ । उर्व् अन्तरिक्षम् अन्विहि देवस्य त्वा सवितुः प्रसवे ऽश्विनोर् बाहुभ्यां पूष्णो हस्ताभ्याम् अग्नये जुष्टं निर्वपामि । इति
24.1.185.m: As is the case with this: 'Forth has the inspiring power gone towards the sacrificial grass,' 'Traverse the wide intermediate space,' and 'At the impulse of the god Savitar, with the arms of the Aśvins, with the hands of Pūṣan, I measure out [the oblation] acceptable to Agni.'

24.1.185.s: yac chandasā na śaknuyāt kalpayituṃ brāhmaṇena tac cikalpayiṣet |
24.1.185.d: यच् छन्दसा न शक्नुयात् कल्पयितुं ब्राह्मणेन तच् चिकल्पयिषेत् ।
24.1.185.m: What one cannot arrange by the Vedic text, that one should seek to arrange by the brāhmaṇa passage.

24.1.185.s: brāhmaṇam u haivainān mantrān aprajñātān vidadhātīdam anena karotīdam aneneti
24.1.185.d: ब्राह्मणम् उ हैवैनान् मन्त्रान् अप्रज्ञातान् विदधातीदम् अनेन करोतीदम् अनेनेति
24.1.185.m: And the brāhmaṇa passage indeed enjoins these mantras when their application is unknown: 'He does this with this [mantra], he does this with this [mantra].'

24.1.185.s: yathaitad bhavati | iṣe tvā | ūrje tvā | iti śākhām ācchinatti vāyava stha | upāyava stha | iti vatsān apākarotīti |
24.1.185.d: यथैतद् भवति । इषे त्वा । ऊर्जे त्वा । इति शाखाम् आच्छिनत्ति वायव स्थ । उपायव स्थ । इति वत्सान् अपाकरोतीति ।
24.1.185.m: As is the case with this: with 'For sap thee,' 'For strength thee,' he cuts off the branch; with 'Vāyu's calves are ye,' 'Upavāyu's calves are ye,' he separates the calves.

24.1.185.s: athāpy amantrāṇi karmāṇi vidadhāti yathaitad bhavati | aṣṭāsu prakrameṣu brāhmaṇo 'gnim ādadhītaikādaśasu rājanyo dvādaśasu vaiśyas | ity evaṃ vyavasthāvarṇasaṃyogāt |
24.1.185.d: अथाप्य् अमन्त्राणि कर्माणि विदधाति यथैतद् भवति । अष्टासु प्रक्रमेषु ब्राह्मणो ऽग्निम् आदधीतैकादशसु राजन्यो द्वादशसु वैश्यस् । इत्य् एवं व्यवस्थावर्णसंयोगात् ।
24.1.185.m: Moreover, it enjoins actions without mantras, as is the case with this: 'A brāhmaṇa should establish his fire at eight paces, a warrior at eleven, a vaiśya at twelve'—thus [it is determined] through connection with the rule of social classes.
Now as to what [was meant by] 'by authority': by the authority of the Sāmaveda priests, the Ṛgveda priests, or the adhvaryu priests.

24.1.185.s: yatho etan nyāyeneti prākṛte tantre prākṛtaṃ nyāyam anadhigacchan grāmanyāyaṃ pratīyād ayam ihārhatām̐ samārambha iti ||
24.1.185.d: यथो एतन् न्यायेनेति प्राकृते तन्त्रे प्राकृतं न्यायम् अनधिगच्छन् ग्रामन्यायं प्रतीयाद् अयम् इहार्हताँ समारम्भ इति ॥
24.1.185.m: And as to what [was said]: "by rule"—if he does not find the natural rule in the basic model, he should follow the common-sense rule: "This is the commencement for those worthy here."

24.1.185.s: yatho etat sam̐sthāvaśeneti some 'pahṛta ādārām̐ś ca phālgunāni cābhiṣuṇuyād iti
24.1.185.d: यथो एतत् सँस्थावशेनेति सोमे ऽपहृत आदाराँश् च फाल्गुनानि चाभिषुणुयाद् इति
24.1.185.m: And as to what [was said]: "according to the ritual form"—if soma is carried off, he should press ādāra or phālguna plants.

24.1.185.s: catuṣṭayena mantrā vartante stutyā nirdeśenāśiṣā naiva stutyā nāśiṣā na nirdeśeneti caturtham
24.1.185.d: चतुष्टयेन मन्त्रा वर्तन्ते स्तुत्या निर्देशेनाशिषा नैव स्तुत्या नाशिषा न निर्देशेनेति चतुर्थम्
24.1.185.m: Mantras operate in a fourfold manner: by praise, by direction, by blessing, and the fourth is neither by praise, nor by blessing, nor by direction.

24.1.185.s: atheme pañca havirākārā auṣadhaṃ payaḥ paśuḥ soma ājyam iti ||
24.1.185.d: अथेमे पञ्च हविराकारा औषधं पयः पशुः सोम आज्यम् इति ॥
24.1.185.m: Now these are the five forms of oblation: vegetable food, milk, animal, soma, and clarified butter.

24.2.185.s: teṣāṃ pṛthakpṛthag dharmāḥ pṛthag adhikaraṇāni yathādhikaraṇaṃ mantrā dṛṣṭās
24.2.185.d: तेषां पृथक्पृथग् धर्माः पृथग् अधिकरणानि यथाधिकरणं मन्त्रा दृष्टास्
24.2.185.m: Distinct are their rules, distinct their operations; the mantras are seen according to each operation.

24.2.186.s: tān na mithaḥ sam̐sādayed anādeśāt | yenayena yad dhaviḥ sam̐sidhyet tenatena tat kuryāt tat tasyādhikaraṇam
24.2.186.d: तान् न मिथः सँसादयेद् अनादेशात् । येनयेन यद् धविः सँसिध्येत् तेनतेन तत् कुर्यात् तत् तस्याधिकरणम्
24.2.186.m: One should not mix them together without specific instruction; with whatever each oblation would succeed, with that he should perform it; that is its operation.

24.2.186.s: yajña iti kim upajño yajñaḥ śraddhopajño māṅgala iti kva u khalu yajña iti
24.2.186.d: यज्ञ इति किम् उपज्ञो यज्ञः श्रद्धोपज्ञो माङ्गल इति क्व उ खलु यज्ञ इति
24.2.186.m: [It is asked:] "As for the sacrifice, on what does the sacrifice depend?" "It depends on faith, auspicious [in result]." "Where indeed is the sacrifice?"

24.2.186.s: puruṣa iti kā u khalu devatā dīkṣeti
24.2.186.d: पुरुष इति का उ खलु देवता दीक्षेति
24.2.186.m: "In the person." "And which deity indeed is the consecration?"

24.2.186.s: vāg iti kā u khalu pathyā svastir iti
24.2.186.d: वाग् इति का उ खलु पथ्या स्वस्तिर् इति

24.2.186.s: vāg eveti kā u khalv ekākṣarā gāyatrīti vāg eveti ka u khalu yajñasyārambhaḥ kā pratiṣṭheti
24.2.186.d: वाग् एवेति का उ खल्व् एकाक्षरा गायत्रीति वाग् एवेति क उ खलु यज्ञस्यारम्भः का प्रतिष्ठेति
24.2.186.m: "Just Speech." "And what indeed is the one-syllabled gāyatrī?" "Just Speech." "And what is the beginning of the sacrifice, what its support?"

24.2.186.s: vijñāyate svāhā yajñaṃ manasā svāhā dyāvāpṛthivībhyām̐ svāhoror antarikṣāt svāhā yajñaṃ vātād ārabhe | iti
24.2.186.d: विज्ञायते स्वाहा यज्ञं मनसा स्वाहा द्यावापृथिवीभ्याँ स्वाहोरोर् अन्तरिक्षात् स्वाहा यज्ञं वाताद् आरभे । इति
24.2.186.m: It is known [from the scripture]: "Hail to the sacrifice through mind, hail to Heaven and Earth, hail from the broad midspace, hail! I undertake the sacrifice from the wind."
The wind alone is the beginning of the sacrifice, the wind is its support.

24.3.186.s: katham u khalv etaj jānīyād idaṃ tantram ayam āvāpa iti | agnyanvādhānaprabhṛti tantram ājyabhāgābhyām anyatrauṣadhāt
24.3.186.d: कथम् उ खल्व् एतज् जानीयाद् इदं तन्त्रम् अयम् आवाप इति । अग्न्यन्वाधानप्रभृति तन्त्रम् आज्यभागाभ्याम् अन्यत्रौषधात्
24.3.186.m: How indeed should one understand: "This is the framework, this is the insertion"? The framework begins from adding fuel to the sacred fires up to the two butter portions, except for the vegetable oblation.

24.3.186.s: tasmim̐s tantre satyāvāpasthānāni bhavanti yathaitad dhenūnāṃ dohanaṃ kapālānām upadhānam̐ stambayajuṣo haraṇam ājyagrahā iti yac ca kiṃ cābhinivapati |
24.3.186.d: तस्मिँस् तन्त्रे सत्यावापस्थानानि भवन्ति यथैतद् धेनूनां दोहनं कपालानाम् उपधानँ स्तम्बयजुषो हरणम् आज्यग्रहा इति यच् च किं चाभिनिवपति ।
24.3.186.m: While that framework is present, the places of insertion are: as here, the milking of the cows, the placing of the potsherds, the carrying away of the grass-stump yajus, the drawings of clarified butter, and whatever one pours down additionally.

24.3.186.s: ūrdhvam ājyabhāgābhyām eṣa madhyata āvāpo bhavati yasminn etad dhavīm̐ṣy opyante tasminn evāvāpajāni tantrasthānaṃ bhajante yathaitat prāśitraṃ yajamānabhāgabrahmabhāgau sviṣṭakṛc ceḍā ceti |
24.3.186.d: ऊर्ध्वम् आज्यभागाभ्याम् एष मध्यत आवापो भवति यस्मिन्न् एतद् धवीँष्य् ओप्यन्ते तस्मिन्न् एवावापजानि तन्त्रस्थानं भजन्ते यथैतत् प्राशित्रं यजमानभागब्रह्मभागौ स्विष्टकृच् चेडा चेति ।
24.3.186.m: Above the two butter portions, this insertion occurs in the middle, in which these oblations are poured; in that very [phase] the things born of the insertion take the place of the framework: as here, the prāśitra portion, the sacrificer's portion, the Brahman's portion, the sviṣṭakṛt offering, and the iḍā.

24.3.187.s: avadānata āvāpo bhavati tantraṃ tu pradānataḥ
24.3.187.d: अवदानत आवापो भवति तन्त्रं तु प्रदानतः
24.3.187.m: From the cutting off arises the insertion, but the framework from the presenting [of the oblation].

24.3.187.s: kva u khalu tantram āvāpabhūyaṃ gacchaty āvāpo vā tantrabhūyam iti
24.3.187.d: क्व उ खलु तन्त्रम् आवापभूयं गच्छत्य् आवापो वा तन्त्रभूयम् इति
24.3.187.m: Where indeed does the framework become insertion, or the insertion become framework?

24.3.187.s: maitrābārhaspatye 'py anyasmim̐s tantram u ha nirvapaṇato bhavaty āvāpa u pradānatas |
24.3.187.d: मैत्राबार्हस्पत्ये ऽप्य् अन्यस्मिँस् तन्त्रम् उ ह निर्वपणतो भवत्य् आवाप उ प्रदानतस् ।
24.3.187.m: In the offering to Mitra and Bṛhaspati, and in another, the framework begins from the apportioning, and the insertion from the presenting.

24.3.187.s: atha vāruṇīṣu ca sam̐jñānīṣṭyāṃ cāvāpo ha nirvapaṇato bhavati tantraṃ tu pradānatas |
24.3.187.d: अथ वारुणीषु च सँज्ञानीष्ट्यां चावापो ह निर्वपणतो भवति तन्त्रं तु प्रदानतस् ।
24.3.187.m: Then in the offerings to Varuṇa and in the Saṃjñānī offering, the insertion begins from the apportioning, but the framework from the presenting.

24.3.187.s: anūyājaprabhṛti tantram ā samiṣṭayajuṣo homāt kiṃdevatyā u khalv anūyājā bhavantīti |
24.3.187.d: अनूयाजप्रभृति तन्त्रम् आ समिष्टयजुषो होमात् किंदेवत्या उ खल्व् अनूयाजा भवन्तीति ।
24.3.187.m: The framework begins from the after-offerings up to the offering of the samiṣṭayajus oblation. To which deity indeed do the after-offerings belong?

24.3.187.s: āgneyā ity eva brūyāt | vijñāyate taṃ devā āhutībhir anūyājeṣv anvavindan yad anūyājān yajaty agnim eva tat saminddhe | iti |
24.3.187.d: आग्नेया इत्य् एव ब्रूयात् । विज्ञायते तं देवा आहुतीभिर् अनूयाजेष्व् अन्वविन्दन् यद् अनूयाजान् यजत्य् अग्निम् एव तत् समिन्द्धे । इति ।
24.3.187.m: He should say: "To Agni." It is known [from the scripture]: "The gods found him through libations in the after-offerings; when he offers the after-offerings, he kindles Agni himself."
And the fore-offerings have the seasons as their deities.

24.4.187.s: kiyatyaḥ pākayajñasam̐sthāḥ kiyatyo haviryajñasam̐sthāḥ kiyatyaḥ somasam̐sthā iti
24.4.187.d: कियत्यः पाकयज्ञसँस्थाः कियत्यो हविर्यज्ञसँस्थाः कियत्यः सोमसँस्था इति
24.4.187.m: How many are the forms of pākayajña? How many the forms of haviryajña? How many the forms of somayajña?

24.4.187.s: hutaḥ prahuta āhutaḥ śūlagavo baliharaṇaṃ pratyavarohaṇam aṣṭakāhoma iti sapta pākayajñasam̐sthā iti |
24.4.187.d: हुतः प्रहुत आहुतः शूलगवो बलिहरणं प्रत्यवरोहणम् अष्टकाहोम इति सप्त पाकयज्ञसँस्था इति ।
24.4.187.m: Huta, prahuta, āhuta, the śūlagava, bali-offering, pratyavarohaṇa, and the aṣṭakā-offering—these are the seven forms of pākayajña.

24.4.187.s: aparimitā u haike bruvate yac ca kiṃ cānyatra vihārād dhūyate sarvās tāḥ pākayajñasam̐sthā iti |
24.4.187.d: अपरिमिता उ हैके ब्रुवते यच् च किं चान्यत्र विहाराद् धूयते सर्वास् ताः पाकयज्ञसँस्था इति ।
24.4.187.m: Some say they are limitless: whatever is offered elsewhere than the sacrificial enclosure, all those are forms of pākayajña.

24.4.187.s: atha haviryajñasam̐sthā agnyādheyam agnihotraṃ darśapūrṇamāsāv āgrayaṇaṃ cāturmāsyāni dākṣāyaṇayajñaḥ kauṇḍapāyinya iti
24.4.187.d: अथ हविर्यज्ञसँस्था अग्न्याधेयम् अग्निहोत्रं दर्शपूर्णमासाव् आग्रयणं चातुर्मास्यानि दाक्षायणयज्ञः कौण्डपायिन्य इति
24.4.187.m: Now the forms of haviryajña: agnyādheya, agnihotra, the new and full moon rituals, āgrayaṇa, the cāturmāsya rituals, dākṣāyaṇayajña, and kauṇḍapāyinya.

24.4.188.s: sautrāmaṇim u haike bruvate | atha somasaṃsthās |
24.4.188.d: सौत्रामणिम् उ हैके ब्रुवते । अथ सोमसंस्थास् ।
24.4.188.m: Some also mention sautrāmaṇī. Now the forms of somayajña:

24.4.188.s: agniṣṭomo 'tyagniṣṭoma ukthyaḥ ṣoḍaśī vājpeyo 'tirātro 'ptoryāma iti sapta somasam̐sthās |
24.4.188.d: अग्निष्टोमो ऽत्यग्निष्टोम उक्थ्यः षोडशी वाज्पेयो ऽतिरात्रो ऽप्तोर्याम इति सप्त सोमसँस्थास् ।
24.4.188.m: Agniṣṭoma, atyagniṣṭoma, ukthya, ṣoḍaśin, vājapeya, atirātra, and aptoryāma—these are the seven forms of somayajña.
Whatever is the ritual structure of the agniṣṭoma, that is of the atyagniṣṭoma.
Whatever is of the ukthya, that is of the ṣoḍaśin and vājapeya.

24.4.188.s: yad atirātrasya tad aptoryāmasyeti saptānām̐ somāsam̐sthānāṃ dve sattrāṇi na gacchato vājapeyaś cāptoryāmaś ceti ||
24.4.188.d: यद् अतिरात्रस्य तद् अप्तोर्यामस्येति सप्तानाँ सोमासँस्थानां द्वे सत्त्राणि न गच्छतो वाजपेयश् चाप्तोर्यामश् चेति ॥
24.4.188.m: Whatever is of the atirātra, that is of the aptoryāma. Of the seven forms of somayajña, two do not become sacrificial sessions: the vājapeya and the aptoryāma.

24.5.188.s: katham u khalv etaj jānīyād iyaṃ pūrvā tatir iyam uttareti yā prakṛtiḥ sā pūrvā tatis |
24.5.188.d: कथम् उ खल्व् एतज् जानीयाद् इयं पूर्वा ततिर् इयम् उत्तरेति या प्रकृतिः सा पूर्वा ततिस् ।
24.5.188.m: How indeed should one understand: "This is the prior series, this the subsequent series"? That which is the archetype is the prior series.

24.5.188.s: atha yad vidadhāti sottarā tatis | agnyādheyaṃ pūrvā tatiḥ punarādheyam uttarā tatis |
24.5.188.d: अथ यद् विदधाति सोत्तरा ततिस् । अग्न्याधेयं पूर्वा ततिः पुनराधेयम् उत्तरा ततिस् ।
24.5.188.m: Then what it enjoins [as modification] is the subsequent series: the agnyādheya is the prior series, the punarādheya the subsequent series;

24.5.188.s: darśapūrṇamāsāv iṣṭīnāṃ pūrvā tatiḥ sarvāḥ kāmyā iṣṭaya uttarā tatis |
24.5.188.d: दर्शपूर्णमासाव् इष्टीनां पूर्वा ततिः सर्वाः काम्या इष्टय उत्तरा ततिस् ।
24.5.188.m: the new and full moon rituals are the prior series of the optional offerings, all the optional offerings are the subsequent series;

24.5.188.s: aindrāgno nirūḍhapaśubandhānāṃ pūrvā tatiḥ sarve kāmyāḥ paśava uttarā tatis |
24.5.188.d: ऐन्द्राग्नो निरूढपशुबन्धानां पूर्वा ततिः सर्वे काम्याः पशव उत्तरा ततिस् ।
24.5.188.m: the offering to Indra and Agni is the prior series of the set animal sacrifices, all the optional animal sacrifices are the subsequent series;

24.5.188.s: jyotiṣṭomaḥ somānāṃ pūrvā tatiḥ sarve somā uttarā tatiḥ
24.5.188.d: ज्योतिष्टोमः सोमानां पूर्वा ततिः सर्वे सोमा उत्तरा ततिः
24.5.188.m: the jyotiṣṭoma is the prior series of the soma sacrifices, all the soma sacrifices are the subsequent series;

24.5.188.s: śyenacid agnīnāṃ pūrvā tatiḥ sarve kāmyā agnaya uttarā tatis |
24.5.188.d: श्येनचिद् अग्नीनां पूर्वा ततिः सर्वे काम्या अग्नय उत्तरा ततिस् ।
24.5.188.m: the falcon-piling is the prior series of the fire-altars, all the optional fire-altars are the subsequent series;

24.5.188.s: dvirātro 'hīnānāṃ pūrvā tatiḥ sarve 'hīnā uttarā tatis |
24.5.188.d: द्विरात्रो ऽहीनानां पूर्वा ततिः सर्वे ऽहीना उत्तरा ततिस् ।
24.5.188.m: the two-day rite is the prior series of the ahīnas, all the ahīnas are the subsequent series;

24.5.188.s: dvādaśāho 'hargaṇānāṃ pūrvā tatiḥ sarve 'hargaṇā uttarā tatis |
24.5.188.d: द्वादशाहो ऽहर्गणानां पूर्वा ततिः सर्वे ऽहर्गणा उत्तरा ततिस् ।
24.5.188.m: the twelve-day rite is the prior series of the day-groups, all the day-groups are the subsequent series;

24.5.188.s: gavāmayanam̐ sāṃvatsarikāṇām̐ sattrāṇāṃ pūrvā tatiḥ sarvāṇi sāṃvatsarikāṇi sattrāṇy uttarā tatiḥ
24.5.188.d: गवामयनँ सांवत्सरिकाणाँ सत्त्राणां पूर्वा ततिः सर्वाणि सांवत्सरिकाणि सत्त्राण्य् उत्तरा ततिः
24.5.188.m: the gavāmayana is the prior series of the year-long sacrificial sessions, all the year-long sacrificial sessions are the subsequent series.
How many gavāmayanas indeed are there?

24.5.188.s: vijñāyate yathaitan māsi pṛṣṭham uttame māsi sakṛt pṛṣṭhāny upeyur daśamāsyaṃ tṛtīyam |
24.5.188.d: विज्ञायते यथैतन् मासि पृष्ठम् उत्तमे मासि सकृत् पृष्ठान्य् उपेयुर् दशमास्यं तृतीयम् ।
24.5.188.m: It is known [from scripture]: "As here: a pṛṣṭha in each month, in the last month they should perform the pṛṣṭhas all at once; the ten-month [rite] is the third."

24.5.189.m: "Seven are the cultivated plants, seven the wild;

24.5.189.s: sapta grāmyāḥ paśavaḥ saptāraṇyāḥ sapta chandām̐si caturuttarāṇi | iti
24.5.189.d: सप्त ग्राम्याः पशवः सप्तारण्याः सप्त छन्दाँसि चतुरुत्तराणि । इति
24.5.189.m: seven are the domestic animals, seven the wild; seven are the metres increasing by four."

24.5.189.s: sapta grāmyā oṣadhayas tilamāṣavrīhiyavāḥ priyaṅgavo 'ṇavo godhūmāḥ saptame
24.5.189.d: सप्त ग्राम्या ओषधयस् तिलमाषव्रीहियवाः प्रियङ्गवो ऽणवो गोधूमाः सप्तमे
24.5.189.m: The seven cultivated plants: sesame, black gram, rice, barley, millet, panicum grains, and wheat as the seventh.

24.5.189.s: saptāraṇyāḥ śyāmākāś ca nīvārāś ca jartilāś ca gavīdhukāś ca gārmutāś ca vāstvāni ca veṇuyavāś ca saptame
24.5.189.d: सप्तारण्याः श्यामाकाश् च नीवाराश् च जर्तिलाश् च गवीधुकाश् च गार्मुताश् च वास्त्वानि च वेणुयवाश् च सप्तमे
24.5.189.m: The seven wild: śyāmāka, nīvāra, jartila, gavīdhukā, gārmuta, spinach, and bamboo grains as the seventh.

24.5.189.s: sapta grāmyāḥ paśavo goaśvam ajāvikaṃ puruṣaś ca gardabhaś coṣṭraś ca saptame |
24.5.189.d: सप्त ग्राम्याः पशवो गोअश्वम् अजाविकं पुरुषश् च गर्दभश् चोष्ट्रश् च सप्तमे ।
24.5.189.m: The seven domestic animals: cow, horse, goat, sheep, man, donkey, and camel as the seventh.

24.5.189.s: aśvataram u haike bruvate saptāraṇyā dvikhurāś ca śvāpadāni ca pakṣiṇaś ca sarīsṛpāṇi ca hastī ca markaṭaś ca nādeyā saptame
24.5.189.d: अश्वतरम् उ हैके ब्रुवते सप्तारण्या द्विखुराश् च श्वापदानि च पक्षिणश् च सरीसृपाणि च हस्ती च मर्कटश् च नादेया सप्तमे
24.5.189.m: Some mention the mule. The seven wild: cloven-hoofed animals, beasts of prey, birds, reptiles, the elephant, the monkey, and aquatic creatures as the seventh.

24.5.189.s: sapta chandām̐si caturuttarāṇīti gāyatry uṣṇig anuṣṭhub bṛhatī paṅktis triṣṭub jagatīti ||
24.5.189.d: सप्त छन्दाँसि चतुरुत्तराणीति गायत्र्य् उष्णिग् अनुष्ठुब् बृहती पङ्क्तिस् त्रिष्टुब् जगतीति ॥
24.5.189.m: "Seven are the metres increasing by four": gāyatrī, uṣṇih, anuṣṭubh, bṛhatī, paṅkti, triṣṭubh, and jagatī.

24.6.189.s: athedaṃ trayaṃ bhavati karmābhyāvarti devatābhyāvarti saṃkhyābhyāvartīti
24.6.189.d: अथेदं त्रयं भवति कर्माभ्यावर्ति देवताभ्यावर्ति संख्याभ्यावर्तीति
24.6.189.m: Now these three occur: recurring by action, recurring by deity, recurring by number.

24.6.189.s: sāvitraṃ nu khalv idaṃ karmābhyāvrti bhavati | atha devatābhyāvarti dhruvājyaṃ droṇakalaśaḥ sarvapṛṣṭheti |
24.6.189.d: सावित्रं नु खल्व् इदं कर्माभ्याव्र्ति भवति । अथ देवताभ्यावर्ति ध्रुवाज्यं द्रोणकलशः सर्वपृष्ठेति ।
24.6.189.m: This Savitar-formula indeed recurs by action; now, recurring by deity: the dhruvā butter, the droṇakalaśa trough, the sarvapṛṣṭhā rite;

24.6.189.s: atha saṃkhyābhyāvarti triḥ pṛcchati śṛtam̐ havī3ḥ śamitar iti |
24.6.189.d: अथ संख्याभ्यावर्ति त्रिः पृच्छति शृतँ हवी३ः शमितर् इति ।
24.6.189.m: now, recurring by number: three times he asks: "Is the oblation cooked, O slaughterer?"

24.6.189.s: athāpi rājño mānam | kva u khalu mantram antaritaṃ kalpayet
24.6.189.d: अथापि राज्ञो मानम् । क्व उ खलु मन्त्रम् अन्तरितं कल्पयेत्
24.6.189.m: Likewise, the measuring of King [Soma]. Where indeed should one adapt an interrupted mantra?

24.6.189.s: sthānād vā sthānaṃ prajijñāsītābhirūpyeṇa vā prauheṇa veti
24.6.189.d: स्थानाद् वा स्थानं प्रजिज्ञासीताभिरूप्येण वा प्रौहेण वेति
24.6.189.m: He should determine it either from place to place, or by suitability, or by adaptation.

24.6.189.s: sthānāt sthānam iti yad avocāma yo 'nantaro mantra āmnātaḥ syāt tenainam̐ saha kalpayet pūrvakālena vottarakālena veti
24.6.189.d: स्थानात् स्थानम् इति यद् अवोचाम यो ऽनन्तरो मन्त्र आम्नातः स्यात् तेनैनँ सह कल्पयेत् पूर्वकालेन वोत्तरकालेन वेति
24.6.189.m: As to what we said, 'from place to place': one should arrange it together with that mantra which is handed down immediately contiguous, whether earlier in time or later in time.

24.6.190.s: yatho etad ābhirūpyeṇeti yathaitad bhavati | āśāsānaḥ suvīryam̐ rāyaspoṣam̐ svaśviyam | bṛhaspatinā rāyā svagākṛto mahyaṃ yajamānāya tiṣṭha | iti
24.6.190.d: यथो एतद् आभिरूप्येणेति यथैतद् भवति । आशासानः सुवीर्यँ रायस्पोषँ स्वश्वियम् । बृहस्पतिना राया स्वगाकृतो मह्यं यजमानाय तिष्ठ । इति
24.6.190.m: Now as to what [was meant by] 'by conformity': as is the case with this: 'Hoping for good heroic sons, wealth, prosperity, and fine horses / Made pleasing by Bṛhaspati with wealth, stand for me, the sacrificer!'

24.6.190.s: yatho etat prauheṇety agnikalpaḥ khalv ayam iṣṭakābhūyān samāmnātas
24.6.190.d: यथो एतत् प्रौहेणेत्य् अग्निकल्पः खल्व् अयम् इष्टकाभूयान् समाम्नातस्
24.6.190.m: Now as to what [was meant by] 'by adaptation': this ritual of the fire-altar, indeed, is handed down as consisting predominantly of bricks.

24.6.190.s: tatra yo mantro 'ntaritaḥ syād iṣṭakābhūyam enam āpādayet ||
24.6.190.d: तत्र यो मन्त्रो ऽन्तरितः स्याद् इष्टकाभूयम् एनम् आपादयेत् ॥
24.6.190.m: In that case, whatever mantra has been omitted, he should make it conform to the predominance of bricks.

24.7.190.s: athāyam aśvamedha āhutibhūyān samāmnātas tatra yo mantro 'ntaritaḥ syād āhutibhūyam enam āpādayet |
24.7.190.d: अथायम् अश्वमेध आहुतिभूयान् समाम्नातस् तत्र यो मन्त्रो ऽन्तरितः स्याद् आहुतिभूयम् एनम् आपादयेत् ।
24.7.190.m: Then, this horse sacrifice is handed down as consisting predominantly of libations; in that case, whatever mantra has been omitted, he should make it conform to the predominance of libations.

24.7.190.s: nāprakrāntaṃ prakramayen na prakrāntaṃ krama tūṣṇīṃ karmaṇābhipūrayiṣed iti
24.7.190.d: नाप्रक्रान्तं प्रक्रमयेन् न प्रक्रान्तं क्रम तूष्णीं कर्मणाभिपूरयिषेद् इति
24.7.190.m: [Regarding the rule:] 'One should not begin what is not begun; what is begun one should not step over; one should fill it out silently with the ritual action.'

24.7.190.s: nāprakrāntam iti yad avocāma barhirlavanaḥ khalv ayam̐ hrasvo mantra āmnāto bhavati dīrghamu karma
24.7.190.d: नाप्रक्रान्तम् इति यद् अवोचाम बर्हिर्लवनः खल्व् अयँ ह्रस्वो मन्त्र आम्नातो भवति दीर्घमु कर्म
24.7.190.m: As to what we said, 'One should not [leave] unbegun': this mantra for cutting the sacrificial grass, indeed, is handed down as short, but the action is long.

24.7.190.s: na kramaṇo hetor mantro 'bhinivarteta | athāyaṃ paśor viśasano hrasvo mantra āmnāto bhavati dīrgham u karma
24.7.190.d: न क्रमणो हेतोर् मन्त्रो ऽभिनिवर्तेत । अथायं पशोर् विशसनो ह्रस्वो मन्त्र आम्नातो भवति दीर्घम् उ कर्म
24.7.190.m: The mantra should not be repeated for the sake of the pace [of the action]. Now, this mantra for cutting up the victim is handed down as short, but the action is long.
The mantra should not be repeated for the sake of the action.

24.7.190.s: athāsyām̐ svayamātṛṇṇāyāṃ dīrgho ha mantra āmnāto bhavati hrasvam u karma
24.7.190.d: अथास्याँ स्वयमातृण्णायां दीर्घो ह मन्त्र आम्नातो भवति ह्रस्वम् उ कर्म
24.7.190.m: Now, at this naturally perforated brick, a long mantra is handed down, but the action is short.
The mantra should not be broken off for the sake of the action.

24.7.190.s: yatho etat trir yajuṣā sakṛt tūṣṇīm iti lokāgnīm̐ś ca teṣām upaśrutya stambayajuś ceti
24.7.190.d: यथो एतत् त्रिर् यजुषा सकृत् तूष्णीम् इति लोकाग्नीँश् च तेषाम् उपश्रुत्य स्तम्बयजुश् चेति
24.7.190.m: Now as to what [was meant by] 'three times with a yajus, once silently': having learned this from them [regarding] the fires for the worlds and the stambayajus.

24.7.190.s: yatho etat pañcakṛtvo yajuṣā pañcakṛtvas tūṣṇīm iti rājñas teṣāṃ mānam upaśrutyeti
24.7.190.d: यथो एतत् पञ्चकृत्वो यजुषा पञ्चकृत्वस् तूष्णीम् इति राज्ञस् तेषां मानम् उपश्रुत्येति
24.7.190.m: Now as to what [was meant by] 'five times with a yajus, five times silently': having learned this from them [regarding] the measuring of the King [Soma].

24.7.191.s: yatho etat sakṛd yajuṣā sakṛt tūṣṇīm iti rājña eva teṣāṃ mānam upaśrutyeti
24.7.191.d: यथो एतत् सकृद् यजुषा सकृत् तूष्णीम् इति राज्ञ एव तेषां मानम् उपश्रुत्येति
24.7.191.m: Now as to what [was meant by] 'once with a yajus, once silently': having learned this from them [regarding] the measuring of the King [Soma] alone.

24.7.191.s: yatho etac caturo muṣṭīn vrīhīṇāṃ nirvapatīti dvau devatāyai sviṣṭakṛte tṛtīya iḍāyai caturtha iti sarva evaiteṣāṃ brāhmaṇavantaḥ ||
24.7.191.d: यथो एतच् चतुरो मुष्टीन् व्रीहीणां निर्वपतीति द्वौ देवतायै स्विष्टकृते तृतीय इडायै चतुर्थ इति सर्व एवैतेषां ब्राह्मणवन्तः ॥
24.7.191.m: Now as to what [was meant by] 'He measures out four handfuls of rice: two for the deity, the third for the Sviṣṭakṛt, the fourth for the iḍā'—all these indeed possess a brāhmaṇa passage.

24.8.191.m: Now, therefore, we shall explain the actions governed by specific designation. When the fire is not specified:

24.8.191.s: api tu yathaitad bhavati | adhidevane juhoti rathamukhe juhoti rathanāḍyāṃ juhoti catuṣpathe juhoti vartmanor juhoti | āvraścane juhoti pade juhoti | ajāyāṃ juhoti | ajasya dakṣiṇe karṇe juhoti | ajasya dakṣiṇe śṛṅge juhoti brāhmaṇasya dakṣiṇe haste juhoti darbhastambe juhoti | apsu juhoti | audumbaryāṃ juhoti valmīkavapāyāṃ juhoti | aupāsane juhoti | uttapanīye juhoti śāmitre juhoti | āgnīdhrīye juhoti | anvāhāryapacane juhoti gārhapatye juhoti | iti |
24.8.191.d: अपि तु यथैतद् भवति । अधिदेवने जुहोति रथमुखे जुहोति रथनाड्यां जुहोति चतुष्पथे जुहोति वर्त्मनोर् जुहोति । आव्रश्चने जुहोति पदे जुहोति । अजायां जुहोति । अजस्य दक्षिणे कर्णे जुहोति । अजस्य दक्षिणे शृङ्गे जुहोति ब्राह्मणस्य दक्षिणे हस्ते जुहोति दर्भस्तम्बे जुहोति । अप्सु जुहोति । औदुम्बर्यां जुहोति वल्मीकवपायां जुहोति । औपासने जुहोति । उत्तपनीये जुहोति शामित्रे जुहोति । आग्नीध्रीये जुहोति । अन्वाहार्यपचने जुहोति गार्हपत्ये जुहोति । इति ।
24.8.191.m: However, as is the case with this: 'He offers on the gaming place,' 'He offers at the front of the chariot,' 'He offers in the chariot's nave,' 'He offers at the crossway,' 'He offers in the two ruts,' 'He offers at the place of hewing,' 'He offers at the footprint,' 'He offers on the she-goat,' 'He offers into the right ear of the he-goat,' 'He offers on the right horn of the he-goat,' 'He offers in the right hand of the brāhmaṇa,' 'He offers on the clump of darbha grass,' 'He offers in the waters,' 'He offers on the audumbarī pillar,' 'He offers on the anthill-mound,' 'He offers on the domestic fire,' 'He offers on the heating fire,' 'He offers on the slaughtering hearth,' 'He offers on the āgnīdhrīya fire,' 'He offers on the anvāhāryapacana fire,' 'He offers on the gārhapatya fire.'
When not specified, the offering must be made in the āhavanīya fire alone.

24.8.191.s: anādiṣṭo 'dhvaryus | api tu yathaitad bhavati | unnetā juhoti pratiprasthātā juhoti | iti |
24.8.191.d: अनादिष्टो ऽध्वर्युस् । अपि तु यथैतद् भवति । उन्नेता जुहोति प्रतिप्रस्थाता जुहोति । इति ।
24.8.191.m: When the adhvaryu is not specified: however, as is the case with this: 'The unnetṛ priest offers,' 'The pratiprasthātṛ priest offers.'
When not specified, the offering must be made by the adhvaryu priest alone.

24.8.191.s: anādiṣṭaṃ pātram api tu yathaitad bhavati | añjalinā juhoti śūrpeṇa juhoti kṛṣṇājinapuṭena juhoti madhyamena parṇena juhoti | antamena parṇena juhoti | arkaparṇena juhoti parṇamayena sruveṇa juhoti | audumbareṇa sruveṇa juhoti | aṅguṣṭhābhyāṃ juhoti visram̐sikākāṇḍābhyāṃ juhoti gomṛgakaṇṭhena juhoti | aśvaśaphena juhoti | ayasmayena kamaṇḍalunā juhoti | iti |
24.8.191.d: अनादिष्टं पात्रम् अपि तु यथैतद् भवति । अञ्जलिना जुहोति शूर्पेण जुहोति कृष्णाजिनपुटेन जुहोति मध्यमेन पर्णेन जुहोति । अन्तमेन पर्णेन जुहोति । अर्कपर्णेन जुहोति पर्णमयेन स्रुवेण जुहोति । औदुम्बरेण स्रुवेण जुहोति । अङ्गुष्ठाभ्यां जुहोति विस्रँसिकाकाण्डाभ्यां जुहोति गोमृगकण्ठेन जुहोति । अश्वशफेन जुहोति । अयस्मयेन कमण्डलुना जुहोति । इति ।
24.8.191.m: [When] the vessel is unspecified—but as in these cases: "he offers with the folded hands," "he offers with the winnowing basket," "he offers with a fold of the black antelope skin," "he offers with the middle leaf," "he offers with the outermost leaf," "he offers with an arka leaf," "he offers with a ladle made of palāśa wood," "he offers with a ladle made of udumbara wood," "he offers with both thumbs," "he offers with two shoots of visraṃsikā," "he offers with the neck of a wild bovine," "he offers with a horse's hoof," "he offers with an iron pitcher"—

24.8.192.m: when unspecified, the offering must be made with the ladle only. [When] the kindling stick is unspecified—

24.8.192.s: ādeśād eva samidhaṃ jānīyāt | vijñāyate nāsamitke juhuyād yad asamitke juhuyād yathājihve 'nnaṃ dadyāt tādṛk tat
24.8.192.d: आदेशाद् एव समिधं जानीयात् । विज्ञायते नासमित्के जुहुयाद् यद् असमित्के जुहुयाद् यथाजिह्वे ऽन्नं दद्यात् तादृक् तत्
24.8.192.m: he should know the kindling stick only from specific instruction. It is taught: "He should not offer without a kindling stick; if he should offer without a kindling stick, that would be like giving food to one without a tongue."
Therefore, the offering must be made only [on a fire] having a kindling stick.
When unspecified, the offering must be made only after placing [a kindling stick on the fire].

24.9.192.s: athāto 'vadānakalpas | catur unnayati caturavattaṃ bhavatīti | anādiṣṭa upahatyaiva hotavyam
24.9.192.d: अथातो ऽवदानकल्पस् । चतुर् उन्नयति चतुरवत्तं भवतीति । अनादिष्ट उपहत्यैव होतव्यम्
24.9.192.m: Now then, the rule of portioning: "He scoops four times, it becomes a four-cut portion"—when unspecified, the offering must be made only after scooping up [from the oblation].

24.9.192.s: anādiṣṭam̐ havis | ādeśād evānyad vrīhiyavebhyo jānīyāt |
24.9.192.d: अनादिष्टँ हविस् । आदेशाद् एवान्यद् व्रीहियवेभ्यो जानीयात् ।
24.9.192.m: [When] the oblation is unspecified, he should know anything other than rice and barley only from specific instruction.

24.9.192.s: api tu nu khalu kṣiprasam̐skāratamam ājyaṃ bruvate |
24.9.192.d: अपि तु नु खलु क्षिप्रसँस्कारतमम् आज्यं ब्रुवते ।
24.9.192.m: However, they indeed declare clarified butter to be the most quickly prepared.

24.9.192.s: anādiṣṭaḥ paśus | ādeśād evānyam ajāj jānīyād aindrāgnāt |
24.9.192.d: अनादिष्टः पशुस् । आदेशाद् एवान्यम् अजाज् जानीयाद् ऐन्द्राग्नात् ।
24.9.192.m: [When] the sacrificial animal is unspecified, he should know an animal other than a goat sacred to Indra-Agni only from specific instruction.

24.9.192.s: yad abhihāraṃ tantram̐ syāt tad abhihāraṃ kuryāt | agnyabhihārau darśapūrṇamāsau
24.9.192.d: यद् अभिहारं तन्त्रँ स्यात् तद् अभिहारं कुर्यात् । अग्न्यभिहारौ दर्शपूर्णमासौ
24.9.192.m: Whatever procedure has a primary ritual act, he should perform that primary act: the new- and full-moon rituals have Agni as their primary act;

24.9.192.s: soma indrābhihāraḥ sāvitram auṣadhasya nirvapaṇaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ bhavati
24.9.192.d: सोम इन्द्राभिहारः सावित्रम् औषधस्य निर्वपणं दृष्टं भवति
24.9.192.m: soma has Indra as its primary act. The measuring out of the plant oblation is seen to be dedicated to Savitar.

24.9.192.s: kim̐ svit sāṃnāyyasya paśo rājña iti dohanam̐ sāṃnāyyasya |
24.9.192.d: किँ स्वित् सांनाय्यस्य पशो राज्ञ इति दोहनँ सांनाय्यस्य ।
24.9.192.m: What is it for the curd-and-milk oblation, for the sacrificial animal, and for the king [Soma]? The milking for the curd-and-milk oblation,

24.9.192.s: upākaraṇaṃ paśos | yad upām̐śusavanam abhi mimīte tad rājñaḥ
24.9.192.d: उपाकरणं पशोस् । यद् उपाँशुसवनम् अभि मिमीते तद् राज्ञः
24.9.192.m: the dedication for the animal, and that he measures towards the upāṃśusavana stone for the king [Soma].

24.9.192.s: prajñātam anyeṣām̐ haviṣāṃ paryagnikaraṇam | kim̐ svid rājña iti
24.9.192.d: प्रज्ञातम् अन्येषाँ हविषां पर्यग्निकरणम् । किँ स्विद् राज्ञ इति
24.9.192.m: The carrying of fire around the other oblations is well known; what is it for the king [Soma]?

24.9.192.s: yad evādo vasatīvarīḥ pariharati tad rājña iti ||
24.9.192.d: यद् एवादो वसतीवरीः परिहरति तद् राज्ञ इति ॥
24.9.192.m: That he carries around the vasatīvarī waters over there, that is [the corresponding act] for the king [Soma].

24.10.193.m: Now then, we shall explain the sacrificial cakes.

24.10.193.s: sarva evaindrāgnā ekādaśakapālā anyatrāgrayaṇāc ca śunāsīrīyāc ca
24.10.193.d: सर्व एवैन्द्राग्ना एकादशकपाला अन्यत्राग्रयणाच् च शुनासीरीयाच् च
24.10.193.m: All cakes dedicated to Indra-Agni are on eleven potsherds, except for the first-fruits ritual and the śunāsīrīya ritual.
All cakes dedicated to Indra are on eleven potsherds, except for the śunāsīrīya ritual.
All cakes dedicated to Agni-Soma are on eleven potsherds, except for the one made of wild millet.

24.10.193.s: sarva eva paśupuroḍāśā ekādaśakapālā anyatra vāyavyāt |
24.10.193.d: सर्व एव पशुपुरोडाशा एकादशकपाला अन्यत्र वायव्यात् ।
24.10.193.m: All animal-cake offerings are on eleven potsherds, except the one dedicated to Vāyu.

24.10.193.s: yaddevatyaḥ paśus taddevatyaḥ paśupuroḍāśo 'nyatra vāyavyād bhavati
24.10.193.d: यद्देवत्यः पशुस् तद्देवत्यः पशुपुरोडाशो ऽन्यत्र वायव्याद् भवति
24.10.193.m: Whatever deity the animal belongs to, that deity the animal cake belongs to, except the one dedicated to Vāyu.
All cakes dedicated to Agni-Viṣṇu are on eleven potsherds, except for the adhvarakalpā ritual.

24.10.193.s: tatraivāṣṭākapālaś ca dvādaśakapālaś ca bhavataḥ sarva eva sāvitrā dvādaśakapālā anyatrāśvamedhikebhyas
24.10.193.d: तत्रैवाष्टाकपालश् च द्वादशकपालश् च भवतः सर्व एव सावित्रा द्वादशकपाला अन्यत्राश्वमेधिकेभ्यस्
24.10.193.m: There indeed occur one on eight potsherds and one on twelve potsherds. All cakes dedicated to Savitar are on twelve potsherds, except for those belonging to the horse sacrifice.

24.10.193.s: tatraivāṣṭākapālaś caikādaśakapālaś ca bhavataḥ sāvitro 'ṣṭākapālas | iti ca
24.10.193.d: तत्रैवाष्टाकपालश् चैकादशकपालश् च भवतः सावित्रो ऽष्टाकपालस् । इति च
24.10.193.m: There indeed occur one on eight potsherds and one on eleven potsherds, and [the text says]: "The cake to Savitar is on eight potsherds."

24.10.193.s: sarva eva mārutāḥ saptakapālā anyatrāśvamedhikānāṃ cāturmāsyapaśūnāṃ paśupuroḍāśebhyo mārutāc caikavim̐śatikapālād anyatra rājasūyikāt pañcaśāradīyānāṃ ca paśūnāṃ paśupuroḍāśebhyaḥ
24.10.193.d: सर्व एव मारुताः सप्तकपाला अन्यत्राश्वमेधिकानां चातुर्मास्यपशूनां पशुपुरोडाशेभ्यो मारुताच् चैकविँशतिकपालाद् अन्यत्र राजसूयिकात् पञ्चशारदीयानां च पशूनां पशुपुरोडाशेभ्यः
24.10.193.m: All cakes dedicated to the Maruts are on seven potsherds, except for the animal cakes of the four-month seasonal animals of the horse sacrifice, and the twenty-one-potsherd cake to the Maruts, and except for that belonging to the rājasūya, and the animal cakes of the five-autumn animals.

24.10.193.s: kim anukhyāni nu khalu te vilekhyāni kapālāni bhavantīti
24.10.193.d: किम् अनुख्यानि नु खलु ते विलेख्यानि कपालानि भवन्तीति
24.10.193.m: Now, are the potsherds to be demarcated according to the visible [model]?

24.10.193.s: vijñāyate vaiśvānaraṃ dvādaśakapālaṃ mṛgākhare bhūmikapālaṃ nirvapet | ity etad anukhyāni bhavantīti |
24.10.193.d: विज्ञायते वैश्वानरं द्वादशकपालं मृगाखरे भूमिकपालं निर्वपेत् । इत्य् एतद् अनुख्यानि भवन्तीति ।
24.10.193.m: It is taught: "He should measure out a cake to Vaiśvānara on twelve potsherds on the lair of a wild animal, [or] on earth-potsherds." Thus these are demarcated according to the visible [model].

24.10.193.s: atha pūrvasam̐sthāḥ pañcaprayājasya navaprayājasyaikādaśaprayājasyeti prayājāḥ pūrvasam̐sthāḥ
24.10.193.d: अथ पूर्वसँस्थाः पञ्चप्रयाजस्य नवप्रयाजस्यैकादशप्रयाजस्येति प्रयाजाः पूर्वसँस्थाः
24.10.193.m: Now, the preliminary conclusions: for a ritual with five fore-offerings, with nine fore-offerings, and with eleven fore-offerings—the fore-offerings are the preliminary conclusions.

24.10.194.m: The carrying of fire around the animal, the upāṃśu pressing in the agniṣṭoma, and the twenty-fourth day in the gavāmayana ritual—

24.10.194.s: tad api vijñāyate tasya trīṇi ca śatāni ṣaṣṭiś ca stotrīyās
24.10.194.d: तद् अपि विज्ञायते तस्य त्रीणि च शतानि षष्टिश् च स्तोत्रीयास्
24.10.194.m: and it is also taught concerning this: "It has three hundred and sixty chant-verses;
so many are the nights of a year."

24.11.194.s: atha rājayajñās | rājasūyo 'śvamedhaḥ puruṣamedhaḥ sarvamedhaḥ somasavaḥ pṛthisavo mṛtyusavaḥ kānāndhayajñaḥ śunaskarṇayajña iti ca |
24.11.194.d: अथ राजयज्ञास् । राजसूयो ऽश्वमेधः पुरुषमेधः सर्वमेधः सोमसवः पृथिसवो मृत्युसवः कानान्धयज्ञः शुनस्कर्णयज्ञ इति च ।
24.11.194.m: Now the royal sacrifices: the rājasūya, the aśvamedha, the puruṣamedha, the sarvamedha, the somasava, the pṛthisava, the mṛtyusava, the kānāndhayajña, and the śunaskarṇayajña.

24.11.194.s: athāditidevatās | agnyādheye tv eva prathamaś carus | cāturmāsyeṣu dvitīyaḥ
24.11.194.d: अथादितिदेवतास् । अग्न्याधेये त्व् एव प्रथमश् चरुस् । चातुर्मास्येषु द्वितीयः
24.11.194.m: Now, [the offerings] dedicated to Aditi: in the establishment of the sacred fires, however, is the first pap; the second is in the four-month seasonal sacrifices;

24.11.194.s: prāyaṇīyodayanīyayor agnidīkṣaṇīyāyām | trayo rājasūye ratnimāneṣu ca prāyujeṣu cādityāṃ malhāṃ garbhiṇīm ālabhata iti ca |
24.11.194.d: प्रायणीयोदयनीययोर् अग्निदीक्षणीयायाम् । त्रयो राजसूये रत्निमानेषु च प्रायुजेषु चादित्यां मल्हां गर्भिणीम् आलभत इति च ।
24.11.194.m: in the opening and concluding offerings, and in the agnidīkṣaṇīyā offering; three in the rājasūya, and in the ratnimāna and prāyuj offerings: and [the text says] "he seizes a pregnant cow with neck-warts for Aditi";

24.11.194.s: eka iṣṭikalas | eko vrātyastome catvāro 'śvamedhe 'dityai viṣṇupatnyai carur adityai ham̐sasācir adityai trayo rohitaitāstisro meṣya ādityās |
24.11.194.d: एक इष्टिकलस् । एको व्रात्यस्तोमे चत्वारो ऽश्वमेधे ऽदित्यै विष्णुपत्न्यै चरुर् अदित्यै हँससाचिर् अदित्यै त्रयो रोहितैतास्तिस्रो मेष्य आदित्यास् ।
24.11.194.m: one in the iṣṭikāla; one in the vrātyastoma; four in the aśvamedha: a pap for Aditi the wife of Viṣṇu, a swan-sāci for Aditi, three red-speckled ones for Aditi, three ewes for Aditi;
two in the sautrāmaṇī: a barren sheep for Aditi,

24.11.194.s: graho 'ṣṭādaśa iti ca trīṇi tantrāṇi yajñam anvāyattāni bhavanti pañcaprayājaṃ navaprayājam ekādaśaprayājam iti
24.11.194.d: ग्रहो ऽष्टादश इति च त्रीणि तन्त्राणि यज्ञम् अन्वायत्तानि भवन्ति पञ्चप्रयाजं नवप्रयाजम् एकादशप्रयाजम् इति
24.11.194.m: and the eighteenth cup. Three procedures accompany the sacrifice: that with five fore-offerings, that with nine fore-offerings, and that with eleven fore-offerings.

24.11.194.s: pañcaprayājena darśapūrṇamāsau kāmyā iṣṭaya iti vartante navaprayājena cāturmāsyāni |
24.11.194.d: पञ्चप्रयाजेन दर्शपूर्णमासौ काम्या इष्टय इति वर्तन्ते नवप्रयाजेन चातुर्मास्यानि ।
24.11.194.m: The new- and full-moon rituals and the optional wish-granting rites proceed with five fore-offerings; the four-month seasonal rituals with nine fore-offerings;

24.11.194.s: ekādaśaprayājena paśuḥ soma iti ṣaḍ imāni sarvakalpe sarvābhiprāyikāṇi bhavanti
24.11.194.d: एकादशप्रयाजेन पशुः सोम इति षड् इमानि सर्वकल्पे सर्वाभिप्रायिकाणि भवन्ति
24.11.194.m: the animal sacrifice and the soma sacrifice with eleven fore-offerings. In the comprehensive ritual manual, these six serve all intentions,

24.11.194.s: yathaitad agnyādheyam agnihotraṃ darśapūrṇamāsau cāturmāsyāni paśuḥ soma iti
24.11.194.d: यथैतद् अग्न्याधेयम् अग्निहोत्रं दर्शपूर्णमासौ चातुर्मास्यानि पशुः सोम इति
24.11.194.m: namely: the establishment of the fires, the agnihotra, the new- and full-moon rituals, the four-month seasonal rituals, the animal sacrifice, and the soma sacrifice.

24.11.195.s: tad api vijñāyate 'tha yad asyāgnim uddharati sahasraṃ tena kāmadughā avarunddhe |
24.11.195.d: तद् अपि विज्ञायते ऽथ यद् अस्याग्निम् उद्धरति सहस्रं तेन कामदुघा अवरुन्द्धे ।
24.11.195.m: And concerning this it is also taught: "Now, when he brings out his fire, he thereby secures a thousand wish-granting cows;

24.11.195.s: atha yad agnihotraṃ juhoti sahasraṃ tenaiṣā vai vaiśvadevasya mātrā |
24.11.195.d: अथ यद् अग्निहोत्रं जुहोति सहस्रं तेनैषा वै वैश्वदेवस्य मात्रा ।
24.11.195.m: now, when he offers the agnihotra, thereby [he secures] a thousand; this indeed is the measure of the vaiśvadeva [offering];

24.11.195.s: etad vā eteṣām avamam ato'to vā uttarāṇi śreyām̐si bhavanti
24.11.195.d: एतद् वा एतेषाम् अवमम् अतोऽतो वा उत्तराणि श्रेयाँसि भवन्ति
24.11.195.m: This indeed is the lowest among these; from this point on, subsequent ones are superior.

24.11.195.s: sarvān lokān paśubandhayājy abhijayati | ekasmai vai kāmāyānye yajñakratava ālabhyante
24.11.195.d: सर्वान् लोकान् पशुबन्धयाज्य् अभिजयति । एकस्मै वै कामायान्ये यज्ञक्रतव आलभ्यन्ते
24.11.195.m: The sacrificer of an animal sacrifice wins all worlds. For a single desire indeed are other sacrificial rites undertaken;
the animal sacrifice and soma sacrifice are for all desires.

24.12.195.s: agnīn ādhāsyamānaḥ prajyamātmānaṃ kurvīta yenāsyākuśalam̐ sthāt tena kuśalaṃ kurvīta
24.12.195.d: अग्नीन् आधास्यमानः प्रज्यमात्मानं कुर्वीत येनास्याकुशलँ स्थात् तेन कुशलं कुर्वीत
24.12.195.m: One about to establish the sacred fires should make himself free from obligation. In whatever respect there would be fault for him, in that respect he should make it good.

24.12.195.s: yāny ṛṇāny utthitakālāni syus tāni vyavahared anujñāpayīta vā |
24.12.195.d: यान्य् ऋणान्य् उत्थितकालानि स्युस् तानि व्यवहरेद् अनुज्ञापयीत वा ।
24.12.195.m: Whatever debts have reached their due time, he should discharge them or obtain consent [for postponement].

24.12.195.s: athāpy agnyādheya evartvijāṃ varaṇaṃ prathamam udāharāmas
24.12.195.d: अथाप्य् अग्न्याधेय एवर्त्विजां वरणं प्रथमम् उदाहरामस्
24.12.195.m: Moreover, in the establishment of the sacred fires itself we mention the first selection of officiating priests.

24.12.195.s: tasya cet pūrvapuruṣair vṛtāḥ syus tān eva nātivṛṇītāvyavacchinnāś cet kaulenādhyayanena mānuṣeṇa śīlavṛttābhyām̐ syur iti
24.12.195.d: तस्य चेत् पूर्वपुरुषैर् वृताः स्युस् तान् एव नातिवृणीताव्यवच्छिन्नाश् चेत् कौलेनाध्ययनेन मानुषेण शीलवृत्ताभ्याँ स्युर् इति
24.12.195.m: If [certain priests] were chosen by his ancestors, he should not pass them over, provided they are unbroken [in succession] by family lineage, Vedic study, human repute, and moral conduct.

24.12.195.s: kiṃgata u khalv ativaraṇaṃ vāvaraṇaṃ vā bhavatīti steyamacārīdabhyamam̐sthādayājyamayājayatsāditaṃ karma tad u hāsthita ity eteṣām ekasminn ativaraṇaṃ vāvaraṇaṃ vā bhavatīti
24.12.195.d: किंगत उ खल्व् अतिवरणं वावरणं वा भवतीति स्तेयमचारीदभ्यमँस्थादयाज्यमयाजयत्सादितं कर्म तद् उ हास्थित इत्य् एतेषाम् एकस्मिन्न् अतिवरणं वावरणं वा भवतीति
24.12.195.m: On what grounds, indeed, does passing over or selection occur? "He committed theft, he defamed, he officiated for one unfit to sacrifice, he abandoned an undertaking commenced"—on any one of these [grounds], passing over or selection occurs.

24.12.196.m: If he chooses them, he should choose only those with unimpaired limbs.

24.12.196.s: kaṃ nu khalv eṣāṃ prathamaṃ vṛṇīta
24.12.196.d: कं नु खल्व् एषां प्रथमं वृणीत
24.12.196.m: Whom, indeed, among these should he choose first?

24.12.196.s: yo 'sya sam̐stutatamaḥ syāt taṃ prathamaṃ vṛṇīta
24.12.196.d: यो ऽस्य सँस्तुततमः स्यात् तं प्रथमं वृणीत
24.12.196.m: Whichever priest is most commended to him, that one he should choose first.

24.12.196.s: tena sacivenānyān lipseta yadyu vai yathājyeṣṭhaṃ brahmāṇaṃ prathamaṃ vṛṇītātha hotāram athodgātāram athādhvaryum |
24.12.196.d: तेन सचिवेनान्यान् लिप्सेत यद्यु वै यथाज्येष्ठं ब्रह्माणं प्रथमं वृणीताथ होतारम् अथोद्गातारम् अथाध्वर्युम् ।
24.12.196.m: With him as an assistant, he should seek to obtain the others. Or, if [he chooses] according to seniority of rank: he should choose the brahman priest first, then the hotṛ priest, then the udgātṛ priest, then the adhvaryu priest;
or the adhvaryu priest immediately after the brahman priest.

24.12.196.s: pūrvaṃ vottaraṃ vā yathākarma cet syāt sṛṣṭena dhanenartvijaḥ pratisaṃvasīta
24.12.196.d: पूर्वं वोत्तरं वा यथाकर्म चेत् स्यात् सृष्टेन धनेनर्त्विजः प्रतिसंवसीत
24.12.196.m: [The order should be] earlier or later, if it is in accordance with the rite. / With given wealth, he should dwell together with the officiating priests.

24.12.196.s: trīṇy adhikaraṇāny ṛtvijāṃ vināpi yakṣye 'jyāśiṣi bhāryām akṛṣīti
24.12.196.d: त्रीण्य् अधिकरणान्य् ऋत्विजां विनापि यक्ष्ये ऽज्याशिषि भार्याम् अकृषीति
24.12.196.m: There are three occasions for [inviting] officiating priests: 'Even without [inviting previously] I shall sacrifice', 'I have made my wife pregnant with a blessing for wealth', [or 'I have taken a wife'].

24.12.197.s: ko nu khalv ṛtvikṣu dharma iti
24.12.197.d: को नु खल्व् ऋत्विक्षु धर्म इति
24.12.197.m: "Now, what indeed is the rule of conduct towards officiating priests?"

24.12.197.s: ya ācārya iti katham arhaṇa iti ||
24.12.197.d: य आचार्य इति कथम् अर्हण इति ॥
24.12.197.m: "That which pertains to a teacher." / "How is the honoring [to be done]?"

24.13.197.s: āgamaāgama ity ekam ṛtumukhaṛtumukha ity ekam | saṃvatsarasya pāra ity ekam |
24.13.197.d: आगमआगम इत्य् एकम् ऋतुमुखऋतुमुख इत्य् एकम् । संवत्सरस्य पार इत्य् एकम् ।
24.13.197.m: "At every arrival [of a teacher]", is one [view]; / "at the beginning of every season", is one [view]; / "at the end of a year", is one [view];

24.13.197.s: yajñādhigama ity etad aparam | ko nu khalv ṛtvijāṃ dharma iti
24.13.197.d: यज्ञाधिगम इत्य् एतद् अपरम् । को नु खल्व् ऋत्विजां धर्म इति
24.13.197.m: "upon the acquisition of a sacrifice", is another [view]. / "Now, what indeed is the duty of officiating priests?"

24.13.197.s: na nyastam ārtvijyaṃ kuryāt | nānudhyātam | nāvakrīto yājayet |
24.13.197.d: न न्यस्तम् आर्त्विज्यं कुर्यात् । नानुध्यातम् । नावक्रीतो याजयेत् ।
24.13.197.m: He should not perform an officiating priesthood that has been abandoned [by another]. / Nor one that has been coveted [from another]. / Hired [by money], he should not officiate at a sacrifice.

24.13.197.s: nāvṛto yājayet | nātivṛto yājayet | nānūddeśyaṃ yājayet | na nītadakṣiṇaṃ yājayet |
24.13.197.d: नावृतो याजयेत् । नातिवृतो याजयेत् । नानूद्देश्यं याजयेत् । न नीतदक्षिणं याजयेत् ।
24.13.197.m: Unchosen, he should not officiate at a sacrifice. / Chosen in place of another [already chosen], he should not officiate at a sacrifice. / He should not officiate at a sacrifice intended for someone else. / He should not officiate at a sacrifice where the priestly fee has been led away [beforehand].

24.13.197.s: nāparapakṣe yājayet | nārtaṃ yājayet | na mṛtaṃ yājayet |
24.13.197.d: नापरपक्षे याजयेत् । नार्तं याजयेत् । न मृतं याजयेत् ।
24.13.197.m: He should not officiate at a sacrifice during the dark fortnight. / He should not officiate at a sacrifice for a sick person. / He should not officiate at a sacrifice for a dead person.

24.13.197.s: na trikiṇinaṃ yājayet | na parikhātikrāntaṃ yājayet | nāntagaṃ yājayet |
24.13.197.d: न त्रिकिणिनं याजयेत् । न परिखातिक्रान्तं याजयेत् । नान्तगं याजयेत् ।
24.13.197.m: He should not officiate at a sacrifice for one who has three scars. / He should not officiate at a sacrifice for one who has transgressed a boundary ditch. / He should not officiate at a sacrifice for an outcaste.

24.13.198.s: nāntyajaṃ yājayet | nānanūcānaṃ yājayet | api vaiteṣāṃ taṃ yājayedyaḥ kapālāny upahanyād vṛttiprekṣe vartamāne
24.13.198.d: नान्त्यजं याजयेत् । नाननूचानं याजयेत् । अपि वैतेषां तं याजयेद्यः कपालान्य् उपहन्याद् वृत्तिप्रेक्षे वर्तमाने
24.13.198.m: He should not officiate at a sacrifice for a low-caste person. / He should not officiate at a sacrifice for one who is not learned. / Or rather, among these, he may officiate at a sacrifice for one who might strike [his begging] bowls, when one who looks for a livelihood is present.

24.13.198.s: tad api dāśataye vijñāyate | avartyā śuna āntrāṇi pece na deveṣu vivide marḍitāram | apaśyaṃ jāyām amahīyamānām adhā me śyeno madhv ājabhāra | iti
24.13.198.d: तद् अपि दाशतये विज्ञायते । अवर्त्या शुन आन्त्राणि पेचे न देवेषु विविदे मर्डितारम् । अपश्यं जायाम् अमहीयमानाम् अधा मे श्येनो मध्व् आजभार । इति
24.13.198.m: That is also understood from the Ṛgveda: "In my distress I cooked a dog's entrails; among the gods I found no consoler; I saw my wife unhonored; then the falcon brought me the honey."
"Among these, one who gives a thousand [cows as] priestly fee is not ineligible for sacrifice."

24.14.198.s: ūṣāś ca sikatāś ceti ye bhasmarā ivoṣāḥ syus tān āhārayet |
24.14.198.d: ऊषाश् च सिकताश् चेति ये भस्मरा इवोषाः स्युस् तान् आहारयेत् ।
24.14.198.m: Regarding: "Saline earth and sand": / Whatever saline earth is like ashes, that he should have brought.

24.14.198.s: āraṇyasya varāhasya vihatād āhārayet | āraṇyasyākhor utkarād āhārayet |
24.14.198.d: आरण्यस्य वराहस्य विहताद् आहारयेत् । आरण्यस्याखोर् उत्कराद् आहारयेत् ।
24.14.198.m: He should have it brought from [earth] dug up by a wild boar. / He should have it brought from a molehill thrown up by a wild rat.

24.14.198.s: yo 'nupadāsī sūdaḥ syāt tata āhārayet sūde 'vidyamāne kulīrasuṣirād āhārayet |
24.14.198.d: यो ऽनुपदासी सूदः स्यात् तत आहारयेत् सूदे ऽविद्यमाने कुलीरसुषिराद् आहारयेत् ।
24.14.198.m: Whatever pool is never dry, from there he should have it brought. / If no pool is available, he should have it brought from a crab's hole.

24.14.198.d: अशनिहते ऽविद्यमाने शीतहतम् आहारयेद् वातहतं वा
24.14.198.m: If [wood] struck by lightning is not available, he should have [wood] struck by cold brought, or struck by wind.

24.14.198.s: citriyasyāśvatthasyeti yena grāmo vā nagaraṃ vā nadī vā tīrthaṃ vā jñāyate tata āhārayet |
24.14.198.d: चित्रियस्याश्वत्थस्येति येन ग्रामो वा नगरं वा नदी वा तीर्थं वा ज्ञायते तत आहारयेत् ।
24.14.198.m: Regarding: "Of an aśvattha tree having special marks": / By which a village, a town, a river, or a holy bathing place is known, from that [tree] he should have it brought.

24.14.198.s: yuvānam ity evedam uktaṃ bhavati trīn hiraṇyaśalkān iti
24.14.198.d: युवानम् इत्य् एवेदम् उक्तं भवति त्रीन् हिरण्यशल्कान् इति
24.14.198.m: "A young horse" is what is meant by this. / Regarding: "Three pieces of gold":

24.14.198.s: ṣaḍ imān kārayet sauvarṇā upāsanārthā rājatā atipradānārthās |
24.14.198.d: षड् इमान् कारयेत् सौवर्णा उपासनार्था राजता अतिप्रदानार्थास् ।
24.14.198.m: He should cause these six to be made: / the golden ones are for the worship; the silver ones are for the giving away.

24.14.199.m: Regarding: "Both are adorned with human ornament, wearing unwashed garments":

24.14.199.s: sarva evānyo mānuṣo 'laṅkāro 'nyatra naladāt | ārtāyaivaitad udāharanti
24.14.199.d: सर्व एवान्यो मानुषो ऽलङ्कारो ऽन्यत्र नलदात् । आर्तायैवैतद् उदाहरन्ति
24.14.199.m: Every other human ornament [is allowed] except spikenard. / They cite this only for one who is suffering.

24.15.199.s: tāḥ saṃvatsare purastād ādadhyād iti tryahe ṣaḍahe dvādaśāhe vā
24.15.199.d: ताः संवत्सरे पुरस्ताद् आदध्याद् इति त्र्यहे षडहे द्वादशाहे वा
24.15.199.m: Regarding: "He should set them up a year before": / on three days, on six days, or on twelve days.

24.15.199.s: saṃvatsare 'paryaveta udvāyati kathaṃ tatra kuryād iti punar eva brahmaudanam̐ samutthāpayed ā samidhām abhyādhānāt |
24.15.199.d: संवत्सरे ऽपर्यवेत उद्वायति कथं तत्र कुर्याद् इति पुनर् एव ब्रह्मौदनँ समुत्थापयेद् आ समिधाम् अभ्याधानात् ।
24.15.199.m: "If [the fire] goes out when a year has not elapsed, what should he do then?" / He should again prepare the brahmaudana porridge up to the putting on of the kindling sticks.
He should not have his hair and beard shaved.

24.15.199.s: purastāt tv evaitat saṃvatsaram̐ saṃcakṣīta prāyaścittārtha eṣa ukto bhavati
24.15.199.d: पुरस्तात् त्व् एवैतत् संवत्सरँ संचक्षीत प्रायश्चित्तार्थ एष उक्तो भवति
24.15.199.m: Beforehand, however, he should calculate this year. / This is said for the purpose of an expiation.

24.15.199.s: sa yāvatkṛtva udvāyed evam eva kuryāt paryavete nopanamed evam eva kuryāt |
24.15.199.d: स यावत्कृत्व उद्वायेद् एवम् एव कुर्यात् पर्यवेते नोपनमेद् एवम् एव कुर्यात् ।
24.15.199.m: As many times as it goes out, so should he do. / When [the year] has elapsed, if it does not turn out well, he should do just so.
If it turns out well, the rite beginning with the fast-day cow is performed.

24.15.199.s: dvibrahmaudanamu haike bruvata uccheṣaṇīyo hetaraḥ sāntvakaraṇa uttaras |
24.15.199.d: द्विब्रह्मौदनमु हैके ब्रुवत उच्छेषणीयो हेतरः सान्त्वकरण उत्तरस् ।
24.15.199.m: Some indeed say, "There are two brahmaudana porridges": the other is [the porridge] of the remains, the latter is the one that appeases.

24.15.199.s: atha saṃbhāreṣūṣān nivapan yad adaś candramasi kṛṣṇaṃ tan manasā dhyāyet tad apīheti
24.15.199.d: अथ संभारेषूषान् निवपन् यद् अदश् चन्द्रमसि कृष्णं तन् मनसा ध्यायेत् तद् अपीहेति
24.15.199.m: Then, while scattering the saline earth over the requisites, he should mentally meditate on that which is black in yonder moon: "[Enter] that also here."

24.15.199.s: sāmāni cen na pratyadhīyīta yonīr nigaded api vā vyāhṛtībhir api vā hiṃkāreṇa
24.15.199.d: सामानि चेन् न प्रत्यधीयीत योनीर् निगदेद् अपि वा व्याहृतीभिर् अपि वा हिंकारेण
24.15.199.m: If he does not study the samans along with [the ṛcs], he should recite their verse bases, or with the mystical utterances, or with the sound "hiṃ".
He should roll the chariot-wheel along the path of the Praṇītā water.

24.15.199.s: tasya ced ādadhānasya purastāc candramā dṛśyeta kathaṃ tatra kuryād iti
24.15.199.d: तस्य चेद् आदधानस्य पुरस्ताच् चन्द्रमा दृश्येत कथं तत्र कुर्याद् इति
24.15.199.m: "If, while he is setting up [the fires], the moon should appear before [the completion], what should he do then?"

24.15.199.s: yaḥ karmānta ārabdhaḥ syāt taṃ pariniṣṭhāpya kramāntenoparamet |
24.15.199.d: यः कर्मान्त आरब्धः स्यात् तं परिनिष्ठाप्य क्रमान्तेनोपरमेत् ।
24.15.199.m: having completed whatever part of the rite had been begun, he should cease with the end of that step.

24.15.199.s: śvo bhūte parinistiṣṭhed iti | atha ced idhme 'bhyāhite dṛśyeta kathaṃ tatra kuryād iti
24.15.199.d: श्वो भूते परिनिस्तिष्ठेद् इति । अथ चेद् इध्मे ऽभ्याहिते दृश्येत कथं तत्र कुर्याद् इति
24.15.199.m: "On the morrow, he should finish it." / "Now if it should appear when the kindling wood has been put on, what should he do then?"

24.15.200.m: Having performed the rite ending with the full-spoon offering, he should cease with the end of that part of the rite.
"On the morrow, he should finish it."

24.16.200.s: athāta ṛtunakṣatrāṇām eva mīmām̐sās | ṛtūn evāgre vyākhyāsyāmo 'tha chandām̐sīti
24.16.200.d: अथात ऋतुनक्षत्राणाम् एव मीमाँसास् । ऋतून् एवाग्रे व्याख्यास्यामो ऽथ छन्दाँसीति
24.16.200.m: Now then, the investigations of the seasons and lunar mansions: / "We will explain the seasons first, and then the meters."

24.16.200.s: vasante brāhmaṇo 'gnim ādadhīta grīṣme rājanyaḥ śaradi vaiśyo varṣāsu rathakāra iti
24.16.200.d: वसन्ते ब्राह्मणो ऽग्निम् आदधीत ग्रीष्मे राजन्यः शरदि वैश्यो वर्षासु रथकार इति
24.16.200.m: "In spring a brāhmaṇa should set up the fire, in summer a nobleman, in autumn a vaiśya, in the rainy season a chariot-maker."

24.16.200.s: sarveṣāṃ tv eva vasanta ādhānam̐ sarveṣām̐ rohiṇyām |
24.16.200.d: सर्वेषां त्व् एव वसन्त आधानँ सर्वेषाँ रोहिण्याम् ।
24.16.200.m: For all, however, the setting up is in spring, or for all under Rohiṇī.
The meters, however, are according to caste.

24.16.200.s: api tu nu khalu kāmaniyuktāny agnyādheyāni bhavanti yathaitad bhavati kṛttikāsv agnim ādadhīta rohiṇyām agnim ādadhīta punarvasvor agnim ādadhīta pūrvayoḥ phalgunyos | uttarayoḥ phalgunyos | citrāyām iti
24.16.200.d: अपि तु नु खलु कामनियुक्तान्य् अग्न्याधेयानि भवन्ति यथैतद् भवति कृत्तिकास्व् अग्निम् आदधीत रोहिण्याम् अग्निम् आदधीत पुनर्वस्वोर् अग्निम् आदधीत पूर्वयोः फल्गुन्योस् । उत्तरयोः फल्गुन्योस् । चित्रायाम् इति
24.16.200.m: Moreover, indeed, the establishments of the sacred fire are associated with desires, / as in this: "He should set up the fire under the Kṛttikās", "He should set up the fire under Rohiṇī", "He should set up the fire under the Punarvasūs", "under the former Phalgunīs", "under the latter Phalgunīs", "under Citrā".

24.16.200.s: sadyaskālāny etāni bhavanti grīṣme rājanyaḥ śaradi vaiśya iti naite sadyaskāle bhavatas |
24.16.200.d: सद्यस्कालान्य् एतानि भवन्ति ग्रीष्मे राजन्यः शरदि वैश्य इति नैते सद्यस्काले भवतस् ।
24.16.200.m: These take place on the same day. / [The prescriptions] "In summer a nobleman, in autumn a vaiśya" do not take place on the same day.
Now then, we shall explain the establishments of the sacred fire connected with the seasons.
At an intermediate period during the waxing fortnight, or at an intermediate period during the waning fortnight.

24.16.200.s: vipakṣa āpūryamāṇapakṣa ādadhāno yāvān atrāvakāśaḥ syāt tam abhividadhīta
24.16.200.d: विपक्ष आपूर्यमाणपक्ष आदधानो यावान् अत्रावकाशः स्यात् तम् अभिविदधीत
24.16.200.m: Setting up [the fires] at an intermediate period during the waxing fortnight, he should utilize whatever interval there may be here.
On the full moon day, however, it takes place on the same day.

24.16.200.d: विपक्षे ऽपक्षीयमाणपक्ष आदधानो नात्रावकाशः वाङ्क्षणाय विद्यते
24.16.200.m: Setting up [the fires] at an intermediate period during the waning fortnight, no interval exists here for waiting.

24.16.200.s: sarvam evaitad ahaḥ sadyaskālaṃ kuryāc caturhotāram̐ sārasvatau homāv anvārambheṣṭim iti ||
24.16.200.d: सर्वम् एवैतद् अहः सद्यस्कालं कुर्याच् चतुर्होतारँ सारस्वतौ होमाव् अन्वारम्भेष्टिम् इति ॥
24.16.200.m: On that very day, he should perform everything on the same day: the Caturhotṛ formula, the two offerings to Sarasvant, and the introductory offering.

24.17.201.s: atha paurṇamāsavaimṛdhābhyām iṣṭvāmāvāsyām eva tataḥ kāṅkṣet | atha ced amāvāsyāyām̐ sadyaskālam amāvāsyāntam
24.17.201.d: अथ पौर्णमासवैमृधाभ्याम् इष्ट्वामावास्याम् एव ततः काङ्क्षेत् । अथ चेद् अमावास्यायाँ सद्यस्कालम् अमावास्यान्तम्
