24.37.223.s: atha haika ācāryā ekādaśa dharmān paśubandha utsādayanty agnyanvādhānaṃ vratopāyanaṃ pṛṣṭhyāṃ praṇītāṃ yājamānam ājyabhāgau prāśitraṃ yajamānabhāgabrahmabhāgau caturdhākaraṇaṃ viṣṇukramān iti
24.37.223.d: अथ हैक आचार्या एकादश धर्मान् पशुबन्ध उत्सादयन्त्य् अग्न्यन्वाधानं व्रतोपायनं पृष्ठ्यां प्रणीतां याजमानम् आज्यभागौ प्राशित्रं यजमानभागब्रह्मभागौ चतुर्धाकरणं विष्णुक्रमान् इति
24.37.223.m: Then some teachers discard eleven duties in the animal sacrifice: adding fuel to the sacred fires, undertaking the vow, the backbone line, the brought-forward water, the sacrificer's duties, the two portions of clarified butter, the prāśitra portion, the sacrificer's portion and the brahman priest's portion, dividing into four, and the steps of Viṣṇu.

24.37.223.s: kiyan nu khalu paśubandhe darvihomā dṛṣṭā bhavantīti
24.37.223.d: कियन् नु खलु पशुबन्धे दर्विहोमा दृष्टा भवन्तीति
24.37.223.m: How many ladle offerings indeed are seen in the animal sacrifice?

24.37.223.s: ṣaḍḍhotā yūpāhuti stokyā diśāṃpratījyaupayaja iti kiṃdevatyā u khalu manotā bhavatīti |
24.37.223.d: षड्ढोता यूपाहुति स्तोक्या दिशांप्रतीज्यौपयज इति किंदेवत्या उ खलु मनोता भवतीति ।
24.37.223.m: The six-hotṛ formula, the post libation, the drop libations, the counter-offering of the quarters, and the auxiliary offerings. To which deity indeed does the Manotā verse belong?

24.37.223.s: āgneyīty eva brūyāt kiṃdevatya u khalu vanaspatir bhavatīti
24.37.223.d: आग्नेयीत्य् एव ब्रूयात् किंदेवत्य उ खलु वनस्पतिर् भवतीति
24.37.223.m: He should simply say, “It belongs to Agni.” To which deity indeed does the Tree belong?

24.37.223.s: vaiṣṇava ity eva brūyāt | vijñāyate vaiṣṇavā vai vanaspatayas | iti |
24.37.223.d: वैष्णव इत्य् एव ब्रूयात् । विज्ञायते वैष्णवा वै वनस्पतयस् । इति ।
24.37.223.m: He should simply say, “To Viṣṇu.” It is known [from sacred text]: “Trees belong to Viṣṇu.”

24.37.223.s: athāpy udāharanti yajño vai viṣṇus | iti | athāyaṃ paśuḥ sārvatraiṣṭubho bhavaty ekādaśa prayājā ekādaśānuyājā ekādaśakapālaḥ paśupuroḍāśa ekādaśāvadānāny ekādaśopayājā iti |
24.37.223.d: अथाप्य् उदाहरन्ति यज्ञो वै विष्णुस् । इति । अथायं पशुः सार्वत्रैष्टुभो भवत्य् एकादश प्रयाजा एकादशानुयाजा एकादशकपालः पशुपुरोडाश एकादशावदानान्य् एकादशोपयाजा इति ।
24.37.223.m: And moreover they quote: “The sacrifice is Viṣṇu.” Now this animal [sacrifice] belongs entirely to the Triṣṭubh metre: eleven fore-offerings, eleven after-offerings, an eleven-potsherd animal-cake, eleven cuttings of the oblation, eleven auxiliary offerings.

24.37.224.s: yatho etac chālīkeḥ kalpaṃ vedayante 'raṇyor agnīn samārohyodavasyet tā cet tatra ceṣṭantam ādityo 'bhyastamiyāt kathaṃ tatra prāyaścittam̐ sidhyatī3 na sidhyatī3 iti
24.37.224.d: यथो एतच् छालीकेः कल्पं वेदयन्ते ऽरण्योर् अग्नीन् समारोह्योदवस्येत् ता चेत् तत्र चेष्टन्तम् आदित्यो ऽभ्यस्तमियात् कथं तत्र प्रायश्चित्तँ सिध्यती३ न सिध्यती३ इति
24.37.224.m: As they teach this procedure of Śālīki: having mounted the fires into the churning sticks, he should depart; if, while he is active there, the sun should set upon him, how does the expiation succeed or not succeed there?

24.37.224.s: sidhyatīty eka āhus | atha haika āhur na sidhyatīti
24.37.224.d: सिध्यतीत्य् एक आहुस् । अथ हैक आहुर् न सिध्यतीति
24.37.224.m: “It succeeds,” say some. Then indeed others say, “It does not succeed.”

24.37.224.s: yajñābhiparīta eṣa ākāśo bhavati naiva sidhyatītīn nvā ayaṃ paśuḥ sārvatraiṣṭubho vyākhyātaḥ ||
24.37.224.d: यज्ञाभिपरीत एष आकाशो भवति नैव सिध्यतीतीन् न्वा अयं पशुः सार्वत्रैष्टुभो व्याख्यातः ॥
24.37.224.m: “This open space is encompassed by the sacrifice; it does not succeed at all.” In this way, indeed, this animal [sacrifice] belonging entirely to the Triṣṭubh metre has been explained.

24.38.224.s: athātaḥ kāmyān paśūn vyākhyāsyāmaḥ ko nu khalv eṣām upām̐śu bhavatīti
24.38.224.d: अथातः काम्यान् पशून् व्याख्यास्यामः को नु खल्व् एषाम् उपाँशु भवतीति
24.38.224.m: Now therefore we shall explain the optional animal sacrifices. Which indeed among these is [offered] silently?

24.38.224.s: ya evāśvamedhikāḥ prājāpatyāḥ sāvitrāḥ sārasvatāḥ pauṣṇā yāmyāḥ pitṛdevatyā dyāvāpṛthivyā vāyavyāḥ sauryā vaiśvakarmaṇā iti
24.38.224.d: य एवाश्वमेधिकाः प्राजापत्याः सावित्राः सारस्वताः पौष्णा याम्याः पितृदेवत्या द्यावापृथिव्या वायव्याः सौर्या वैश्वकर्मणा इति
24.38.224.m: Those that belong to the horse sacrifice: those dedicated to Prajāpati, Savitar, Sarasvatī, Pūṣan, Yama, the Fathers, Heaven and Earth, Vāyu, Sūrya, and Viśvakarman.

24.38.224.s: garbhiṇayo bhavantīti katham atra prayaścittam̐ sidhyatī3 na sidhyatī3 iti
24.38.224.d: गर्भिणयो भवन्तीति कथम् अत्र प्रयश्चित्तँ सिध्यती३ न सिध्यती३ इति
24.38.224.m: When they are pregnant, how does the expiation succeed or not succeed here?

24.38.224.s: sidhyatīty eka āhus | atha haika āhur na sidhyatīti |
24.38.224.d: सिध्यतीत्य् एक आहुस् । अथ हैक आहुर् न सिध्यतीति ।
24.38.224.m: “It succeeds,” say some. Then indeed others say, “It does not succeed.”

24.38.224.s: etat samṛddhaya etā bhavanti naiva sidhyatīti |
24.38.224.d: एतत् समृद्धय एता भवन्ति नैव सिध्यतीति ।
24.38.224.m: “These [animals] are for this prosperity; it does not succeed at all.”

24.38.224.s: ādityāṃ malhāṃ garbhiṇīm ālabhate | ity ṛṣināmadheyam evaitad bhavati |
24.38.224.d: आदित्यां मल्हां गर्भिणीम् आलभते । इत्य् ऋषिनामधेयम् एवैतद् भवति ।
24.38.224.m: “He sacrifices a dewlapped pregnant cow to the Ādityas”—this is merely the name of a seer.

24.38.225.s: apannadatī bhavati | ity ahīnadatīty evedam uktaṃ bhavati | atheyaṃ daśarṣabhā saṃvatsaram abhi vihitā
24.38.225.d: अपन्नदती भवति । इत्य् अहीनदतीत्य् एवेदम् उक्तं भवति । अथेयं दशर्षभा संवत्सरम् अभि विहिता
24.38.225.m: “She has not lost her teeth”—by this, “having all her teeth” is stated. Now this [offering] of ten bulls is prescribed over a year.
“The tenth of them is a reddish-brown [bull] dedicated to Prajāpati.”

24.38.225.s: katham atra brahmacaryam̐ sidhyatī3 na sidhyatī3 iti
24.38.225.d: कथम् अत्र ब्रह्मचर्यँ सिध्यती३ न सिध्यती३ इति
24.38.225.m: How does the practice of student celibacy succeed or not succeed here?

24.38.225.s: sidhyatīty eka āhus | atha haika āhur na sidhyatīti saṃtiṣṭhate
24.38.225.d: सिध्यतीत्य् एक आहुस् । अथ हैक आहुर् न सिध्यतीति संतिष्ठते
24.38.225.m: "It succeeds," say some; "and now, it does not succeed," say some. It concludes.

24.38.225.s: naiva sidhyatīti paryāriṇī bhavatīti parihārasūr ity eka āhus |
24.38.225.d: नैव सिध्यतीति पर्यारिणी भवतीति परिहारसूर् इत्य् एक आहुस् ।
24.38.225.m: "It does not succeed at all." "It becomes a paryāriṇī." "It is a parihārasū [cow]," say some.

24.38.225.s: atha haika āhur anujaivaiṣoktā bhavati vehadity etām ācakṣate ||
24.38.225.d: अथ हैक आहुर् अनुजैवैषोक्ता भवति वेहदित्य् एताम् आचक्षते ॥
24.38.225.m: And now some say: "It is an anujā that is spoken of; they call this one a vehad."

24.39.225.s: somāpauṣṇaṃ traitam ālabheta | iti trayāṇām evaiṣa ukto bhavati | athāpy udāharanti yas tisro dhayatīti
24.39.225.d: सोमापौष्णं त्रैतम् आलभेत । इति त्रयाणाम् एवैष उक्तो भवति । अथाप्य् उदाहरन्ति यस् तिस्रो धयतीति
24.39.225.m: "[The sacrificer] should slaughter a three-year-old animal for Soma and Pūṣan." This is spoken of one of three years; and they also cite: "one that sucks three [mothers]."
"[He] should slaughter a stallion for Tvaṣṭṛ."

24.39.225.s: yam evaitaṃ pumām̐sam̐ santam adhirohati sa vaḍabas | viṣama ālabheta | iti
24.39.225.d: यम् एवैतं पुमाँसँ सन्तम् अधिरोहति स वडबस् । विषम आलभेत । इति
24.39.225.m: "He who mounts [another] while being male himself is a stallion." "He should slaughter it on uneven [ground]."

24.39.225.s: devayajanaṃ vā viṣamam̐ syādy asmin vā paśum ālabheta | apāṃ cauṣadhīnāṃ ca sandhāv ālabhata iti |
24.39.225.d: देवयजनं वा विषमँ स्याद्य् अस्मिन् वा पशुम् आलभेत । अपां चौषधीनां च सन्धाव् आलभत इति ।
24.39.225.m: Either the sacrificial ground should be uneven, or [the ground] on which he slaughters the animal; "he slaughters at the juncture of waters and plants."

24.39.225.s: udakānta ity eka āhus | atha haika āhuḥ prāvṛṣi vā śaradi veti
24.39.225.d: उदकान्त इत्य् एक आहुस् । अथ हैक आहुः प्रावृषि वा शरदि वेति
24.39.225.m: "At the water's edge," say some; and now some say: "either in the rainy season or in the autumn."

24.39.225.s: yasyāśvine śasyamāne sūryo nāvirbhavati sauryaṃ bahurūpam ālabheta | iti
24.39.225.d: यस्याश्विने शस्यमाने सूर्यो नाविर्भवति सौर्यं बहुरूपम् आलभेत । इति
24.39.225.m: "For him while the Āśvina [recitation] is being recited the sun does not appear, he should slaughter a multicolored [animal] for Sūrya."

24.39.225.s: prāyaṇīye ced atirātre na dṛśyetārambhaṇīyasyāhnaḥ savanīyasyopālambhyaṃ kuryāt |
24.39.225.d: प्रायणीये चेद् अतिरात्रे न दृश्येतारम्भणीयस्याह्नः सवनीयस्योपालम्भ्यं कुर्यात् ।
24.39.225.m: If it should not appear on the opening atirātra day, he should make it an additional victim to the offering animal of the introductory day.

24.39.226.s: atha ced udayanīye 'tirātre na dṛśyetaikāhike vānūbandhyasyopālambhyaṃ kuryur api vodavasāyaivaitena paśunā yajeran |
24.39.226.d: अथ चेद् उदयनीये ऽतिरात्रे न दृश्येतैकाहिके वानूबन्ध्यस्योपालम्भ्यं कुर्युर् अपि वोदवसायैवैतेन पशुना यजेरन् ।
24.39.226.m: And if it should not appear on the concluding atirātra day or on a one-day rite, they should make it an additional victim to the anūbandhyā cow; or they should perform the sacrifice with this animal only after breaking camp.

24.39.226.s: itīn nvā ime kāmyāḥ paśavo vyākhyātāḥ ||
24.39.226.d: इतीन् न्वा इमे काम्याः पशवो व्याख्याताः ॥
24.39.226.m: Thus indeed these optional animal sacrifices have been explained.

25.1.227.s: katham u khalv yāvajjīvaprayuktānāṃ cāturmāsyānām anuprayogo bhavatīti
25.1.227.d: कथम् उ खल्व् यावज्जीवप्रयुक्तानां चातुर्मास्यानाम् अनुप्रयोगो भवतीति
25.1.227.m: "And how indeed is the ongoing performance of the four-month sacrifices undertaken for life?"

25.1.227.s: phālgunyāṃ vā caitryāṃ vā paurṇamāsyām̐ śunāsīrīyaparuṣā yajeta |
25.1.227.d: फाल्गुन्यां वा चैत्र्यां वा पौर्णमास्याँ शुनासीरीयपरुषा यजेत ।
25.1.227.m: On the full moon day of Phālguna or of Caitra, he should sacrifice with the seasonal division of the Śunāsīrīya.
Then he should fast for the Vaiśvadeva; having sacrificed with the Vaiśvadeva, he should sacrifice with the full moon and Vaimṛdha offerings.

25.1.227.s: atha ced iṣṭyā paśunā somena vā yajeta kathaṃ tatra kuryād iti
25.1.227.d: अथ चेद् इष्ट्या पशुना सोमेन वा यजेत कथं तत्र कुर्याद् इति
25.1.227.m: "And if he should sacrifice with an iṣṭi, an animal sacrifice, or a Soma sacrifice, how should he do in that case?"
Having advanced [the time], he should sacrifice with the seasonal division of the Śunāsīrīya in that fortnight.

25.1.227.s: athaiteṣām ekena yajeta | atha vaiśvadevāyopavaset | vaiśvadeveneṣṭvā paurṇamāsavaimṛdhābhyāṃ yajeteti
25.1.227.d: अथैतेषाम् एकेन यजेत । अथ वैश्वदेवायोपवसेत् । वैश्वदेवेनेष्ट्वा पौर्णमासवैमृधाभ्यां यजेतेति
25.1.227.m: Then he should sacrifice with one of these; then he should fast for the Vaiśvadeva; having sacrificed with the Vaiśvadeva, he should sacrifice with the full moon and Vaimṛdha offerings.

25.1.227.s: yatho etad baudhāyanasya kalpaṃ vedayante yāvajjīvaprayuktāny eva cāturmāsyāni syur antar mithunāni
25.1.227.d: यथो एतद् बौधायनस्य कल्पं वेदयन्ते यावज्जीवप्रयुक्तान्य् एव चातुर्मास्यानि स्युर् अन्तर् मिथुनानि
25.1.227.m: And as they declare this ritual procedure of Baudhāyana: "The four-month sacrifices should indeed be undertaken for life, with pairs within;

25.1.227.s: prathame tv eva saṃvatsare vrataṃ cared iti katham atreṣṭipaśubandhā iti
25.1.227.d: प्रथमे त्व् एव संवत्सरे व्रतं चरेद् इति कथम् अत्रेष्टिपशुबन्धा इति
25.1.227.m: but in the first year alone he should observe the vow." How are the iṣṭis and animal sacrifices [arranged] in this case?

25.1.227.s: kāmam iṣṭyā kāmaṃ paśubandheneti kva u khalu cāturmāsyāni samāsaṃ gacchantīti
25.1.227.d: कामम् इष्ट्या कामं पशुबन्धेनेति क्व उ खलु चातुर्मास्यानि समासं गच्छन्तीति
25.1.227.m: "At will with an iṣṭi, at will with an animal sacrifice." "And where indeed do the four-month sacrifices undergo combination?"

25.1.227.s: rājasūye ca cāturmāsyeṣu ca someṣv ity eva brūyāt |
25.1.227.d: राजसूये च चातुर्मास्येषु च सोमेष्व् इत्य् एव ब्रूयात् ।
25.1.227.m: "In the Rājasūya and in the four-month Soma sacrifices," he should say.

25.1.227.s: athāpy udāharanti dvādaśāhe 'pi cāturmāsyair yajeta vaiśvadeveneṣṭvā caturthyāṃ varuṇapraghāsair aṣṭamyāṃ ca navamyāṃ ca sākamedhair dvādaśyām̐ śunāsīrīyaparuṣā yajeteti
25.1.227.d: अथाप्य् उदाहरन्ति द्वादशाहे ऽपि चातुर्मास्यैर् यजेत वैश्वदेवेनेष्ट्वा चतुर्थ्यां वरुणप्रघासैर् अष्टम्यां च नवम्यां च साकमेधैर् द्वादश्याँ शुनासीरीयपरुषा यजेतेति
25.1.227.m: And now they also cite: "Even in the twelve-day rite he should sacrifice with the four-month offerings: having sacrificed with the Vaiśvadeva, on the fourth [day] with the Varuṇapraghāsa offerings, on the eighth and ninth with the Sākamedha offerings, and on the twelfth with the seasonal division of the Śunāsīrīya." [Thus] he should sacrifice.

25.1.227.s: vijñāyate saṃvatsarapratimā vai dvādaśarātrayo bhavanti | iti
25.1.227.d: विज्ञायते संवत्सरप्रतिमा वै द्वादशरात्रयो भवन्ति । इति
25.1.227.m: It is known [from the sacred text]: "The twelve nights are indeed the counterpart of the year."

25.1.227.s: tūṣṇīkāni hāntarāṇi bhavantīti mantravaduhabāhyam etad eva sadanyatreṣṭisaṃnipāte viparītaṃ bhavatīti
25.1.227.d: तूष्णीकानि हान्तराणि भवन्तीति मन्त्रवदुहबाह्यम् एतद् एव सदन्यत्रेष्टिसंनिपाते विपरीतं भवतीति
25.1.227.m: "The inner ones are silent; with a mantra and modification is the outer one." This being so, it is reversed in other combinations of iṣṭis.

25.1.227.s: kva u khalu karambhapātrāṇi prathamaṃ mantraṃ labhanta iti
25.1.227.d: क्व उ खलु करम्भपात्राणि प्रथमं मन्त्रं लभन्त इति
25.1.227.m: "And where indeed do the barley-porridge dishes first receive a mantra?"

25.1.228.s: prokṣaṇa ity eva brūyāt saha havirbhiḥ karambhapātrāṇy abhiparyagnikuryāt
25.1.228.d: प्रोक्षण इत्य् एव ब्रूयात् सह हविर्भिः करम्भपात्राण्य् अभिपर्यग्निकुर्यात्
25.1.228.m: "At the sprinkling," he should say; "together with the oblations, he should carry the fire around the barley-porridge dishes."
"Now, to which deities indeed do the barley-porridge dishes belong?"

25.1.228.s: vāruṇānīty eva brūyāt | vijñāyate | anyam eva varuṇam avayajate | iti |
25.1.228.d: वारुणानीत्य् एव ब्रूयात् । विज्ञायते । अन्यम् एव वरुणम् अवयजते । इति ।
25.1.228.m: "To Varuṇa," he should say; it is known [from the sacred text]: "he buys off none other than Varuṇa."

25.1.228.s: astaṃ preta sudānavas | iti gṛhān prekṣetety evedam uktaṃ bhavati
25.1.228.d: अस्तं प्रेत सुदानवस् । इति गृहान् प्रेक्षेतेत्य् एवेदम् उक्तं भवति
25.1.228.m: With "Go home, O bountiful ones," he should look toward the houses; this indeed is what is meant.

25.1.228.s: tau vyaticāram̐ stambayajuṣī hareyātām itaś cāmutaś ca yantaṃ pratiprasthātādhvaryuṃ parigṛhṇīyāt
25.1.228.d: तौ व्यतिचारँ स्तम्बयजुषी हरेयाताम् इतश् चामुतश् च यन्तं प्रतिप्रस्थाताध्वर्युं परिगृह्णीयात्
25.1.228.m: Crossing each other, the two should carry the Stambayajuṣ offerings; the pratiprasthātṛ priest should take hold of the adhvaryu priest who is going to and fro.
Having poured out water for that which was measured out together, the pratiprasthātṛ priest should make [the sacrificer] recite [the mantra] for the ghee of the adhvaryu priest.

25.1.228.s: athedhmayor atipraṇayanād ādāyādhvaryuḥ svam idhmam apakramyaiva tiṣṭhati ||
25.1.228.d: अथेध्मयोर् अतिप्रणयनाद् आदायाध्वर्युः स्वम् इध्मम् अपक्रम्यैव तिष्ठति ॥
25.1.228.m: Then, before bringing forward the two firewood bundles, having taken his own firewood bundle, the adhvaryu priest steps aside and stands.

25.2.228.s: athāyaṃ pratiprasthātāntareṇedhmaṃ cāhavanīyaṃ copātītya svam idhmam ādadīta
25.2.228.d: अथायं प्रतिप्रस्थातान्तरेणेध्मं चाहवनीयं चोपातीत्य स्वम् इध्मम् आददीत
25.2.228.m: Then this pratiprasthātṛ priest, having passed between the firewood bundle and the āhavanīya fire, should take his own firewood bundle.

25.2.228.s: tāv apasalaiḥ paryāvṛtyedhmau hareyātām athāmutaḥ pradakṣiṇam āvṛtyedhmau pratiṣṭhāpyaitenaiva yathetam etya pratinirveṣṭayate pratiprasthātāntareṇa vedī prācīnam upayamanīhāras |
25.2.228.d: ताव् अपसलैः पर्यावृत्येध्मौ हरेयाताम् अथामुतः प्रदक्षिणम् आवृत्येध्मौ प्रतिष्ठाप्यैतेनैव यथेतम् एत्य प्रतिनिर्वेष्टयते प्रतिप्रस्थातान्तरेण वेदी प्राचीनम् उपयमनीहारस् ।
25.2.228.m: Turning around counter-clockwise, the two should carry the two firewood bundles; then, turning clockwise from there and having set down the two firewood bundles, having gone by the same way as they came, the carrier of the supporting wood covers it back up eastwards between the two altars.

25.2.229.s: athemā adhvaryoḥ prokṣaṇyo dakṣiṇena pratiprasthātāraṃ parigṛhyāsādayet |
25.2.229.d: अथेमा अध्वर्योः प्रोक्षण्यो दक्षिणेन प्रतिप्रस्थातारं परिगृह्यासादयेत् ।
25.2.229.m: Then, taking these sprinkling waters of the adhvaryu priest to the south of the pratiprasthātṛ priest, he should set them down.

25.2.229.s: evam etābhir anabhiparihṛto bhavati | atheyaṃ mārutī dakṣiṇāṃ vediṃ gacchati saptamī haviṣām adhiśrīyate
25.2.229.d: एवम् एताभिर् अनभिपरिहृतो भवति । अथेयं मारुती दक्षिणां वेदिं गच्छति सप्तमी हविषाम् अधिश्रीयते
25.2.229.m: Thus he is not bypassed by these. Then this [oblation] for the Maruts goes to the southern altar; as seventh of the oblations, it is placed on the fire.
"How are they not separated by it?"

25.2.229.s: pratikṛṣyainām agreṇa dakṣiṇena havīm̐ṣy anabhighāritām udvāsayet |
25.2.229.d: प्रतिकृष्यैनाम् अग्रेण दक्षिणेन हवीँष्य् अनभिघारिताम् उद्वासयेत् ।
25.2.229.m: Having moved it forward, south of the front of the oblations, without pouring ghee over it, he should remove it from the fire.
Then, having placed it on the fire again, poured ghee over it, and removed it from the fire, he should set it down within the altar.

25.2.229.s: evam etāny avyavetāni bhavanti | athāyaṃ pratiprasthātā mārutyai daivatasya sakṛd evānuvācayet sakṛd āśrāvayet |
25.2.229.d: एवम् एतान्य् अव्यवेतानि भवन्ति । अथायं प्रतिप्रस्थाता मारुत्यै दैवतस्य सकृद् एवानुवाचयेत् सकृद् आश्रावयेत् ।
25.2.229.m: Thus these are not separated. Then this pratiprasthātṛ priest should make [the hotṛ priest] recite [the puronuvākyā] only once for the deity of the Maruts oblation, and should make the call only once.
Then in other respects he imitates the adhvaryu priest.

25.2.229.s: tad yad ihāśrāvayatīha yajatīti tat pratiprasthātā kṛtānukāra eva bhavati |
25.2.229.d: तद् यद् इहाश्रावयतीह यजतीति तत् प्रतिप्रस्थाता कृतानुकार एव भवति ।
25.2.229.m: That which [the adhvaryu priest] makes the call for here, and offers here—in that the pratiprasthātṛ priest merely imitates [him].

25.2.229.s: athedaṃ mārutyai mekṣaṇam agreṇauttaravedikam agniṃ parigṛhyānupraharet |
25.2.229.d: अथेदं मारुत्यै मेक्षणम् अग्रेणौत्तरवेदिकम् अग्निं परिगृह्यानुप्रहरेत् ।
25.2.229.m: Then, having encircled the fire of the high altar with the stirring stick of this [oblation] for the Maruts from the front, he should throw it [into the fire].

25.2.229.s: yatho etad aupamanyavasya kalpaṃ vedayante tuṣaiś ca niṣkāsena cāvabhṛtham aveyād iti daivataṃ pradāya sviṣṭakṛtaṃ prayacchet tuṣān saṃprakīryodakāntaṃ pratyasyet
25.2.229.d: यथो एतद् औपमन्यवस्य कल्पं वेदयन्ते तुषैश् च निष्कासेन चावभृथम् अवेयाद् इति दैवतं प्रदाय स्विष्टकृतं प्रयच्छेत् तुषान् संप्रकीर्योदकान्तं प्रत्यस्येत्
25.2.229.m: And as they declare this procedure of Aupamanyava: "He should go to the purifying bath with the husks and the scrapings"—having offered to the deity, he should present the sviṣṭakṛt offering; having scattered the husks together, he should throw them towards the water's edge.

25.2.230.m: Then this Gṛhamedhīya sacrifice concludes with the introductory ghee-portions and ending with the iḍā.

25.2.230.s: tatra nāsti prāśitram | tūṣṇīm̐ samaktāñ chākalān paridhīn agnāv anupraharet |
25.2.230.d: तत्र नास्ति प्राशित्रम् । तूष्णीँ समक्ताञ् छाकलान् परिधीन् अग्नाव् अनुप्रहरेत् ।
25.2.230.m: There is no eating of the priest's portion there. Silently, having anointed the splinters of the enclosing sticks, he should throw them into the fire.
If a cow with an adopted calf is not available, he should milk the milk of a cow that yields milk for two cows.

25.3.230.s: athāyaṃ mahāpitṛyajñas tasya kaḥ karmaṇa upakramo bhavatīti
25.3.230.d: अथायं महापितृयज्ञस् तस्य कः कर्मण उपक्रमो भवतीति
25.3.230.m: Now this Mahāpitṛyajña: "What is the beginning of its ritual action?"

25.3.230.s: barhiryajuṣā kuryāt | devānāṃ pitṛṇāṃ pariṣūtam asi devapitṛbarhir mā tvānvaṅ mā tirak parva te rādhyāsam iti | apahato 'raruḥ pṛthivyai devapitṛyajanyai | iti | apahato 'raruḥ pṛthivyā adevapitṛyajanas | ity evam eteṣv adhikaraṇeṣu kuryād yatra devāś ca pitaraś ca saṃnigaccheyuḥ
25.3.230.d: बर्हिर्यजुषा कुर्यात् । देवानां पितृणां परिषूतम् असि देवपितृबर्हिर् मा त्वान्वङ् मा तिरक् पर्व ते राध्यासम् इति । अपहतो ऽररुः पृथिव्यै देवपितृयजन्यै । इति । अपहतो ऽररुः पृथिव्या अदेवपितृयजनस् । इत्य् एवम् एतेष्व् अधिकरणेषु कुर्याद् यत्र देवाश् च पितरश् च संनिगच्छेयुः
25.3.230.m: He should do it with the grass formula: "You are the protection of the gods and the ancestors," "May you, the grass of the gods and ancestors, not injure me backwards or sideways," "May I prosper through your joint"; with "Repelled is Araru from the earth, the sacrificial ground of the gods and ancestors"; with "Repelled is Araru from the earth, the non-sacrificial ground of the gods and ancestors"—thus he should do on these occasions where the gods and the ancestors assemble together.

25.3.230.s: pāṇī saṃmṛśīta paristṛṇīyāt pātrāṇi nirṇijya sam̐sādayet |
25.3.230.d: पाणी संमृशीत परिस्तृणीयात् पात्राणि निर्णिज्य सँसादयेत् ।
25.3.230.m: He should wipe his hands; he should scatter [grass] around; having cleansed the utensils, he should arrange them together.

25.3.230.s: brahmāṇaṃ dakṣiṇata upaveśyātraivottarata udapātraṃ nidhāya jaghanena gārhapatyam̐ sphyaṃ nidadhyāt
25.3.230.d: ब्रह्माणं दक्षिणत उपवेश्यात्रैवोत्तरत उदपात्रं निधाय जघनेन गार्हपत्यँ स्फ्यं निदध्यात्
25.3.230.m: Having seated the brahman priest to the south, having placed the water vessel right here to the north, he should set down the wooden sword behind the gārhapatya fire.
Above the wooden sword, the dish; in the dish he should pour the rice grains.

25.3.230.s: śūrpādānaprabhṛti karmāntastāyata āpyāntas | jaghanena gārhapatyam āpyebhyo ninayet |
25.3.230.d: शूर्पादानप्रभृति कर्मान्तस्तायत आप्यान्तस् । जघनेन गार्हपत्यम् आप्येभ्यो निनयेत् ।
25.3.230.m: Beginning with taking the winnowing basket, the ritual action extends to the end of the Āpya offerings; behind the gārhapatya fire, he should pour out [water] for the Āpyas.

25.3.230.s: viparikrāmanty eta ṛtvijas | adhvaryur anantaro 'gneḥ syād atha yajamāno 'tha brahmāthāgnīdhras |
25.3.230.d: विपरिक्रामन्त्य् एत ऋत्विजस् । अध्वर्युर् अनन्तरो ऽग्नेः स्याद् अथ यजमानो ऽथ ब्रह्माथाग्नीध्रस् ।
25.3.230.m: These officiating priests walk around in reverse order: the adhvaryu priest should be next to the fire, then the sacrificer, then the brahman, then the āgnīdhra.

25.3.230.s: api vāgnīdhra evānantaro 'gneḥ syād atha yajamāno 'tha brahmāthādhvaryus |
25.3.230.d: अपि वाग्नीध्र एवानन्तरो ऽग्नेः स्याद् अथ यजमानो ऽथ ब्रह्माथाध्वर्युस् ।
25.3.230.m: Or rather, the āgnīdhra alone should be next to the fire, then the sacrificer, then the brahman, then the adhvaryu priest.

25.3.231.s: vipariharanti havīm̐ṣy agreṇa puroḍāśaṃ dhānā jaghanena dhānāḥ karambham iti |
25.3.231.d: विपरिहरन्ति हवीँष्य् अग्रेण पुरोडाशं धाना जघनेन धानाः करम्भम् इति ।
25.3.231.m: They move the oblations in reverse order: in front the sacrificial cake, behind it the parched grains, behind the parched grains the gruel.

25.3.231.s: evaṃ viparihṛtānām evaiteṣām̐ haviṣām ekaikam udvāsayet
25.3.231.d: एवं विपरिहृतानाम् एवैतेषाँ हविषाम् एकैकम् उद्वासयेत्
25.3.231.m: In this manner, when they have been transposed, he should remove each of these oblations.

25.3.231.s: kva u khalu traiyambakā nirupyanta iti | udvāsya havīm̐ṣi rudrāyāmbikāyai juṣṭaṃ nirvapāmi | iti yasya mantravantaḥ
25.3.231.d: क्व उ खलु त्रैयम्बका निरुप्यन्त इति । उद्वास्य हवीँषि रुद्रायाम्बिकायै जुष्टं निर्वपामि । इति यस्य मन्त्रवन्तः
25.3.231.m: Now, where indeed are the Tryambaka oblations measured out? Having removed the oblations, [they belong] to whoever's ritual formula is: 'I measure out what is pleasing to Rudra and Ambikā.'
He should measure out for Ka with: 'To Ka!'

25.3.231.s: kāyānubrūhi | ity anubrūyāt kaṃ yaja | iti yajet kva u khalu traiyambakāṇām̐ sauviṣṭakṛtaṃ bhavatīti
25.3.231.d: कायानुब्रूहि । इत्य् अनुब्रूयात् कं यज । इति यजेत् क्व उ खलु त्रैयम्बकाणाँ सौविष्टकृतं भवतीति
25.3.231.m: He should recite the invitatory verse with: 'Recite for Ka!' He should make the offering with: 'Worship Ka!' Now, where indeed does the Sviṣṭakṛt offering of the Tryambaka rites take place?
Just when he hangs up the woven basket from here.

25.3.231.s: asamudita ṛṣabhaṃ dadātīti mahāhaviṣām evaiṣo 'samudite dātavyo bhavati
25.3.231.d: असमुदित ऋषभं ददातीति महाहविषाम् एवैषो ऽसमुदिते दातव्यो भवति
25.3.231.m: With the words, 'He gives a bull when it has not yet risen,' this [bull] is to be given before the rising of the sun only in the Mahāhavis offerings.

25.3.231.s: sarvam eva yājamānaṃ pitṛyajña utsīdet paśubandhe saumye 'dhvare 'nyatratatrotpattivacanāt
25.3.231.d: सर्वम् एव याजमानं पितृयज्ञ उत्सीदेत् पशुबन्धे सौम्ये ऽध्वरे ऽन्यत्रतत्रोत्पत्तिवचनात्
25.3.231.m: Every duty of the sacrificer should cease in the ancestral sacrifice, in the animal sacrifice, [and] in the Soma sacrifice, because there are specific injunctions elsewhere for their performance there.

25.3.231.s: sarva evāgnir yājamāno 'gnicaye sarvam evāgnyādheyac chando yājamānam agnyādheye ||
25.3.231.d: सर्व एवाग्निर् याजमानो ऽग्निचये सर्वम् एवाग्न्याधेयच् छन्दो याजमानम् अग्न्याधेये ॥
25.3.231.m: The entire sacrificer's portion is the fire in the piling of the fire altar, and the entire sacrificer's portion is the meter of the establishment of the sacred fires in the establishment of the sacred fires.

25.4.231.s: agniṣṭomena yakṣyamāṇaḥ prajyam ātmānaṃ kurvīta yenāsyākuśalam̐ syāt tena kuśalaṃ kurvīta
25.4.231.d: अग्निष्टोमेन यक्ष्यमाणः प्रज्यम् आत्मानं कुर्वीत येनास्याकुशलँ स्यात् तेन कुशलं कुर्वीत
25.4.231.m: One about to sacrifice with the agniṣṭoma should make himself fit. In whatever way an ill deed might have occurred to him, by that he should make it good.

25.4.231.s: yāny ṛṇāny utthitakālāni syus tāni vyavahared anujñāpayīta vā
25.4.231.d: यान्य् ऋणान्य् उत्थितकालानि स्युस् तानि व्यवहरेद् अनुज्ञापयीत वा
25.4.231.m: Whatever debts have their time [of payment] arrived, he should settle them or obtain permission [for delay].

25.4.231.s: sa purastād evopakalpayate prabhūtaṃ ṛṇavam̐śaṃ paśvājyam̐ sthālyamatraṃ kumbaṃ ca kurīraṃ ceti
25.4.231.d: स पुरस्ताद् एवोपकल्पयते प्रभूतं ऋणवँशं पश्वाज्यँ स्थाल्यमत्रं कुम्बं च कुरीरं चेति
25.4.231.m: He procures beforehand plenty of reed bamboo, animal butter, earthen vessels, a head-band, and a hair-net.

25.4.232.s: vidalam u ha kumbaṃ bhavati jālam u kurīram | dvādaśaśataṃ dakṣiṇānām |
25.4.232.d: विदलम् उ ह कुम्बं भवति जालम् उ कुरीरम् । द्वादशशतं दक्षिणानाम् ।
25.4.232.m: The kumba is split wicker-work, and the kurīra is a net. There are one hundred and twelve sacrificial gifts.

25.4.232.s: vijñāyate chandogabrāhmaṇaṃ vīrahā vā eṣa devānāṃ yaḥ somam abhiṣuṇoti | iti
25.4.232.d: विज्ञायते छन्दोगब्राह्मणं वीरहा वा एष देवानां यः सोमम् अभिषुणोति । इति
25.4.232.m: It is taught in the brāhmaṇa passage of the Chāndogas: 'He who presses soma is indeed a slayer of the hero of the gods.'

25.4.232.s: śatena vīraṃ niravadayate daśabhir daśa prāṇāni |
25.4.232.d: शतेन वीरं निरवदयते दशभिर् दश प्राणानि ।
25.4.232.m: With a hundred [cows] he buys off the hero; with ten, the ten breaths.

25.4.232.s: aikādaśī tayātmānam | yaiva dvādaśī sā dakṣiṇeti | atha haika ekavim̐śatidakṣiṇena yajanta ekavim̐śaṃ yajñāyajñiyam iti vadantas |
25.4.232.d: ऐकादशी तयात्मानम् । यैव द्वादशी सा दक्षिणेति । अथ हैक एकविँशतिदक्षिणेन यजन्त एकविँशं यज्ञायज्ञियम् इति वदन्तस् ।
25.4.232.m: The eleventh is that [by which he buys off] himself; the twelfth alone is the sacrificial gift. Now, some sacrifice with twenty-one sacrificial gifts, saying: 'The yajñāyajñīya [saman] has twenty-one parts.'

25.4.232.s: atha haike saptagunā yajante somakrayaṇy atithigavy anūbandhyāś catasro madhyatas
25.4.232.d: अथ हैके सप्तगुना यजन्ते सोमक्रयण्य् अतिथिगव्य् अनूबन्ध्याश् चतस्रो मध्यतस्
25.4.232.m: Now, some sacrifice with seven cows: the cow for purchasing soma, the cow for the guest-reception, the barren cow, and four in between.

25.4.232.s: tad api dāśataye vijñāyate pra saptagum ṛtadhītiṃ sumedhām iti ||
25.4.232.d: तद् अपि दाशतये विज्ञायते प्र सप्तगुम् ऋतधीतिं सुमेधाम् इति ॥
25.4.232.m: That is also known in the Ṛgveda: 'Offer the rite with seven cows, of true thought, of good wisdom.'

25.5.232.s: athāto devayajanakalpaḥ sa etad devayajanakalpaṃ joṣayate purastād udakam anūṣaram anupahitam avisṛgdāryaniriṇamasuṣiram abhaṅguram avalmīkaṃ bahulauṣadhi yatrānyāanyā oṣadhayo vyatiṣaktāḥ syuḥ prāgudakpravaṇaṃ yathā cātvālasāriṇīr āpaḥ syur nātipravaṇaṃ yasmād anyat purastātsamantikaṃ devayajanaṃ na vindeyus
25.5.232.d: अथातो देवयजनकल्पः स एतद् देवयजनकल्पं जोषयते पुरस्ताद् उदकम् अनूषरम् अनुपहितम् अविसृग्दार्यनिरिणमसुषिरम् अभङ्गुरम् अवल्मीकं बहुलौषधि यत्रान्याअन्या ओषधयो व्यतिषक्ताः स्युः प्रागुदक्प्रवणं यथा चात्वालसारिणीर् आपः स्युर् नातिप्रवणं यस्माद् अन्यत् पुरस्तात्समन्तिकं देवयजनं न विन्देयुस्
25.5.232.m: Now then, the rule for the sacrificial ground. He selects this sacrificial ground: with water to the east, free of saline soil, not previously occupied, not broken by chasms or fissures, without holes, unbroken, without ant-hills, with abundant plants where diverse plants intertwine, sloping towards the northeast, such that water flows to the cātvāla pit, not excessively steep, [and] such that they do not find another sacrificial ground directly facing it nearby in the east.

25.5.233.m: Then they measure out this hall with its beams pointing east.

25.5.233.s: kṛttikāḥ khalv imāḥ prācīṃ diśaṃ na parijahati
25.5.233.d: कृत्तिकाः खल्व् इमाः प्राचीं दिशं न परिजहति
25.5.233.m: The Pleiades indeed do not deviate from the eastern direction.

25.5.233.s: tāsām̐ saṃdarśanena māpayed ity etad ekam |
25.5.233.d: तासाँ संदर्शनेन मापयेद् इत्य् एतद् एकम् ।
25.5.233.m: One [view] is that he should measure it out by sighting them.

25.5.233.s: śroṇāsaṃdarśanena māpayed ity etad ekam | citrāsvātyor antareṇety etad aparam |
25.5.233.d: श्रोणासंदर्शनेन मापयेद् इत्य् एतद् एकम् । चित्रास्वात्योर् अन्तरेणेत्य् एतद् अपरम् ।
25.5.233.m: Another [view] is that he should measure it out by sighting Śroṇā; another is: 'Between Citrā and Svātī.'

25.5.233.s: dikṣvatīkāśā bhavatīti dvārbhir evaiṣā dikṣvatīkāśā bhavati |
25.5.233.d: दिक्ष्वतीकाशा भवतीति द्वार्भिर् एवैषा दिक्ष्वतीकाशा भवति ।
25.5.233.m: Regarding the statement, 'It has openings toward the cardinal directions': it has openings toward the cardinal directions by means of its doors alone.
Moreover, they also cite: 'He should make openings by means of the beams themselves.'

25.5.233.s: dvau stomau prātaḥsavanaṃ vahata iti trivṛtpañcadaśau prātaḥsavanaṃ vahataḥ
25.5.233.d: द्वौ स्तोमौ प्रातःसवनं वहत इति त्रिवृत्पञ्चदशौ प्रातःसवनं वहतः
25.5.233.m: Regarding the statement, 'Two stomans carry the morning pressing': the nine-verse stoman and the fifteen-verse stoman carry the morning pressing;
the fifteen-verse stoman and the seventeen-verse stoman the midday pressing;

25.5.233.s: saptadaśaikavim̐śau tṛtīyasavanam eṣa eva sam̐ś catuṣṭomo bhavati
25.5.233.d: सप्तदशैकविँशौ तृतीयसवनम् एष एव सँश् चतुष्टोमो भवति
25.5.233.m: the seventeen-verse stoman and the twenty-one-verse stoman the third pressing. This very one, being [such], is the Catuṣṭoma.

25.5.233.s: dvādaśa hi stotrāṇi bhavanti yatho etad aupamanyavasya kalpaṃ vedayante purastād evaitat traividhyagateṣu devayajanam adhyavasyed vijñāyate sā vā iyam̐ sarvaiva vedis | iti ||
25.5.233.d: द्वादश हि स्तोत्राणि भवन्ति यथो एतद् औपमन्यवस्य कल्पं वेदयन्ते पुरस्ताद् एवैतत् त्रैविध्यगतेषु देवयजनम् अध्यवस्येद् विज्ञायते सा वा इयँ सर्वैव वेदिस् । इति ॥
25.5.233.m: For there are twelve chants. And as they explain this rule of Aupamanyava: beforehand, when the threefold division has been reached, he should take possession of the sacrificial ground; it is known [from scripture]: 'This whole earth indeed is the altar.'

25.6.233.s: athemam āgnāvaiṣṇavam eke prāgapsudīkṣāyai bruvata upariṣṭād vā
25.6.233.d: अथेमम् आग्नावैष्णवम् एके प्रागप्सुदीक्षायै ब्रुवत उपरिष्टाद् वा
25.6.233.m: Now, some declare this [offering] to Agni and Viṣṇu [to take place] before the consecration in the waters, or after.

25.6.234.s: kva u khalu dīkṣaṇīyāyai barhiryajuṣā kuryād iti vyupanidhāya saṃbhārān prāk pāṇisaṃmarśanāt |
25.6.234.d: क्व उ खलु दीक्षणीयायै बर्हिर्यजुषा कुर्याद् इति व्युपनिधाय संभारान् प्राक् पाणिसंमर्शनात् ।
25.6.234.m: Now, where indeed should he prepare the sacrificial grass for the consecratory offering with a ritual formula? Having placed the equipment down, [he does so] before touching his hands.

25.6.234.s: na yajamānaṃ vratam upanayati na patnīm̐ saṃnahyatīty adhvaradīkṣāyai vrataṃ praṇudate
25.6.234.d: न यजमानं व्रतम् उपनयति न पत्नीँ संनह्यतीत्य् अध्वरदीक्षायै व्रतं प्रणुदते
25.6.234.m: With the rule, 'He does not lead the sacrificer to the vow, nor does he gird the wife,' he sets aside the vow for the initiation of the solemn sacrifice.

25.6.234.s: sarvaivaiṣā vratopāyanīyā bhavatīṣṭir agram u patnīsaṃnahanam |
25.6.234.d: सर्वैवैषा व्रतोपायनीया भवतीष्टिर् अग्रम् उ पत्नीसंनहनम् ।
25.6.234.m: This entire offering is one for undertaking the vow, and the girding of the wife is its principal part.

25.6.234.s: na yajamānabhāgaṃ karoti na brahmabhāgam ity āśīḥsaṃyojanāv evaitāv uktau bhavataḥ
25.6.234.d: न यजमानभागं करोति न ब्रह्मभागम् इत्य् आशीःसंयोजनाव् एवैताव् उक्तौ भवतः
25.6.234.m: Regarding, 'He does not make the sacrificer's portion, nor the brahman's portion': both these are declared to be connected with the invocation of blessings.

25.6.234.s: kim upakramamāṇo yajñam āśiṣaṃ vaded iti |
25.6.234.d: किम् उपक्रममाणो यज्ञम् आशिषं वदेद् इति ।
25.6.234.m: How, while commencing a sacrifice, could he utter a blessing?
Moreover, 'He becomes one possessing abundant food at the undertaking of the vow.'

25.6.234.s: kasmai kim̐ subhikṣāyāvadyet | yajamānabhāgasya khalūtsādanād brahmabhāga utsīdati
25.6.234.d: कस्मै किँ सुभिक्षायावद्येत् । यजमानभागस्य खलूत्सादनाद् ब्रह्मभाग उत्सीदति
25.6.234.m: For whose sake, for what abundant food should he cut off [a portion]? Surely, by the omission of the sacrificer's portion, the brahman's portion drops out;
for these two, the sacrificer's portion and the brahman's portion, are connected.

25.6.234.s: na barhiṣadaṃ puroḍāśaṃ karoti nānvāhāryaṃ yācatīti
25.6.234.d: न बर्हिषदं पुरोडाशं करोति नान्वाहार्यं याचतीति
25.6.234.m: Regarding, 'He does not make the sacrificial cake resting on sacrificial grass, nor does he ask for the anvāhārya cooked rice':

25.6.234.s: dakṣiṇoktāv evaitāv uktau bhavatas | anyā u khalv iha dakṣiṇāḥ pratikhyātā bhavanti
25.6.234.d: दक्षिणोक्ताव् एवैताव् उक्तौ भवतस् । अन्या उ खल्व् इह दक्षिणाः प्रतिख्याता भवन्ति
25.6.234.m: both of these are declared in the context of the sacrificial gift; however, different sacrificial gifts are prescribed here.

25.6.234.s: na phalīkaraṇahomena carati na samiṣṭayajur juhotīty antaparikramiṇāv evaitāv uktau bhavataḥ
25.6.234.d: न फलीकरणहोमेन चरति न समिष्टयजुर् जुहोतीत्य् अन्तपरिक्रमिणाव् एवैताव् उक्तौ भवतः
25.6.234.m: Regarding, 'He does not perform the chaff-offering, nor does he offer the samiṣṭayajus formula': both these are declared to be rituals belonging to the conclusion.

25.6.234.s: kim upakramamāṇo yajñam antaṃ pariṇayed iti na pūrṇapātre yajamānaṃ vācayati na viṣṇukramān kramata ity avabhṛthoktaḥ khalu pūrṇapātro bhavati |
25.6.234.d: किम् उपक्रममाणो यज्ञम् अन्तं परिणयेद् इति न पूर्णपात्रे यजमानं वाचयति न विष्णुक्रमान् क्रमत इत्य् अवभृथोक्तः खलु पूर्णपात्रो भवति ।
25.6.234.m: How, while commencing a sacrifice, could he lead it to the conclusion? Regarding, 'He does not make the sacrificer recite over the full vessel, nor does he step the strides of Viṣṇu': the full vessel is indeed declared at the concluding bath;

25.6.235.s: anyaḥ khalv ihāvabhṛthaḥ pratikhyāto bhavati | antaparikramiṇo viṣṇukramāḥ
25.6.235.d: अन्यः खल्व् इहावभृथः प्रतिख्यातो भवति । अन्तपरिक्रमिणो विष्णुक्रमाः
25.6.235.m: and a different concluding bath is prescribed here. The strides of Viṣṇu are rituals belonging to the conclusion.
How, while commencing a sacrifice, could he lead it to the conclusion?

25.7.235.s: dvādaśa vātsabandhāny udayacchann iti katamāni khalv imāni vātsabandhāni bhavantīti |
25.7.235.d: द्वादश वात्सबन्धान्य् उदयच्छन्न् इति कतमानि खल्व् इमानि वात्सबन्धानि भवन्तीति ।
25.7.235.m: Regarding, 'They raised twelve vātsabandha [verses]': which indeed are these vātsabandha verses?

25.7.235.s: etā eva sruvāhutīr anyatra svāhākārād iti |
25.7.235.d: एता एव स्रुवाहुतीर् अन्यत्र स्वाहाकाराद् इति ।
25.7.235.m: These ladle libations themselves, without the svāhā exclamation.

25.7.235.s: athāpy udāharanti samānasaṃkhyāno 'gnir ṛci tisro devatās tāni dvādaśa |
25.7.235.d: अथाप्य् उदाहरन्ति समानसंख्यानो ऽग्निर् ऋचि तिस्रो देवतास् तानि द्वादश ।
25.7.235.m: Moreover, they cite: 'Agni has an equal count in the verse; there are three deities; these make twelve.'

25.7.235.s: athedaṃ kṛṣṇājinaṃ nauruktaṃ bhavati | ācya jānv etat pārśvata evābhisarped dakṣiṇaṃ prati randhraṃ yathā nāvam |
25.7.235.d: अथेदं कृष्णाजिनं नौरुक्तं भवति । आच्य जान्व् एतत् पार्श्वत एवाभिसर्पेद् दक्षिणं प्रति रन्ध्रं यथा नावम् ।
25.7.235.m: Now, this black antelope skin is spoken of as a boat: bending the knee, he should creep onto it from the side toward the right opening, as if into a boat.

25.7.235.s: naktaṃ ced amedhyaṃ paśyed āhavanīyam evaitena yajuṣopatiṣṭheta |
25.7.235.d: नक्तं चेद् अमेध्यं पश्येद् आहवनीयम् एवैतेन यजुषोपतिष्ठेत ।
25.7.235.m: If he should see something impure at night, he should revere the āhavanīya fire with this very ritual formula.

25.7.235.s: athemāni daikṣāṇi vratāni sāyam upakramāṇi prātar apavargāṇi |
25.7.235.d: अथेमानि दैक्षाणि व्रतानि सायम् उपक्रमाणि प्रातर् अपवर्गाणि ।
25.7.235.m: Now, these vows of consecration begin in the evening and end in the morning;
and those of the upasads begin in the morning and end in the evening.

25.7.235.s: athedaṃ daikṣaṃ vrataṃ pariśrityaiva vratayet | āhavanīya evaitat purāgnihotram̐ hūyate sa mānuṣyāsyatīti ||
25.7.235.d: अथेदं दैक्षं व्रतं परिश्रित्यैव व्रतयेत् । आहवनीय एवैतत् पुराग्निहोत्रँ हूयते स मानुष्यास्यतीति ॥
25.7.235.m: Now, having enclosed [the space], he should partake of this consecration fast-milk: 'Before the agnihotra is offered, this is offered in the āhavanīya fire; it will become human [food].'

25.8.236.s: athāyaṃ prāyaṇīyas tasya kaḥ karmaṇa upakramo bhavatīti
25.8.236.d: अथायं प्रायणीयस् तस्य कः कर्मण उपक्रमो भवतीति
25.8.236.m: Now, this introductory offering: what is the beginning of its procedure?

25.8.236.s: barhiryajuṣā kuryād yadi purastād ayajuṣkṛtam̐ syāt pāṇī saṃmṛśīta
25.8.236.d: बर्हिर्यजुषा कुर्याद् यदि पुरस्ताद् अयजुष्कृतँ स्यात् पाणी संमृशीत
25.8.236.m: He should prepare the sacrificial grass with a ritual formula if previously it was done without a formula. He should cleanse his hands.

25.8.236.s: paristṛṇīyāt pātrāṇi nirṇijya sam̐sādayet | brahmāṇaṃ dakṣiṇata upaveśyātraivottarata udapātraṃ nidhāya jaghanena gārhaptayam̐ sphyaṃ nidadhyāt
25.8.236.d: परिस्तृणीयात् पात्राणि निर्णिज्य सँसादयेत् । ब्रह्माणं दक्षिणत उपवेश्यात्रैवोत्तरत उदपात्रं निधाय जघनेन गार्हप्तयँ स्फ्यं निदध्यात्
25.8.236.m: He should strew [grass] around. Having cleansed the vessels, he should set them down. Having seated the brahman to the south, having placed the water vessel right here to the north, he should set down the wooden sword behind the gārhapatya fire.

25.8.236.s: sphyopari pātrīm | pātryāṃ vrīhīn āvapet | śūrpādānaprabhṛti karmāntas tāyata ā praskandanāt
25.8.236.d: स्फ्योपरि पात्रीम् । पात्र्यां व्रीहीन् आवपेत् । शूर्पादानप्रभृति कर्मान्तस् तायत आ प्रस्कन्दनात्
25.8.236.m: [He places] the vessel on top of the wooden sword. / He should pour the rice into the vessel. / Beginning with the taking of the winnowing basket, the ritual performance extends up to the leaping forth [of the grain].

25.8.236.s: praskandanāntaṃ karma kṛtvāhavanīye sruvāhutim̐ hutvopaniṣkramya saṃpraiṣam uktvābhiprapadya tiraḥ pavitram apa ānīyādhiśritya tiraḥ pavitraṃ taṇḍulān āvapet |
25.8.236.d: प्रस्कन्दनान्तं कर्म कृत्वाहवनीये स्रुवाहुतिँ हुत्वोपनिष्क्रम्य संप्रैषम् उक्त्वाभिप्रपद्य तिरः पवित्रम् अप आनीयाधिश्रित्य तिरः पवित्रं तण्डुलान् आवपेत् ।
25.8.236.m: Having performed the rites ending with the leaping forth, having offered a ladle libation into the āhavanīya fire, having stepped out, having uttered the direction, having approached, having poured water across the purifier, [and] having placed [the cooking vessel] on [the fire], he should pour in the husked rice grains across the purifier.

25.8.236.s: athājyam adhiśrayet | ubhayaṃ paryagni kṛtvā sphyahastaḥ prāṅ etya stambayajur haret
25.8.236.d: अथाज्यम् अधिश्रयेत् । उभयं पर्यग्नि कृत्वा स्फ्यहस्तः प्राङ् एत्य स्तम्बयजुर् हरेत्
25.8.236.m: Then he should place the clarified butter on [the fire]. / Having carried fire around both, holding the wooden sword in hand, stepping eastward, he should carry the grass-clod spell.

25.8.236.s: siddham ata ūrdhvam | śaṃyvantaḥ prāyaṇīyaḥ saṃtiṣṭhate
25.8.236.d: सिद्धम् अत ऊर्ध्वम् । शंय्वन्तः प्रायणीयः संतिष्ठते
25.8.236.m: From here onwards it is established. / The introductory rite concludes ending with the śaṃyu [recitation].

25.8.236.s: ko nu khalv asya karmaṇo 'vaśeṣo bhavatīti | ā srucāṃ vimokāt | na caruhaviṣām āpyaninayanaṃ vidyata iti
25.8.236.d: को नु खल्व् अस्य कर्मणो ऽवशेषो भवतीति । आ स्रुचां विमोकात् । न चरुहविषाम् आप्यनिनयनं विद्यत इति
25.8.236.m: "What indeed is the remainder of this rite?" / Up to the unyoking of the ladles. / "There is no pouring of the water-cleansing of the caru oblations."

25.8.236.s: sthālībhiś caiva caruṃ nirvaped iti nu baudhāyanasya kalpaḥ
25.8.236.d: स्थालीभिश् चैव चरुं निर्वपेद् इति नु बौधायनस्य कल्पः
25.8.236.m: And he should portion out the caru using pots—such is Baudhāyana's procedure.
"To what deity does the footprint-offering belong?"

25.8.236.s: āgneyīty eke vaiṣṇavīty eke prājāpatyety eke
25.8.236.d: आग्नेयीत्य् एके वैष्णवीत्य् एके प्राजापत्येत्य् एके
25.8.236.m: "To Agni," say some; / "to Viṣṇu," say some; / "to Prajāpati," say some.

25.8.236.s: vāgdevatyety eva brūyāt kṛṣṇayorṇāstukayā somavikrayiṇam antareṇa bhrūmake vidhyati
25.8.236.d: वाग्देवत्येत्य् एव ब्रूयात् कृष्णयोर्णास्तुकया सोमविक्रयिणम् अन्तरेण भ्रूमके विध्यति
25.8.236.m: He should just say: "To the deity Speech." / With a tuft of black wool he pierces the soma-seller between the eyebrows.

25.9.237.s: vayaḥ suparṇā upasedur indram ity etayā | atha yadi na somavikrayī syād agreṇa yūpāvaṭakālaṃ palāśaśākhāṃ nihatya samupanahya rājānaṃ palāśaśākhāyām̐ samāsajyopāsīta |
25.9.237.d: वयः सुपर्णा उपसेदुर् इन्द्रम् इत्य् एतया । अथ यदि न सोमविक्रयी स्याद् अग्रेण यूपावटकालं पलाशशाखां निहत्य समुपनह्य राजानं पलाशशाखायाँ समासज्योपासीत ।
25.9.237.m: With [the verse], "The birds of beautiful wings have approached Indra..." / Now, if there should be no soma-seller, having struck a palāśa branch into the ground in front of the place of the sacrificial post's pit, having tied King [Soma] together, having hung him upon the palāśa branch, he should sit by [him].

25.9.237.s: atha yadi kaścit prasavasaṃyuktaṃ vyāharet kṣipram iti vā tvaradhvam iti vā kuruta | iti vā tad rājānam ādadīta
25.9.237.d: अथ यदि कश्चित् प्रसवसंयुक्तं व्याहरेत् क्षिप्रम् इति वा त्वरध्वम् इति वा कुरुत । इति वा तद् राजानम् आददीत
25.9.237.m: Then, if anyone should utter an expression connected with impulse, either "Quickly!" or "Hasten!" or "Do it!", at that he should take King [Soma].

25.9.237.s: na saṃvādā āvarteran sa somavikrayī syāt | atheyaṃ prathamā subrahmaṇyoṃkārāntaivaiṣoktā bhavati |
25.9.237.d: न संवादा आवर्तेरन् स सोमविक्रयी स्यात् । अथेयं प्रथमा सुब्रह्मण्योंकारान्तैवैषोक्ता भवति ।
25.9.237.m: The negotiations should not be repeated; / he would be the soma-seller. / Now this first Subrahmaṇyā [chant] is declared as ending with the syllable om.

25.9.237.s: athāyam ātithyas tasya kaḥ karmaṇa upakramo bhavatīti
25.9.237.d: अथायम् आतिथ्यस् तस्य कः कर्मण उपक्रमो भवतीति
25.9.237.m: Now this guest-offering: / "What is the beginning of its performance?"

25.9.237.s: barhiryajuṣā kuryād yadi purastād ayajuṣkṛtam̐ syāt
25.9.237.d: बर्हिर्यजुषा कुर्याद् यदि पुरस्ताद् अयजुष्कृतँ स्यात्
25.9.237.m: He should prepare the sacrificial grass with a sacrificial formula if previously it was not prepared with a formula.

25.9.237.s: pāṇī saṃmṛśīta paristṛṇīyāt pātrāṇi nirṇijya sam̐sādayet |
25.9.237.d: पाणी संमृशीत परिस्तृणीयात् पात्राणि निर्णिज्य सँसादयेत् ।
25.9.237.m: He should rub his hands together; / he should strew [the grass around]; / having washed the vessels, he should set them down.

25.9.237.s: brahmāṇaṃ dakṣiṇata upaveśya dakṣiṇam anaḍvāhaṃ vimucyātraivottarata udapātraṃ nidhāya jaghanena gārhapatyam̐ sphyaṃ nidadhyāt
25.9.237.d: ब्रह्माणं दक्षिणत उपवेश्य दक्षिणम् अनड्वाहं विमुच्यात्रैवोत्तरत उदपात्रं निधाय जघनेन गार्हपत्यँ स्फ्यं निदध्यात्
25.9.237.m: Having seated the brahman priest to the south, having unyoked the southern ox, having placed the water vessel right here to the north, he should set down the wooden sword behind the gārhapatya fire.

25.9.237.s: sphopari pātrīm | pātryāṃ vrīhīn āvapet | śūrpādānaprabhṛti karmāntas tāyata ā praskandanāt
25.9.237.d: स्फोपरि पात्रीम् । पात्र्यां व्रीहीन् आवपेत् । शूर्पादानप्रभृति कर्मान्तस् तायत आ प्रस्कन्दनात्
25.9.237.m: [He places] the vessel on top of the wooden sword. / He should pour the rice into the vessel. / Beginning with the taking of the winnowing basket, the ritual performance extends up to the leaping forth [of the grain].

25.9.237.s: praskandanāntaṃ karma kṛtvottaram anaḍvāhaṃ vimucya rājānaṃ prapādayet
25.9.237.d: प्रस्कन्दनान्तं कर्म कृत्वोत्तरम् अनड्वाहं विमुच्य राजानं प्रपादयेत्
25.9.237.m: Having performed the rites ending with the leaping forth, having unyoked the northern ox, he should bring King [Soma] forward.

25.9.237.s: siddham atrāgniṣṭomikaṃ karma jānīyād ā saṃpraiṣāt
25.9.237.d: सिद्धम् अत्राग्निष्टोमिकं कर्म जानीयाद् आ संप्रैषात्
25.9.237.m: He should know that the rite belonging to the agniṣṭoma is established here up to the direction.
He undertakes the guest-offering solely with the shaking out of the black antelope skin.

25.10.237.s: sa darbhapuñjīlam udvṛhyeti katarann u khalv idaṃ darbhapuñjīlaṃ bhavatīti
25.10.237.d: स दर्भपुञ्जीलम् उद्वृह्येति कतरन्न् उ खल्व् इदं दर्भपुञ्जीलं भवतीति
25.10.237.m: [Regarding the passage,] "Having pulled out that bunch of darbha grass...": / "Which one indeed is this bunch of darbha grass?"

25.10.237.s: yad evaitad godānayor nidadhātīti sapta girīn bhittveti
25.10.237.d: यद् एवैतद् गोदानयोर् निदधातीति सप्त गिरीन् भित्त्वेति
25.10.237.m: "Just that which he places in the two tufts of hair at the side of the head." / [Regarding the passage,] "Having cleft the seven mountains...":

25.10.237.s: katame nu khalv ime girayo bhavantīti prayājānūyājā evaitā uktā bhavantīti dīkṣaṇīyāyāḥ prāyaṇīyāyā ātithyāyā agnīṣomīyasyeti |
25.10.237.d: कतमे नु खल्व् इमे गिरयो भवन्तीति प्रयाजानूयाजा एवैता उक्ता भवन्तीति दीक्षणीयायाः प्रायणीयाया आतिथ्याया अग्नीषोमीयस्येति ।
25.10.237.m: "Which indeed are these mountains?" / "These are declared to be the fore-offerings and after-offerings of the consecration ceremony, of the introductory rite, of the guest-offering, and of the animal sacrifice to Agni-Soma."

25.10.238.s: athāpy udāharanti dīkṣaṇīyā prāyaṇīyātithyopasado 'gnīṣomīyaḥ saptama iti
25.10.238.d: अथाप्य् उदाहरन्ति दीक्षणीया प्रायणीयातिथ्योपसदो ऽग्नीषोमीयः सप्तम इति
25.10.238.m: Moreover they cite: "The consecration ceremony, the introductory rite, the guest-offering, the upasads, and the animal sacrifice to Agni-Soma as the seventh."
[Regarding the passage,] "The sacrifice hid itself from the gods...":

25.10.238.s: katamo nu khalv ayaṃ yajño bhavatīti ya evaiṣa iḍānta ātithyaḥ saṃtiṣṭhate
25.10.238.d: कतमो नु खल्व् अयं यज्ञो भवतीति य एवैष इडान्त आतिथ्यः संतिष्ठते
25.10.238.m: "Which indeed is this sacrifice?" / "Just this guest-offering which concludes ending with the iḍā."
[Regarding the passage,] "The gods, holding hands, sought it...":

25.10.238.s: yad evaitat tānūnaptram̐ samavamṛśantīti tam indra uparyupary atyakrāmad iti
25.10.238.d: यद् एवैतत् तानूनप्त्रँ समवमृशन्तीति तम् इन्द्र उपर्युपर्य् अत्यक्रामद् इति
25.10.238.m: "Just that they touch together the covenant of Tanūnapāt." / [Regarding the passage,] "Indra stepped over it from above...":

25.10.238.s: yad evaitad upasadbhiś carantīti tam ebhyo yajña eva yajñam āharad iti
25.10.238.d: यद् एवैतद् उपसद्भिश् चरन्तीति तम् एभ्यो यज्ञ एव यज्ञम् आहरद् इति
25.10.238.m: "Just that they perform with the upasads." / [Regarding the passage,] "Sacrifice itself brought sacrifice to them...":

25.10.238.s: katamo nu khalv ayaṃ yajño yajñam āharad iti
25.10.238.d: कतमो नु खल्व् अयं यज्ञो यज्ञम् आहरद् इति
25.10.238.m: "Which indeed is this sacrifice that brought the sacrifice?"

25.10.238.s: dīkṣaṇīyā prāyaṇīyātithyā | eṣa eva yajño yajñam āharad iti
25.10.238.d: दीक्षणीया प्रायणीयातिथ्या । एष एव यज्ञो यज्ञम् आहरद् इति
25.10.238.m: "The consecration ceremony, the introductory rite, [and] the guest-offering— / this very sacrifice brought the sacrifice."

25.10.238.s: varāho 'yaṃ vāmamoṣa iti sutyam ahnāṃ varṣiṣṭham | tad yajamānaṃ vāmaṃ vasu muṣṇātīti
25.10.238.d: वराहो ऽयं वाममोष इति सुत्यम् अह्नां वर्षिष्ठम् । तद् यजमानं वामं वसु मुष्णातीति
25.10.238.m: [Regarding the passage,] "This boar is the stealer of the desirable...": / "The extraction [day] is the longest of the days; / that steals the desirable wealth of the sacrificer."
"What indeed are the after-offerings of the guest-offering?"

25.10.238.s: upasada ity eva brūyāt kiṃdevatyā u khalūpasado bhavantīti |
25.10.238.d: उपसद इत्य् एव ब्रूयात् किंदेवत्या उ खलूपसदो भवन्तीति ।
25.10.238.m: He should just say: "The upasads." / "To what deity do the upasads belong?"

25.10.238.s: āgneyya ity eva brūyāt katham u khalūpasadām upakramo bhavatīti
25.10.238.d: आग्नेय्य इत्य् एव ब्रूयात् कथम् उ खलूपसदाम् उपक्रमो भवतीति
25.10.238.m: He should just say: "To Agni." / "And how indeed is the beginning of the upasads?"

25.10.238.s: barhiryajuṣā kuryād yadi purastād ayajuṣkṛtam̐ syāt pāṇī saṃmṛśīta
25.10.238.d: बर्हिर्यजुषा कुर्याद् यदि पुरस्ताद् अयजुष्कृतँ स्यात् पाणी संमृशीत
25.10.238.m: He should prepare the sacrificial grass with a sacrificial formula if previously it was not prepared with a formula. / He should rub his hands together;

25.10.238.s: paristṛṇīyāt pātrāṇi nirṇijya sam̐sādayet | madantīḥ sam̐skṛtya pātrāṇi prokṣet |
25.10.238.d: परिस्तृणीयात् पात्राणि निर्णिज्य सँसादयेत् । मदन्तीः सँस्कृत्य पात्राणि प्रोक्षेत् ।
25.10.238.m: he should strew [the grass around]; / having washed the vessels, he should set them down; / having prepared the boiling water, he should sprinkle the vessels with water.

25.10.238.s: ājyaṃ nirupyādhiśrityā paryagni kṛtvā sphyahastaḥ prāṅ etya stambayajur haret
25.10.238.d: आज्यं निरुप्याधिश्रित्या पर्यग्नि कृत्वा स्फ्यहस्तः प्राङ् एत्य स्तम्बयजुर् हरेत्
25.10.238.m: Having portioned out the clarified butter, having placed it on [the fire], having carried fire around it, holding the wooden sword in hand, stepping eastward, he should carry the grass-clod spell.

25.10.238.s: siddham ata ūrdhvam | yathā prakṛtyām evaṃ prathamāyām upasadi srucaḥ sādayet |
25.10.238.d: सिद्धम् अत ऊर्ध्वम् । यथा प्रकृत्याम् एवं प्रथमायाम् उपसदि स्रुचः सादयेत् ।
25.10.238.m: From here onwards it is established. / Just as in the archetypal rite, so at the first upasad he should set down the ladles.

25.10.239.m: Pushed forward at the second, pushed further forward at the third.
They should perform with the upasads as if hurrying; they should not care for what is not done.

25.10.239.s: samagrāṅguliḥ sruvam ādāyāsyann ivopasadaṃ juhuyād iti ||
25.10.239.d: समग्राङ्गुलिः स्रुवम् आदायास्यन्न् इवोपसदं जुहुयाद् इति ॥
25.10.239.m: Holding the sruva ladle with all fingers together, he should offer the upasad as if throwing [it] in.

25.11.239.s: kva u khalv agnīṣomīyasya barhiryajuṣā kuryād iti | udvāsya pravargyaṃ prāg āhavanīyasya praṇayanāt
25.11.239.d: क्व उ खल्व् अग्नीषोमीयस्य बर्हिर्यजुषा कुर्याद् इति । उद्वास्य प्रवर्ग्यं प्राग् आहवनीयस्य प्रणयनात्
25.11.239.m: "And where indeed should he prepare the sacrificial grass of the animal sacrifice to Agni-Soma with a sacrificial formula?" / Having removed the pravargya, before the bringing forward of the āhavanīya fire.
And he should bring the calves near for the offerings belonging to the soma pressing.

25.11.239.s: vyavacchinna āhavanīye gārhapatye padatṛtīyam upavaped evam upayamanīṣu |
25.11.239.d: व्यवच्छिन्न आहवनीये गार्हपत्ये पदतृतीयम् उपवपेद् एवम् उपयमनीषु ।
25.11.239.m: When the āhavanīya fire is severed, he should pour a third of a footprint into the gārhapatya fire; likewise into the supporting [fires].

25.11.239.s: atheyam audumbarī sthūṇā yajamānena saṃmitā kāryā bhavati |
25.11.239.d: अथेयम् औदुम्बरी स्थूणा यजमानेन संमिता कार्या भवति ।
25.11.239.m: Now, this post of audumbara wood must be made equal in height to the sacrificer.
Now, this sacrificial post is measured by cubits of the sacrificer.

25.11.239.s: sahopara ity eke | atro haivaitāni kuryād yūpāvaṭaṃ tu parilikhya pāṇī saṃmṛśīta
25.11.239.d: सहोपर इत्य् एके । अत्रो हैवैतानि कुर्याद् यूपावटं तु परिलिख्य पाणी संमृशीत
25.11.239.m: "Together with the unhewn base," say some. / Right at this point he should perform these [rites]; but having marked out the sacrificial post's pit, he should rub his hands together;
he should strew [the grass around]; / having washed the vessels, he should set them down;

25.11.239.s: prokṣaṇīḥ sam̐skṛtya pātrāṇi prokṣet | ājyaṃ nirupyādhiśritya paryagni kṛtvā srucaḥ saṃmārṣṭi
25.11.239.d: प्रोक्षणीः सँस्कृत्य पात्राणि प्रोक्षेत् । आज्यं निरुप्याधिश्रित्य पर्यग्नि कृत्वा स्रुचः संमार्ष्टि
25.11.239.m: having prepared the sprinkling waters, he should sprinkle the vessels with water; / having portioned out the clarified butter, having placed it on [the fire], having carried fire around it, he wipes clean the ladles.
They carry them and the sprinkling waters to the high altar.
Then the pratiprasthātṛ priest should gird the sacrificer's wife with the cord for the cake-offering.

25.11.240.s: athaināṃ gārhapatyam īkṣayet | athainām ājyam avekṣayitvājyenādravet
25.11.240.d: अथैनां गार्हपत्यम् ईक्षयेत् । अथैनाम् आज्यम् अवेक्षयित्वाज्येनाद्रवेत्
25.11.240.m: Then he should make her look at the gārhapatya fire. / Then, having made her look at the clarified butter, he should run with the clarified butter.

25.11.240.s: patnyā tad avekṣitam upayacchīta tejo 'si | iti | athainac chakalenopayatya haret tejo 'nu prehi | iti |
25.11.240.d: पत्न्या तद् अवेक्षितम् उपयच्छीत तेजो ऽसि । इति । अथैनच् छकलेनोपयत्य हरेत् तेजो ऽनु प्रेहि । इति ।
25.11.240.m: He should take hold of that which has been looked at by the wife, with [the formula], "You are splendor." / Then, supporting it with a chip of wood, he should carry it, with [the formula], "Go after the splendor."

25.11.240.s: athainad āhavanīye 'dhiśrayet | agnis te tejo mā vinait | iti |
25.11.240.d: अथैनद् आहवनीये ऽधिश्रयेत् । अग्निस् ते तेजो मा विनैत् । इति ।
25.11.240.m: Then he should place it on the āhavanīya fire, with [the formula], "May Agni not depart from your splendor."

25.11.240.s: athainad dhṛtvottareṇa prokṣaṇīḥ sādayitvāvekṣetotpunuyād ājyavatībhyāṃ prokṣaṇīḥ
25.11.240.d: अथैनद् धृत्वोत्तरेण प्रोक्षणीः सादयित्वावेक्षेतोत्पुनुयाद् आज्यवतीभ्यां प्रोक्षणीः
25.11.240.m: Then, having taken it, having placed it to the north of the sprinkling waters, he should look at [it]; he should purify the sprinkling waters with two [strainers] containing clarified butter.
It is well known: "In the presence of the āhavanīya fire, he should draw the clarified portions of butter accompanied by spotted butter."

25.11.240.s: siddham ata ūrdhvam | yatho etac chālīkeḥ kalpaṃ vedayante patnīśāla evāgnīṣomasyājyāni gṛhṇīyāt tāni khare sādayed iti
25.11.240.d: सिद्धम् अत ऊर्ध्वम् । यथो एतच् छालीकेः कल्पं वेदयन्ते पत्नीशाल एवाग्नीषोमस्याज्यानि गृह्णीयात् तानि खरे सादयेद् इति
25.11.240.m: Established from this point onward. / Now, as they report this procedure of Śālīki: 'He should draw the clarified butter portions of the Agnīṣoma [animal sacrifice] right in the hall of the wife, [and] set them down on the mound.'

25.11.240.s: samanvānīya vāsam anvānīya vā purāṇagārhapatyaṃ pāṇī saṃmṛśīta
25.11.240.d: समन्वानीय वासम् अन्वानीय वा पुराणगार्हपत्यं पाणी संमृशीत
25.11.240.m: Having added fuel together or having added fuel after the clothing, he touches his hands over the ancient gārhapatya fire.
He should strew [grass] around. / Having rinsed the vessels, he should arrange them.
Having prepared the sprinkling waters, he should sprinkle the vessels.

25.11.240.s: ājyaṃ nirupyādhiśritya paryagni kṛtvā srucaḥ saṃmārṣṭi tā atraiva saha sam̐sādayanti prokṣaṇīś ca
25.11.240.d: आज्यं निरुप्याधिश्रित्य पर्यग्नि कृत्वा स्रुचः संमार्ष्टि ता अत्रैव सह सँसादयन्ति प्रोक्षणीश् च
25.11.240.m: Having ladled out the clarified butter, placed it on the fire, and carried fire around it, he wipes the ladles. / They set them down together right there, as well as the sprinkling waters.
The pratiprasthātṛ priest should not gird the wife according to the procedure of the cake-offering.

25.11.240.s: naināṃ gārhapatyam īkṣayet | athainām ājyam avekṣayitvājyenādravet
25.11.240.d: नैनां गार्हपत्यम् ईक्षयेत् । अथैनाम् आज्यम् अवेक्षयित्वाज्येनाद्रवेत्
25.11.240.m: He should not make her gaze at the gārhapatya fire. / Then, having made her gaze at the clarified butter, he should run forward with the clarified butter.

25.11.240.s: patnyā tad avekṣitam upayacchīta tejo 'si | iti |
25.11.240.d: पत्न्या तद् अवेक्षितम् उपयच्छीत तेजो ऽसि । इति ।
25.11.240.m: He should support that [clarified butter] gazed upon by the wife, with: 'You are brilliance.'

25.11.240.s: athainac chakalenopayatya haret tejo 'nu prehi | iti | athainad gārhapatye 'dhiśrayet | agnis te tejo mā vinait | iti |
25.11.240.d: अथैनच् छकलेनोपयत्य हरेत् तेजो ऽनु प्रेहि । इति । अथैनद् गार्हपत्ये ऽधिश्रयेत् । अग्निस् ते तेजो मा विनैत् । इति ।
25.11.240.m: Then, having supported it with a wood splinter, he should carry it, with: 'Follow the brilliance.' / Then he should set it upon the gārhapatya fire, with: 'May Agni not take away your brilliance.'

25.11.240.s: athainad dhṛtvottareṇa prokṣaṇīḥ sādayitvāvekṣetotpunuyād ājyavatībhyāṃ prokṣaṇīḥ prasiddhaṃ gārhapatyasakāśe pṛṣadājyavantyājyāni gṛhītvā ||
25.11.240.d: अथैनद् धृत्वोत्तरेण प्रोक्षणीः सादयित्वावेक्षेतोत्पुनुयाद् आज्यवतीभ्यां प्रोक्षणीः प्रसिद्धं गार्हपत्यसकाशे पृषदाज्यवन्त्याज्यानि गृहीत्वा ॥
25.11.240.m: Then, holding it, having placed it north of the sprinkling waters, he should gaze at it and purify the sprinkling waters with two [purifiers] containing clarified butter; having drawn the clarified butter portions accompanied by clotted butter in the usual manner in the presence of the gārhapatya fire—

25.12.241.s: parikramibhya utpradāya brahmaṇe rājānam utprayacchet saṃpracchanneṣu sruvāhutī juhuyāt
25.12.241.d: परिक्रमिभ्य उत्प्रदाय ब्रह्मणे राजानम् उत्प्रयच्छेत् संप्रच्छन्नेषु स्रुवाहुती जुहुयात्
25.12.241.m: having handed [them] over to the attendants, he should deliver King [Soma] to the Brahman priest. / While they are covered, he should offer ladle libations.

25.12.241.s: saṃpracchannāś caiva gaccheyur āhavanīyāt | rājā dakṣiṇārdhyaḥ syād athāgnir atha grāvovāyavyāny uttarārdhyāny ājyāni |
25.12.241.d: संप्रच्छन्नाश् चैव गच्छेयुर् आहवनीयात् । राजा दक्षिणार्ध्यः स्याद् अथाग्निर् अथ ग्रावोवायव्यान्य् उत्तरार्ध्यान्य् आज्यानि ।
25.12.241.m: And covered, they should proceed from the āhavanīya fire. / King [Soma] should be on the southern side, then the fire, then the pressing stones and vāyavya vessels, [and] the clarified butters on the northern side.

25.12.241.s: api vāgnir dakṣiṇārdhyaḥ syād atha rājātha grāvovāyavyāny uttarārdhyāny evājyāni
25.12.241.d: अपि वाग्निर् दक्षिणार्ध्यः स्याद् अथ राजाथ ग्रावोवायव्यान्य् उत्तरार्ध्यान्य् एवाज्यानि
25.12.241.m: Or rather, the fire should be on the southern side, then King [Soma], then the pressing stones and vāyavya vessels, and the clarified butters on the northern side.

25.12.241.s: pūrvayā dvāropaniṣkramyottareṇa sadaḥ parītyāgnīdhrāgāre 'gniṃ nidhāyābhihutya prokṣaṇīhasta uttareṇāgnīdhrīyaṃ dhiṣṇiyaṃ pratipadyate |
25.12.241.d: पूर्वया द्वारोपनिष्क्रम्योत्तरेण सदः परीत्याग्नीध्रागारे ऽग्निं निधायाभिहुत्य प्रोक्षणीहस्त उत्तरेणाग्नीध्रीयं धिष्णियं प्रतिपद्यते ।
25.12.241.m: Having stepped out by the eastern door, having walked around north of the sadas shed, having deposited the fire in the shed of the āgnīdhra priest and offered upon it, holding the sprinkling water in hand, he arrives north of the āgnīdhrīya side-hearth.

25.12.241.s: anvañca ājyais | āhavanīye hutvedhmaṃ prokṣya vediṃ prokṣya barhiḥ prokṣya barhirāsannaṃ prokṣyopaninīya purastād āśvavālaṃ prastaraṃ gṛhītvā pañcavidhaṃ barhi stīrtvā prastarapāṇiḥ prāṅ abhisṛpya kārṣmayamayān paridhīn paridhāyordhve samidhāv abhyādhāya barhirmuṣṭiṃ vidhṛtī prastaram ity etat samādāya pradakṣiṇam āvṛtya pūrvayā dvārā havirdhānaṃ prapadyottarārdhe kharasya barhirmuṣṭim̐ stṛṇīyāt |
25.12.241.d: अन्वञ्च आज्यैस् । आहवनीये हुत्वेध्मं प्रोक्ष्य वेदिं प्रोक्ष्य बर्हिः प्रोक्ष्य बर्हिरासन्नं प्रोक्ष्योपनिनीय पुरस्ताद् आश्ववालं प्रस्तरं गृहीत्वा पञ्चविधं बर्हि स्तीर्त्वा प्रस्तरपाणिः प्राङ् अभिसृप्य कार्ष्मयमयान् परिधीन् परिधायोर्ध्वे समिधाव् अभ्याधाय बर्हिर्मुष्टिं विधृती प्रस्तरम् इत्य् एतत् समादाय प्रदक्षिणम् आवृत्य पूर्वया द्वारा हविर्धानं प्रपद्योत्तरार्धे खरस्य बर्हिर्मुष्टिँ स्तृणीयात् ।
25.12.241.m: Behind him [they follow] with the clarified butters. / Having offered into the āhavanīya fire, having sprinkled the kindling wood, having sprinkled the altar, having sprinkled the sacrificial grass, having sprinkled the sacrificial grass set down, having poured [water] down in front, having taken the horse-tail grass bundle, having spread the fivefold sacrificial grass, moving eastward with the grass bundle in hand, having laid down the enclosing sticks made of kārṣmarya wood, having placed two upright kindling sticks, having taken up the handful of sacrificial grass, the two dividing blades, and the grass bundle, having turned clockwise, having entered the havirdhāna shed by the eastern door, he should spread the handful of sacrificial grass on the northern half of the mound.
[He places] the two dividing blades on the sacrificial grass; / the horse-tail grass bundle on the two dividing blades;

25.12.241.s: prastare juhūm | barhiṣītarās | etā asadan | iti samabhimṛśyāpa upaspṛśya brahmaṇo rājānam ādāya pūrvayā dvārā havirdhānaṃ prapādayed ātmānam abhipariharamāṇa iva
25.12.241.d: प्रस्तरे जुहूम् । बर्हिषीतरास् । एता असदन् । इति समभिमृश्याप उपस्पृश्य ब्रह्मणो राजानम् आदाय पूर्वया द्वारा हविर्धानं प्रपादयेद् आत्मानम् अभिपरिहरमाण इव
25.12.241.m: the juhū ladle on the grass bundle; / the other [ladles] on the sacrificial grass. / Having touched them together with 'These have sat down,' having touched water, having taken King [Soma] from the Brahman priest, he should bring him into the havirdhāna shed by the eastern door, as if carrying him around his own body.

25.13.242.s: kva u khalu śilpavad idhmābarhir apavargaṃ gacchatīti | agnīṣomīya ity eva brūyāt
25.13.242.d: क्व उ खलु शिल्पवद् इध्माबर्हिर् अपवर्गं गच्छतीति । अग्नीषोमीय इत्य् एव ब्रूयात्
25.13.242.m: 'Where, indeed, does the kindling wood and sacrificial grass end with the artistic work?' / One should say: 'In the Agnīṣomīya [animal sacrifice].'

25.13.242.s: kva u khalv agnīṣomīyaḥ sutyam ahar anusametīti
25.13.242.d: क्व उ खल्व् अग्नीषोमीयः सुत्यम् अहर् अनुसमेतीति
25.13.242.m: 'Where, indeed, does the Agnīṣomīya [rite] accompany the day of soma-pressing?'

25.13.242.s: sadyaskriyām ity eva brūyāt kva u khalu pravargyaḥ sutyam ahar anusametīti
25.13.242.d: सद्यस्क्रियाम् इत्य् एव ब्रूयात् क्व उ खलु प्रवर्ग्यः सुत्यम् अहर् अनुसमेतीति
25.13.242.m: One should say: 'In the sadyaskri rite.' / 'Where, indeed, does the pravargya rite accompany the day of soma-pressing?'

25.13.242.s: sadyaskriyāmityeva brūyāt kā u khalu devatā subrahmaṇyā prathamāhūyata iti
25.13.242.d: सद्यस्क्रियामित्येव ब्रूयात् का उ खलु देवता सुब्रह्मण्या प्रथमाहूयत इति
25.13.242.m: One should say: 'In the sadyaskri rite.' / 'Which deity, indeed, is called first in the subrahmaṇyā formula?'

25.13.242.s: vāg eva vācam āhvayatīti kva u khalu pitāputrīyā subrahmaṇyā prathamāhūyata iti |
25.13.242.d: वाग् एव वाचम् आह्वयतीति क्व उ खलु पितापुत्रीया सुब्रह्मण्या प्रथमाहूयत इति ।
25.13.242.m: [The answer is:] 'Speech indeed calls speech.' / 'Where, indeed, is the subrahmaṇyā formula with father and son called first?'

25.13.242.s: agnīṣomīyasya hutāyāṃ vapāyāṃ parihṛtāsu vasatīvarīṣu dvitīyā
25.13.242.d: अग्नीषोमीयस्य हुतायां वपायां परिहृतासु वसतीवरीषु द्वितीया
25.13.242.m: 'When the omentum of the Agnīṣomīya [victim] has been offered; the second when the vasatīvarī waters have been carried around;

25.13.242.s: prātaranuvāke tṛtīyā dakṣiṇānām u ha kāla eka āhvayantīti |
25.13.242.d: प्रातरनुवाके तृतीया दक्षिणानाम् उ ह काल एक आह्वयन्तीति ।
25.13.242.m: the third at the morning recitation.' / And some call it at the time of the priestly gifts.

25.13.242.s: atha yo vīḍitaḥ kumbhastaṃ yācatīti dṛḍha ity evedam uktaṃ bhavati
25.13.242.d: अथ यो वीडितः कुम्भस्तं याचतीति दृढ इत्य् एवेदम् उक्तं भवति
25.13.242.m: Now, as to [the text]: 'He asks for the pitcher that is firm,' 'firm' indeed is what is meant here.

25.13.242.s: payaś ca saktūm̐ś ca kuruta | iti śrayaṇārthe evaite ukte bhavatas |
25.13.242.d: पयश् च सक्तूँश् च कुरुत । इति श्रयणार्थे एवैते उक्ते भवतस् ।
25.13.242.m: As to: 'Prepare milk and barley flour,' these two are spoken of only for the sake of mixing.

25.13.242.s: catasro raśanāścatasro vapāśrapaṇīrdvayamidhmābarhiriti savanīyasya cānūbandhyasya caitāni bhavanti
25.13.242.d: चतस्रो रशनाश्चतस्रो वपाश्रपणीर्द्वयमिध्माबर्हिरिति सवनीयस्य चानूबन्ध्यस्य चैतानि भवन्ति
25.13.242.m: Four ropes, four omentum-cooking forks, two sets of kindling wood and sacrificial grass: these belong to the animal offering of the soma day and to the anūbandhyā cow.

25.13.242.s: kāś catasra sthālīr vāyavyāḥ somagrahaṇīr iti |
25.13.242.d: काश् चतस्र स्थालीर् वायव्याः सोमग्रहणीर् इति ।
25.13.242.m: Which are the four pots, the vāyavya vessels used for drawing soma?
The āditya pot, the ukthya pot, the āgrayaṇa pot, [and] the dhruva pot.

25.13.242.s: athemāni dvādaśordhvapātrāṇi bhavanti dadhigrahapātram apām̐śvantaryāmayor dvidevatyānām̐ śukrāmanthinor ṛtupātre ādityasthālyā aupaśayaṃ pātram ukthyasthālyā aupaśayaṃ pātram
25.13.242.d: अथेमानि द्वादशोर्ध्वपात्राणि भवन्ति दधिग्रहपात्रम् अपाँश्वन्तर्यामयोर् द्विदेवत्यानाँ शुक्रामन्थिनोर् ऋतुपात्रे आदित्यस्थाल्या औपशयं पात्रम् उक्थ्यस्थाल्या औपशयं पात्रम्
25.13.242.m: Then these are the twelve upright vessels: the vessel for the dadhigraha, the two vessels for the upāṃśu and antaryāma cups, [those] for the cups dedicated to two deities, the two vessels for the śukra and manthin cups, the two ṛtu vessels, the secondary vessel for the āditya pot, [and] the secondary vessel for the ukthya pot.

25.13.243.s: athema ekādaśa camasā bhavanti yajamānasya brahmaṇo hotur udgātur maitrāvaruṇasya brāhmaṇāccham̐sino 'cchāvākasya sadasyasyāgnīdhaḥ potur neṣṭur iti
25.13.243.d: अथेम एकादश चमसा भवन्ति यजमानस्य ब्रह्मणो होतुर् उद्गातुर् मैत्रावरुणस्य ब्राह्मणाच्छँसिनो ऽच्छावाकस्य सदस्यस्याग्नीधः पोतुर् नेष्टुर् इति
25.13.243.m: Now these eleven soma-cups are: for the sacrificer, the brahman, the hotṛ priest, the udgātṛ, the maitrāvaruṇa, the brāhmaṇācchaṃsin, the acchāvāka, the sadasya, the āgnīdhra, the potṛ, and the neṣṭṛ.
One should have their handles made uniform, out of nyagrodha wood.

25.13.243.s: vijñāyate | uttarasyāṃ tatau yad atsarukaiś camasair bhakṣayanti nyagrodhacamasais | iti |
25.13.243.d: विज्ञायते । उत्तरस्यां ततौ यद् अत्सरुकैश् चमसैर् भक्षयन्ति न्यग्रोधचमसैस् । इति ।
25.13.243.m: It is taught [in the brāhmaṇa passage]: 'When at the later sacrifice they consume with handleless cups, with nyagrodha cups.'

25.13.243.s: etasmān naiyagrodhā eva bhavanti raśmiś ca me | ity adābhya evaiṣa ukto bhavati |
25.13.243.d: एतस्मान् नैयग्रोधा एव भवन्ति रश्मिश् च मे । इत्य् अदाभ्य एवैष उक्तो भवति ।
25.13.243.m: Therefore, they are made only of nyagrodha wood. / By [the formula] 'And my ray,' it is the adābhya cup alone that is spoken of.

25.13.243.s: adhipatiś ca me | iti prājāpatya eṣa dadhigraho bhavati
25.13.243.d: अधिपतिश् च मे । इति प्राजापत्य एष दधिग्रहो भवति
25.13.243.m: By [the formula] 'And my overlord,' it is this curd-graha belonging to Prajāpati.

25.13.243.s: sārasvataś ca me pauṣṇaś ca me | iti vasatīvarīr ity eka āhus |
25.13.243.d: सारस्वतश् च मे पौष्णश् च मे । इति वसतीवरीर् इत्य् एक आहुस् ।
25.13.243.m: By 'And mine belonging to Sarasvat' and 'And mine belonging to Pūṣan,' some say it is the vasatīvarī waters.

25.13.243.s: atha haika āhū rājasūyika eṣa mahāgraho bhavati
25.13.243.d: अथ हैक आहू राजसूयिक एष महाग्रहो भवति
25.13.243.m: Then some say it is this great cup pertaining to the rājasūya.

25.13.243.s: poṣaṇād u ha pauṣṇo bhavati grahaṇād u sārasvata iti ||
25.13.243.d: पोषणाद् उ ह पौष्णो भवति ग्रहणाद् उ सारस्वत इति ॥
25.13.243.m: From nourishment it is indeed belonging to Pūṣan, and from seizing it is belonging to Sarasvat.

25.14.243.s: athedaṃ mahārātrikaṃ karma tasya kaḥ karmaṇa upakramo bhavatīti
25.14.243.d: अथेदं महारात्रिकं कर्म तस्य कः कर्मण उपक्रमो भवतीति
25.14.243.m: Now this rite of the late night: / what is the beginning of that rite?

25.14.243.s: hastapādān prakṣālyāntareṇa cātvālotkarau devayajanam abhi prapadyante
25.14.243.d: हस्तपादान् प्रक्षाल्यान्तरेण चात्वालोत्करौ देवयजनम् अभि प्रपद्यन्ते
25.14.243.m: Having washed hands and feet, they enter the sacrificial ground between the cātvāla pit and the utkara mound.
Their duties are prescribed in accordance with the direction.

25.14.243.s: athādhvaryur āgneyyarcāgnīdhram abhimṛśed vaiṣṇavyā havirdhānam iti | athaiṣa āgnīdhraḥ pūrvaḥ patnīśālaṃ drutvāgnīn upasamādhāya saṃparistīrya pātrāṇi nirṇijya sam̐sādyājyaṃ vilāpyopāste |
25.14.243.d: अथाध्वर्युर् आग्नेय्यर्चाग्नीध्रम् अभिमृशेद् वैष्णव्या हविर्धानम् इति । अथैष आग्नीध्रः पूर्वः पत्नीशालं द्रुत्वाग्नीन् उपसमाधाय संपरिस्तीर्य पात्राणि निर्णिज्य सँसाद्याज्यं विलाप्योपास्ते ।
25.14.243.m: Then the adhvaryu priest touches the āgnīdhra shed with a verse addressed to Agni, and the havirdhāna shed with one addressed to Viṣṇu. / Then this āgnīdhra priest, having run ahead to the patnīśālā shed, having added fuel to the fire, having spread around [grass], having cleansed the vessels, having placed them, and having melted the clarified butter, sits by.

25.14.244.s: aparaḥ pratiprasthātā prokṣaṇīḥ sam̐skṛtya pātrāṇi prokṣet | ājyaṃ nirupyādhiśritya paryagni kṛtvā srucaḥ saṃmārṣṭi
25.14.244.d: अपरः प्रतिप्रस्थाता प्रोक्षणीः सँस्कृत्य पात्राणि प्रोक्षेत् । आज्यं निरुप्याधिश्रित्य पर्यग्नि कृत्वा स्रुचः संमार्ष्टि
25.14.244.m: The other, the pratiprasthātṛ priest, having prepared the sprinkling waters, sprinkles the vessels. / Having poured out the clarified butter, placed it on the fire, and carried fire around it, he wipes the ladles.
They carry them to the uttaravedi, and also the sprinkling waters.
Then the adhvaryu priest touches the ladles with a verse addressed to Agni.

25.14.244.s: saṃmṛṣṭāni dvidhā pātrāṇy abhimrakṣyanta iti vāyavyayā vāyavyāny aindryā sadas |
25.14.244.d: संमृष्टानि द्विधा पात्राण्य् अभिम्रक्ष्यन्त इति वायव्यया वायव्यान्य् ऐन्द्र्या सदस् ।
25.14.244.m: The wiped vessels will be touched in two ways: / the vāyavya vessels with a verse addressed to Vāyu, the sadas shed with one addressed to Indra.

25.14.244.s: athaiṣa unnetā grāvovāyavyam̐ saṃprakṣālya droṇakalaśe daśāpavitre samavadhāya dakṣiṇasya havirdhānasya puro'kṣam̐ sam̐sādayati |
25.14.244.d: अथैष उन्नेता ग्रावोवायव्यँ संप्रक्षाल्य द्रोणकलशे दशापवित्रे समवधाय दक्षिणस्य हविर्धानस्य पुरोऽक्षँ सँसादयति ।
25.14.244.m: Then this unnetṛ priest, having washed the press-stone and the vāyavya vessels and having placed the fringe-strainer into the droṇakalaśa trough, sets it down before the axle of the southern havirdhāna cart.
The pratiprasthātṛ priest prepares the curd for the speckled butter.

25.14.244.s: āgnīdhra idhmābarhir upasādayati | atha pratiprasthātā patnīm abhisaṃnahyet pauroḍāśikena |
25.14.244.d: आग्नीध्र इध्माबर्हिर् उपसादयति । अथ प्रतिप्रस्थाता पत्नीम् अभिसंनह्येत् पौरोडाशिकेन ।
25.14.244.m: The āgnīdhra priest sets down the kindling wood and sacrificial grass. / Then the pratiprasthātṛ priest girds the wife with the cord meant for the cake-ritual.

25.14.244.s: athaināṃ gārhapatyam īkṣayet | athainām ājyam avekṣayitvājyenādravet
25.14.244.d: अथैनां गार्हपत्यम् ईक्षयेत् । अथैनाम् आज्यम् अवेक्षयित्वाज्येनाद्रवेत्
25.14.244.m: Then he makes her look at the gārhapatya fire. / Then, having made her look at the clarified butter, he runs forward with the clarified butter.

25.14.244.s: patnyā tad evekṣitam upayacchīta tejo 'si | iti | athainac chaśalenopayatya haret tejo 'nu prehi | iti |
25.14.244.d: पत्न्या तद् एवेक्षितम् उपयच्छीत तेजो ऽसि । इति । अथैनच् छशलेनोपयत्य हरेत् तेजो ऽनु प्रेहि । इति ।
25.14.244.m: He takes what has been looked at by the wife, with [the formula]: 'Splendor you are.' / Then, holding it underneath with a splinter, he carries it forward with: 'Follow after splendor.'

25.14.244.s: athainad āhavanīye 'dhiśrayet | agnis te tejo mā vinait | iti |
25.14.244.d: अथैनद् आहवनीये ऽधिश्रयेत् । अग्निस् ते तेजो मा विनैत् । इति ।
25.14.244.m: Then he puts it over the āhavanīya fire, with: 'May Agni not take away your splendor.'
Then, holding it and placing it to the north of the sprinkling waters, he gazes at it.

25.14.244.s: utpunuyād ājyavatībhyāṃ prokṣaṇīḥ prasiddham āhavanīyasakāśe pṛṣadājyavantyājyāni gṛhṇīte siddham ata ūrdhvam ||
25.14.244.d: उत्पुनुयाद् आज्यवतीभ्यां प्रोक्षणीः प्रसिद्धम् आहवनीयसकाशे पृषदाज्यवन्त्याज्यानि गृह्णीते सिद्धम् अत ऊर्ध्वम् ॥
25.14.244.m: He purifies the sprinkling waters with two [darbha blades] wet with clarified butter; as is well known, he takes the clarified butters containing speckled butter near the āhavanīya fire; what follows is established.

25.15.245.s: atha śālīkes | evam evaiṣāṃ yathāsaṃpraiṣaṃ vihitāni karmāṇi bhavanti |
25.15.245.d: अथ शालीकेस् । एवम् एवैषां यथासंप्रैषं विहितानि कर्माणि भवन्ति ।
25.15.245.m: Now in Śālīki's opinion: / In this very way their duties are prescribed in accordance with the direction.

25.15.245.s: athādhvaryur āgneyyarcāgnīdhram abhimṛśed vaiṣṇavyā havirdhānam iti | athoparamati |
25.15.245.d: अथाध्वर्युर् आग्नेय्यर्चाग्नीध्रम् अभिमृशेद् वैष्णव्या हविर्धानम् इति । अथोपरमति ।
25.15.245.m: Then the adhvaryu priest touches the āgnīdhra shed with a verse addressed to Agni, and the havirdhāna shed with one addressed to Viṣṇu. / Then he pauses.

25.15.245.s: athaiṣa āgnīdhraḥ pūrvaḥ patnīśālaṃ drutvāgnim upasamādhāyā saṃparistīrya pātrāṇi nirṇijya sam̐sādyājyaṃ vilāpyopāste |
25.15.245.d: अथैष आग्नीध्रः पूर्वः पत्नीशालं द्रुत्वाग्निम् उपसमाधाया संपरिस्तीर्य पात्राणि निर्णिज्य सँसाद्याज्यं विलाप्योपास्ते ।
25.15.245.m: Then this āgnīdhra priest, having run ahead to the patnīśālā shed, having added fuel to the fire, having spread around [grass], having cleansed the vessels, having placed them, and having melted the clarified butter, sits by.

25.15.245.s: aparaḥ pratiprasthātā prokṣaṇīḥ sam̐skṛtya pātrāṇi prokṣet | ājyaṃ nirupayādhiśritya paryagni kṛtvā srucaḥ saṃmārṣṭi
25.15.245.d: अपरः प्रतिप्रस्थाता प्रोक्षणीः सँस्कृत्य पात्राणि प्रोक्षेत् । आज्यं निरुपयाधिश्रित्य पर्यग्नि कृत्वा स्रुचः संमार्ष्टि
25.15.245.m: The other, the pratiprasthātṛ priest, having prepared the sprinkling waters, sprinkles the vessels. / Having poured out the clarified butter, placed it on the fire, and carried fire around it, he wipes the ladles.
They carry them to the āgnīdhra shed, and also the sprinkling waters.
Then the adhvaryu priest touches the ladles with a verse addressed to Agni.

25.15.245.s: saṃmṛṣṭāni dvidhā pātrāṇy abhimrakṣyanta iti vāyavyayā vāyavyāny aindryā sadas |
25.15.245.d: संमृष्टानि द्विधा पात्राण्य् अभिम्रक्ष्यन्त इति वायव्यया वायव्यान्य् ऐन्द्र्या सदस् ।
25.15.245.m: The wiped vessels will be touched in two ways: / the vāyavya vessels with a verse addressed to Vāyu, the sadas shed with one addressed to Indra.

25.15.245.s: athaiṣa unnetā grāvovāyavyam̐ saṃprakṣālya droṇakalaśe daśāpavitre samavadhāya dakṣiṇasya havirdhānasya puro'kṣam̐ sam̐sādayati |
25.15.245.d: अथैष उन्नेता ग्रावोवायव्यँ संप्रक्षाल्य द्रोणकलशे दशापवित्रे समवधाय दक्षिणस्य हविर्धानस्य पुरोऽक्षँ सँसादयति ।
25.15.245.m: Then this unnetṛ priest, having washed the press-stone and the vāyavya vessels and having placed the fringe-strainer into the droṇakalaśa trough, sets it down before the axle of the southern havirdhāna cart.
The pratiprasthātṛ priest prepares the curd for the speckled butter.

25.15.245.s: āgnīdhra idhmābarhir upasādayati na pratiprasthātā patnīm abhisaṃnahyet pauroḍāśikena
25.15.245.d: आग्नीध्र इध्माबर्हिर् उपसादयति न प्रतिप्रस्थाता पत्नीम् अभिसंनह्येत् पौरोडाशिकेन
25.15.245.m: The āgnīdhra priest sets down the kindling wood and sacrificial grass. / The pratiprasthātṛ priest does not gird the wife with the cord meant for the cake-ritual.

25.15.245.s: naināṃ gārhapatyam īkṣayet | athainām ājyam avekṣayitvājyenādravet
25.15.245.d: नैनां गार्हपत्यम् ईक्षयेत् । अथैनाम् आज्यम् अवेक्षयित्वाज्येनाद्रवेत्
25.15.245.m: He does not make her look at the gārhapatya fire. / Then, having made her look at the clarified butter, he runs forward with the clarified butter.

25.15.245.s: patnyā tad avekṣitam upayacchīta tejo 'si | iti | athainac chakalenopayatya haret tejo 'nu prehi | iti |
25.15.245.d: पत्न्या तद् अवेक्षितम् उपयच्छीत तेजो ऽसि । इति । अथैनच् छकलेनोपयत्य हरेत् तेजो ऽनु प्रेहि । इति ।
25.15.245.m: He takes what has been looked at by the wife, with [the formula]: 'Splendor you are.' / Then, holding it underneath with a splinter, he carries it forward with: 'Follow after splendor.'

25.15.246.s: athainad āgnīdhrīye 'dhiśrayet | agnis te tejo mā vinait | iti |
25.15.246.d: अथैनद् आग्नीध्रीये ऽधिश्रयेत् । अग्निस् ते तेजो मा विनैत् । इति ।
25.15.246.m: Then he puts it over the āgnīdhrīya fire, with: 'May Agni not take away your splendor.'

25.15.246.s: athainad dhṛtvottareṇa prokṣaṇīḥ sādayitvāvekṣetotpunuyād ājyavatībhyāṃ prokṣaṇīḥ
25.15.246.d: अथैनद् धृत्वोत्तरेण प्रोक्षणीः सादयित्वावेक्षेतोत्पुनुयाद् आज्यवतीभ्यां प्रोक्षणीः
25.15.246.m: Then, holding it and placing it to the north of the sprinkling waters, he gazes at it, and purifies the sprinkling waters with two [darbha blades] wet with clarified butter.

25.15.246.s: prasiddham āgnīdhrīyasakāśe pṛṣadājyavantyājyāni gṛhītvā parikarmibhya utpradāya prokṣaṇīhasta uttareṇāgnīdhrīyaṃ dhiṣṇiyaṃ pratipadyate |
25.15.246.d: प्रसिद्धम् आग्नीध्रीयसकाशे पृषदाज्यवन्त्याज्यानि गृहीत्वा परिकर्मिभ्य उत्प्रदाय प्रोक्षणीहस्त उत्तरेणाग्नीध्रीयं धिष्णियं प्रतिपद्यते ।
25.15.246.m: As is well known, having taken the clarified butters containing speckled butter near the āgnīdhrīya fire, and having handed them over to the assistants, with the sprinkling waters in his hand he proceeds north of the āgnīdhrīya hearth.

25.15.246.s: anvañca ājyais | athedhmaṃ prokṣya vediṃ prokṣya barhiḥ prokṣya barhirāsannaṃ prokṣyopaninīya purastāt prastaraṃ gṛhītvaikavidhaṃ barhi stīrtvā prastarapāṇiḥ prāṅ abhisṛpyaudumbarān paridhīn paridhāyordhve samidhāv abhyādhāya barhirmuṣṭiṃ vidhṛtī prastaram ity etat samādāya pradakṣiṇam āvṛtya pūrvayā dvārā havirdhānaṃ prapadyottarārdhe kharasya barhirmuṣṭim̐ stṛṇīyāt |
