25.15.246.d: अन्वञ्च आज्यैस् । अथेध्मं प्रोक्ष्य वेदिं प्रोक्ष्य बर्हिः प्रोक्ष्य बर्हिरासन्नं प्रोक्ष्योपनिनीय पुरस्तात् प्रस्तरं गृहीत्वैकविधं बर्हि स्तीर्त्वा प्रस्तरपाणिः प्राङ् अभिसृप्यौदुम्बरान् परिधीन् परिधायोर्ध्वे समिधाव् अभ्याधाय बर्हिर्मुष्टिं विधृती प्रस्तरम् इत्य् एतत् समादाय प्रदक्षिणम् आवृत्य पूर्वया द्वारा हविर्धानं प्रपद्योत्तरार्धे खरस्य बर्हिर्मुष्टिँ स्तृणीयात् ।
25.15.246.m: The others follow behind with the clarified butters. / Then, having sprinkled the kindling wood, sprinkled the altar, sprinkled the sacrificial grass, sprinkled the laid-down sacrificial grass, and poured water to the east, having taken the grass bundle, having spread the sacrificial grass of single thickness, creeping eastward with the grass bundle in hand, having laid down the enclosing sticks of udumbara wood, having added two upright fuel-sticks, and having taken up the handful of sacrificial grass, the two separating blades, and the grass bundle, turning clockwise, entering the havirdhāna shed by the eastern door, he should spread the handful of sacrificial grass on the northern half of the mound.

25.15.246.s: barhiṣi vidhṛtī vidhṛtyoḥ prastaram | prastare juhūm |
25.15.246.d: बर्हिषि विधृती विधृत्योः प्रस्तरम् । प्रस्तरे जुहूम् ।
25.15.246.m: On the sacrificial grass, the two separating blades; / on the two separating blades, the grass bundle; / on the grass bundle, the juhū ladle;

25.15.246.s: barhiṣītarās | etā asadan | iti samabhimṛśya yogena yunakti
25.15.246.d: बर्हिषीतरास् । एता असदन् । इति समभिमृश्य योगेन युनक्ति
25.15.246.m: on the sacrificial grass, the other [ladles]. / Touching them together with 'These have sat down,' he yokes them with the formula.

25.16.246.m: Of what nature is the agnihotra of the consecrated one, what of the one performing the upasads, what of the one at whose rite soma is pressed?

It is taught: 'The vow-milk itself is the agnihotra of the consecrated one.'

The agnihotra of the consecrated one; / the remainder of the cauldron-milk of the one performing the upasads; / the upāṃśu and antaryāma cups of the one pressing soma.

25.16.246.s: ya udite sa prātaragnihotrabhaktiḥ kiṃdarśapūrṇamāsa iti
25.16.246.d: य उदिते स प्रातरग्निहोत्रभक्तिः किंदर्शपूर्णमास इति
25.16.246.m: that which is after sunrise is the morning agnihotra portion. / Of what nature are his new and full moon sacrifices?

25.16.247.s: vijñāyate paurṇamāsaṃ yajñam agnīṣomīyaṃ paśum akurvata dārśaṃ yajñam āgneyaṃ paśum akurvata | iti
25.16.247.d: विज्ञायते पौर्णमासं यज्ञम् अग्नीषोमीयं पशुम् अकुर्वत दार्शं यज्ञम् आग्नेयं पशुम् अकुर्वत । इति
25.16.247.m: It is taught: 'They made the animal offering to Agni-Soma the full-moon sacrifice; they made the animal offering to Agni the new-moon sacrifice.'

25.16.247.s: yatho etad aupamanyavasya kalpaṃ vedayante prātaḥsavana eva sarvebhyaḥ savanebhyaḥ savanīyān nirvapet sakṛdupahitāny eva kapālāni syus |
25.16.247.d: यथो एतद् औपमन्यवस्य कल्पं वेदयन्ते प्रातःसवन एव सर्वेभ्यः सवनेभ्यः सवनीयान् निर्वपेत् सकृदुपहितान्य् एव कपालानि स्युस् ।
25.16.247.m: And as they declare this procedure of Aupamanyava: at the morning pressing alone he should pour out the offering-cakes belonging to the soma-pressings for all the pressings; the potsherds should be arranged only once;
up to the covering with embers the ritual is performed combined.

25.16.247.s: teṣām ekaikam udvāsayed anusavanaṃ yenayena pracariṣyan syāt |
25.16.247.d: तेषाम् एकैकम् उद्वासयेद् अनुसवनं येनयेन प्रचरिष्यन् स्यात् ।
25.16.247.m: He should take off each one of them at each pressing, according as he is about to perform each.

25.16.247.s: api vā vyabhimṛṣṭānāṃ piṇḍānāṃ pariśāyayītetarayoḥ savanayos |
25.16.247.d: अपि वा व्यभिमृष्टानां पिण्डानां परिशाययीतेतरयोः सवनयोस् ।
25.16.247.m: Or rather, he should let the touched dough-balls remain over for the other two pressings.

25.16.247.s: yady ekakapālaś cikīrṣitaḥ syāt prātaḥsavanikair eva vartayet kṛtāntāt pauroḍāśikaṃ karma pratyādadītetarayoḥ savanayor anusavanam aṅgārādhyūhanenaiva kapāleṣu pratipadyeta
25.16.247.d: यद्य् एककपालश् चिकीर्षितः स्यात् प्रातःसवनिकैर् एव वर्तयेत् कृतान्तात् पौरोडाशिकं कर्म प्रत्याददीतेतरयोः सवनयोर् अनुसवनम् अङ्गाराध्यूहनेनैव कपालेषु प्रतिपद्येत
25.16.247.m: If a single-potsherd [cake] is to be made, he should perform it with those of the morning pressing only; from the prepared material he should resume the work of the cake-offering; at the other two pressings, pressing after pressing, he should attend to it on the potsherds only by covering them with embers.

25.17.247.s: yatho etad baudhāyanasya kalpaṃ vedayanta ubhayataḥśukrā ādityavatīr vasatīvarīr gṛhṇīyāt tāḥ śukrās tābhir āpyāyayet tābhir abhiṣuṇuyād iti |
25.17.247.d: यथो एतद् बौधायनस्य कल्पं वेदयन्त उभयतःशुक्रा आदित्यवतीर् वसतीवरीर् गृह्णीयात् ताः शुक्रास् ताभिर् आप्याययेत् ताभिर् अभिषुणुयाद् इति ।
25.17.247.m: Now, as they report this procedure of Baudhāyana: 'He should draw the vasatīvarī waters bright on both sides and accompanied by the sun; they are bright; with them he should swell [Soma]; with them he should press;'—

25.17.247.s: uparyardham̐ hotṛcamasaṃ kṛtvety etenaivāpi tṛtīyena vartayet
25.17.247.d: उपर्यर्धँ होतृचमसं कृत्वेत्य् एतेनैवापि तृतीयेन वर्तयेत्
25.17.247.m: having filled the hotṛ priest's goblet to the upper half, he should proceed even with this third [portion].

25.17.247.s: trayīrapaḥ pūrvayā dvārā havirdhānaṃ prapādayed dhotṛcamasīyā vasatīvarīyā maitrāvaruṇacamasīyā iti dakṣiṇena hotāraṃ parigṛhyāparayā dvāraikadhanān
25.17.247.d: त्रयीरपः पूर्वया द्वारा हविर्धानं प्रपादयेद् धोतृचमसीया वसतीवरीया मैत्रावरुणचमसीया इति दक्षिणेन होतारं परिगृह्यापरया द्वारैकधनान्
25.17.247.m: He should bring the three waters into the havirdhāna shed by the eastern door: those for the hotṛ priest's goblet, those of the vasatīvarī, [and] those for the Maitrāvaruṇa priest's goblet; having gone around south of the hotṛ priest, [he brings] the ekadhana waters by the western door.

25.17.247.s: etasmim̐ś ca kāle sarvaśa eva maitrāvaruṇacamasīyāḥ paryasyet tṛtīyaṃ vasatīvarīṇām avanayet tṛtīyam ekadhanānām
25.17.247.d: एतस्मिँश् च काले सर्वश एव मैत्रावरुणचमसीयाः पर्यस्येत् तृतीयं वसतीवरीणाम् अवनयेत् तृतीयम् एकधनानाम्
25.17.247.m: And at this time, he should completely pour out the waters for the Maitrāvaruṇa priest's goblet; he should pour in a third of the vasatīvarī waters, [and] a third of the ekadhana waters.

25.17.248.s: evam asya prākkevalaḥ śukro bhavati somagrahaṃ gṛhṇīyād brahmavarcasakāmasya | iti |
25.17.248.d: एवम् अस्य प्राक्केवलः शुक्रो भवति सोमग्रहं गृह्णीयाद् ब्रह्मवर्चसकामस्य । इति ।
25.17.248.m: In this way, for him the śukra cup becomes pure before. / 'He should draw a soma-cup for one who desires spiritual luster:'

25.17.248.s: aniruptasyaivaiṣa rājño grahītavyo bhavati kā u khalu devatāḥ prathamam̐ somaṃ bhakṣayantīti |
25.17.248.d: अनिरुप्तस्यैवैष राज्ञो ग्रहीतव्यो भवति का उ खलु देवताः प्रथमँ सोमं भक्षयन्तीति ।
25.17.248.m: this [cup] must be drawn only from King [Soma] before he has been poured out. / 'Which deities, indeed, consume soma first?'

25.17.248.s: vijñāyata upahūtāḥ somasya pibata | upahūto yuṣmākam̐ somaḥ pibatu | iti
25.17.248.d: विज्ञायत उपहूताः सोमस्य पिबत । उपहूतो युष्माकँ सोमः पिबतु । इति
25.17.248.m: It is known [from the sacred text]: 'Invited, drink of soma,' 'May your soma, invited, drink.'

25.17.248.s: kva u khalu somasya somapītho bhavatīti
25.17.248.d: क्व उ खलु सोमस्य सोमपीथो भवतीति
25.17.248.m: 'Where, indeed, does the drinking of soma by soma take place?'

25.17.248.s: vijñāyate yat te somādābhyaṃ nāma jāgṛvi tasmai te soma somāya svāhā | iti |
25.17.248.d: विज्ञायते यत् ते सोमादाभ्यं नाम जागृवि तस्मै ते सोम सोमाय स्वाहा । इति ।
25.17.248.m: It is known [from the sacred text]: 'Whatever name of yours is inviolable, watchful, to that Soma of yours, to soma, svāhā.'

25.17.248.s: eṣa evāpi somasya somapīthas teṣām̐ saṃnipatitānām ānupūrvateti
25.17.248.d: एष एवापि सोमस्य सोमपीथस् तेषाँ संनिपतितानाम् आनुपूर्वतेति
25.17.248.m: This indeed is the drinking of soma by soma. / As to the sequence of those when they have come together:
having made [the sacrificer] recite over the nigrābhyā waters, he should proceed with the adābhya cup; / then he should take the upāṃśusavana stone;

25.17.248.s: atha rājānaṃ nirvapet siddham atrāgniṣṭomikaṃ karma jānīyād ā phalakayor abhimarśanāt
25.17.248.d: अथ राजानं निर्वपेत् सिद्धम् अत्राग्निष्टोमिकं कर्म जानीयाद् आ फलकयोर् अभिमर्शनात्
25.17.248.m: then he should apportion King [Soma]. / One should know the rite of the Agniṣṭoma here to be established up to the touching of the two sounding boards.
Having touched the two sounding boards, he should proceed with the pṛśni cups.

25.17.248.s: atha prāṇagrahaiś caret | athām̐śūn upasaṃgṛhṇīyāt | athām̐śunā caret |
25.17.248.d: अथ प्राणग्रहैश् चरेत् । अथाँशून् उपसंगृह्णीयात् । अथाँशुना चरेत् ।
25.17.248.m: Then he should proceed with the prāṇa cups; / then he should gather the soma shoots together; / then he should proceed with the aṃśu cup;

25.17.248.d: अथोपाँशुना काले ऽन्तर्यामेण सिद्धम् अत ऊर्ध्वम् ॥
25.17.248.m: then with the upāṃśu cup; / at the proper time with the antaryāma cup. / Established from this point onward.

25.18.248.s: yatho etad baudhāyanasya kalpaṃ vedayanta āgrayaṇasya grahaṇe dvayor dhārayoḥ prātaḥsavane gṛhṇīyāt tisṛṇāṃ mādhyaṃdine savane catasṛṇāṃ tṛtīyasavana iti |
25.18.248.d: यथो एतद् बौधायनस्य कल्पं वेदयन्त आग्रयणस्य ग्रहणे द्वयोर् धारयोः प्रातःसवने गृह्णीयात् तिसृणां माध्यंदिने सवने चतसृणां तृतीयसवन इति ।
25.18.248.m: Now, as they report this procedure of Baudhāyana: 'At the drawing of the āgrayaṇa cup, he should draw in two streams at the morning pressing, in three at the midday pressing, in four at the third pressing;'—

25.18.248.s: upām̐śvantaryāmayoś ca sam̐srāvaḥ saṃtataś ca śukra ete dve prātaḥsavane
25.18.248.d: उपाँश्वन्तर्यामयोश् च सँस्रावः संततश् च शुक्र एते द्वे प्रातःसवने
25.18.248.m: the residue of the upāṃśu and antaryāma cups, and the continuous śukra cup: these two are at the morning pressing.

25.18.248.s: saṃtataś caiva śukra āgrayaṇaś codacanena ca tṛtīyā mādhyaṃdine savane |
25.18.248.d: संततश् चैव शुक्र आग्रयणश् चोदचनेन च तृतीया माध्यंदिने सवने ।
25.18.248.m: And the continuous Śukra, and the Āgrayaṇa, and a third with the bucket at the midday pressing;
